docs.title: CRUD 骨架
docs.text: Symfony 8.1 API 后端框架，具有模块化架构、JWT 身份验证、动态查询引擎和可插拔业务模块。

docs.title: 架构
docs.text:
src/
├── Core/       # Framework core (RestController, BaseService, View Mixins, Expression Parser)
├── Common/     # CMS module (Category, Tag, Content, Comment, Page, Media, Setting)
├── Trade/      # E-Commerce (Product, Specification, Order, OrderItem, Pricing Pipeline)
├── Payment/    # Payments (Invoice, Gateway abstraction, Webhooks, Events)
├── Wallet/     # Wallet (Balance, Atomic Transfers, Idempotency)
├── Wechat/     # WeChat (Mini Program/Official Account Login, WeChat Pay V3, Gateway)
└── Identity/   # Authentication (JWT RS256, OTP SMS, Refresh Token Rotation)

docs.title: 技术堆栈
docs.text: 组件 技术 框架 交响乐 8.1 语言 PHP 8.4+ 对象关系管理 学说 ORM 3.6 数据库 MySQL 8 授权 JWT (RS256) + OTP（阿里云短信） API 文档 Swagger UI (/api/doc) 通过 NelmioApiDocBundle 测试 PHPUnit 12.5（最低覆盖率 90%） 静态分析 PHPStan Level 8 + Rector 类型规则试运行 前端 crud-admin — 配置驱动的管理面板

docs.title: 主要特点
docs.text:
• 基于表达式的动态查询：带有 DQL 编译的 @filter、@sort、@dql、@order、@select 查询参数
  • 基于特征的控制器组合：将 9 个 PHP 特征（列表、详细信息、创建、更新、删除、工作流等）组装到控制器中
  • 可插拔的价格计算管道：用于电子商务订单定价的优先顺序计算器
  • 状态机：订单生命周期（草稿 -> 已完成）和发票生命周期（待处理 -> 已付款/退款）的 Symfony 工作流
  • 基于发票的支付框架：网关抽象（模拟/钱包/微信）、webhooks、与提供商无关的发票事件
  • 微信集成：小程序和公众号登录、微信支付V3网关、WechatUser实体（OneToOne→User）
  • 系统自省：通过 /system/* 端点导出实体元数据和路由
  • 原子钱包转账：死锁预防、乐观锁定、幂等性
  • 具有重用检测的令牌轮换：刷新哈希令牌 (HMAC-SHA256)，在使用时轮换

docs.title: 快速入门
docs.text:
# Clone
git clone https://github.com/immane/crud-skeleton.git
cd crud-skeleton

# Start all services
docker compose up -d --build

# Run migrations
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction

# Create an admin user
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin

docs.title: 文档
docs.text:
• Design Contracts -- 系统架构规则、API设计、数据模型、控制器合约
  • Bundles -- 每个模块的设计文档（Core、Common、Trade、Wallet、Identity）
  • API Docs -- 交互式 Swagger UI（运行时）

docs.title: 质量检查
docs.text:
使用 PHP 8.4 或更高版本，然后运行 CI 强制执行的检查：

composer phpstan
composer rector:types:check
XDEBUG_MODE=coverage vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text

PHPStan 和 Rector 作业使用独立的 SQLite URL，因此 Composer 的缓存清除 脚本可以在没有本地配置的开发数据库的情况下运行。

docs.title: CRUD Skeleton - Full Codebase Context
docs.text: Context snapshot. Last updated: 2026-09-01

docs.title: 1. Project Overview
docs.text: CRUD Skeleton is a Symfony 8.1 API backend skeleton with: - PHP 8.4+, Doctrine ORM 3.6, MySQL 8 (Docker), SQLite (tests) - JWT authentication (RS256), OTP/SMS login, WeChat Mini Program / Official Account login - Expression-based dynamic query engine (@filter, @sort, @dql) + server-owned row-scope DqlExpression (entity.getUser() == this.getUser(), in/not in with empty-collection safety) - Modular architecture: Core (framework + DqlExpression), Common (CMS + Content metadata field-grant pilot), Authorization (independent RBAC — scoped Store grants, strict field grants, audit, AuthorizationVoter), Promotion (DSL-driven promotions), Identity (auth), Trade (commercial orders), Store (multi-store operations and approved shared/private catalog target), Payment (invoices), Wallet (balances), Inventory (stock & reservation), Wechat (login + pay), Storage (file upload drivers) - EasyWeChat 6.x integration (Mini Program, Official Account OAuth, WeChat Pay V3) - NelmioApiDoc (Swagger at /api/doc), PHPUnit 12.5, Docker Compose (7 services: app, worker, scheduler, nginx, MySQL, Redis, Mailpit) - MkDocs Material + GitHub Pages documentation (mermaid diagram rendering enabled via CDN + pymdownx.superfences custom fence) - i18n: Symfony Translation with en, zh, zh_Hant, ja — all user-facing messages, entity/field names, and status values translated - Wallet ledger: voucher-backed single-sided deposits/withdrawals (wallet_voucher boundary ledger) with provider-owned voucher-type permissions; Exchange bundle design (pool-backed points economy) at docs/design/bundles/exchange.md

docs.title: Store Catalog (Implemented)
docs.text: docs/design/store-catalog.md is the implemented catalog model: Store owns Product/Specification (store nullable, NULL = shared/global; tables trade_product/trade_specification retained via Version20260902000000 (store_id) and Version20260903000000/Version20260903000001 two-step specificationUuid backfill (irreversible)). App\Store\Controller\App\ProductController / SpecificationController enforce row-scope via DqlExpression (!entity.getStore() / !entity.getProduct().getStore() and || with ExpressionDqlParser-validated syntax) and Trade\Service\Pricing\BasePriceCalculator resolves via Trade\Service\Catalog\CatalogResolverInterface implemented by Store\Service\Catalog\StoreCatalogResolver (X-Store-Code → StoreContext). Trade remains order authority; Inventory and OrderItem remain scalar specificationUuid snapshots. PHPStan Level 8 passes with no Authorization ignoreErrors suppressions.

docs.title: 3. Request Lifecycle
docs.text:
1. public/index.php → App\Kernel (MicroKernelTrait)
  2. config/routes.yaml imports: /api/v1 (Authorization/Common/Trade/Store/Wallet/Payment/Promotion/Wechat/Inventory/Settlement App+Manage), /api/auth (Identity), /api/wechat (Wechat login), /system (introspection), /api/payment/notify (webhook)
  3. JwtAuthenticator intercepts all /api routes (except public paths listed in security.yaml); AuthorizationVoter enforces common:content:*/authorization:*/store:order:* after authentication
  4. Controller action (ApiView mixin lifecycle: commonFilter → listFilter/processCreateContent → BaseService → Doctrine → DB) — Manage controllers use #[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')] + List/Detail/Create/Update/Delete mixins, Store-scoped controllers enforce Membership + AuthorizationService + FieldAuthorizationService
  5. RestController::success() / warning() → JSON {data, code, message, paginator}

docs.title: 4. Authentication Flow
docs.text: Endpoint Method Auth Description /api/auth/login POST PUBLIC Email/username/phone + password → {access_token, refresh_token} /api/auth/register POST PUBLIC Self-registration (email, username, password, phone?) → tokens /api/auth/otp/request POST PUBLIC Request 6-digit OTP via SMS (Alibaba Cloud) /api/auth/otp/verify POST PUBLIC Verify OTP → tokens or mark phone verified /api/auth/token/refresh POST PUBLIC Rotate refresh token (old revoked, new issued) /api/auth/logout POST PUBLIC Revoke access token + optional refresh token /api/wechat/miniapp/login POST PUBLIC WeChat Mini Program js_code → JWT tokens /api/wechat/oauth/url GET PUBLIC Official Account OAuth redirect URL /api/wechat/oauth/callback POST PUBLIC OAuth code → JWT tokens /api/wechat/miniapp/phone POST AUTH Bind WeChat phone number to authenticated user

docs.title: 4.1 User Profile (App)
docs.text: Method Path Auth Description GET /api/v1/app/users/me ROLE_USER Current user profile PUT /api/v1/app/users/me ROLE_USER Update email, username, phone, optional password POST /api/v1/app/users/change-password ROLE_USER Change password (requires current)

docs.title: 4.2 Profile (App)
docs.text:
Method Path Auth Description GET /api/v1/app/profiles ROLE_USER Current user profile (self-service: nickname, avatar, metadata) PUT /api/v1/app/profiles ROLE_USER Update nickname, avatar, metadata (level is admin-only)

Profile is auto-created on User registration via a Doctrine lifecycle listener. Points are delegated to Wallet (currency=POINTS). Formerly named Member.

docs.title: 4.3 User Management (Manage)
docs.text: Method Path Auth Description GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/manage/users/* ROLE_ADMIN Admin user CRUD POST /api/v1/manage/users/{id}/change-password ROLE_ADMIN Admin change user password

docs.title: 4.4 Profile Management (Manage)
docs.text:
Method Path Auth Description GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/manage/profiles/* ROLE_ADMIN Admin profile CRUD (including level)

UserService (App\Identity\Service\UserService): encapsulates register, verifyPassword, changePassword, adminChangePassword, updateProfile. Auto-hashes passwords in update().

Token management: RS256 JWT (7200s TTL), HMAC-SHA256 refresh tokens with rotation + reuse detection.

Translation: AuthController, OtpController, LoginController inject TranslatorInterface and pass error messages through trans(). JwtAuthenticator also translates onAuthenticationFailure() messages.

docs.title: 4.5 Authorization (Manage + App)
docs.text:
Method Path Auth Description GET /api/v1/manage/permissions ROLE_ADMIN List permission catalogue (seeded, read-only — no HTTP create/update/delete) GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/manage/roles/* ROLE_ADMIN Roles (List/Detail/Create/Update/Delete) + POST /{uuid}/permissions replace, PUT /{uuid}/field-grants/{resource}/{action} replace; system roles are 403 on update/delete/replace GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/manage/assignments /manage/assignments/{uuid} ROLE_ADMIN List (filter userUuid/scope), grant (idempotent batch, scope-compat, audit+cache), detail, update (re-validated, audit assignment.updated), revoke (soft revokedAt, audit, cache evict) GET /api/v1/manage/audit-logs ROLE_ADMIN Paginated audit history (targetType, actorUuid) GET /api/v1/app/authorization/me ROLE_USER Current user effective permissions/storeScopes/fieldGrants (UI only) common:content metadata metadata (json) Content.metadata field-grant pilot (editor vs metadata_editor via FieldAuthorizationService)

Setup: php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate && php bin/console app:authorization:seed (idempotent, registry-validated; see docs/manual/authorization.md and docs/runbooks/authorization.md). AuthorizationService uses cache.app (authorization_effective_*, 300s, DB fallback, admin bypass). Assignment uniqueness is UNIQUE(user_uuid, role_id, scope_type, scope_key) (scope_key='' for global) so global grants are portable across MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite.

docs.title: 5. Dynamic Query System
docs.text:
BaseServiceReadListTrait::list() supports:

Param Description Example @filter Expression → DQL WHERE entity.status == "active" @dql Raw DQL sub-query (entity.price > 100) @order ORDER BY createdAt\|DESC @select DQL SELECT entity.id, entity.name @groupBy GROUP BY entity.category @sort In-memory sort item.getPrice() @expands Nested expansion category,tags @display Field projection complex, reduce @transform Field transformation Math.mul(value, 100) page, limit Pagination page=1&limit=20

Expression syntax: ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=, &&, ||, !, matches, in/not in (array-bound, empty in [] → 1=0, empty not in → 1=1), chained attributes, Math, ArrayCommon, FilterDateTime functions. Falls back to in-memory LegacyEvaluator when DQL compilation fails.

Server-owned row-scope: DqlExpression (src/Core/Query/DqlExpression.php) — immutable expression/values/criteria/this, compiled via ExpressionDqlParser + ExpressionQueryBuilderAssembler in BaseServiceReadListTrait, ApiView::resolvedCommonFilter() binds this, BaseService validates criteria against Doctrine metadata, fail-closed 500 on error (no LegacyEvaluator).

docs.title: 6. BaseService Architecture
docs.text:
BaseServiceInterface and BaseService use @template TEntity of object to propagate entity types through the service layer. Concrete services declare @extends BaseService<Entity> and interfaces declare @extends BaseServiceInterface<Entity>. This enables PHPStan to infer return types from get(), new(), and update() at call sites.

flowchart TD
    base["BaseService<Order> (abstract, @template TEntity, @implements BaseServiceInterface<TEntity>)"]
    base --> infra["BaseServiceInfrastructureTrait # EM, Logger, Serializer, Validator, Transactions"]
    base --> readList["BaseServiceReadListTrait<TEntity> # get(mixed): TEntity|null, list(): mixed (QueryBuilder/DqlExpression/array)"]
    base --> mutation["BaseServiceMutationTrait<TEntity> # new(): object, update(mixed): object|false, remove(): bool"]

Key PHPDoc contracts: - get(mixed $criteria): Accepts TEntity|int|string|array<string, mixed>|QueryBuilder|DqlExpression → returns TEntity|null - list(array|QueryBuilder|DqlExpression $filter): Returns mixed (QueryBuilder, Entity[], or scalar arrays depending on @select/@groupBy); disableRequest=false enables @filter/@dql from Request - new(): Returns object (native), @return TEntity (PHPDoc) - update(mixed $object, ?array $data): Returns object|false — native mixed param with PHPDoc @param mixed for trait compatibility - remove($object): Accepts TEntity|int|string|array<string, mixed> - wrapInTransaction(callable $fn): Transaction with commit/rollback - commonFilter: May return array|QueryBuilder|DqlExpression; DqlExpression supports this shorthand and in/not in

docs.title: 8.2 PaymentGatewayInterface — Gateway Registry Pattern
docs.text:
interface PaymentGatewayInterface {
    static getName(): string;           // e.g. 'wallet', 'wechat', 'mock'
    pay(Invoice, int $amount, array $options): PaymentResult;
    notify(Request $request): PaymentNotifyResult;
    refund(Invoice, int $amount, int $paidAmount, string $reason, array $options): PaymentRefundResult;
    getNotifySuccessResponse(PaymentNotifyResult $result): Response;
}

Gateways receive explicit payment/refund amounts and MUST NOT inspect deduction or adjustment options. Invoice::amount remains the gross business payable amount; the gateway amount is computed by InvoiceService after applying payment adjustments.

Gateways are auto-tagged payment.gateway via _instanceof rule. PaymentGatewayRegistry uses #[AutowireIterator('payment.gateway')] for auto-discovery.

docs.title: 8.2.1 Payment Adjustment Providers
docs.text:
Payment defines PaymentAdjustmentProviderInterface — a pre-payment hook that reduces the amount a gateway must process. Implementations live in the owning module (e.g., Wallet provides WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider for wallet balance deduction). Providers are auto-tagged payment.adjustment_provider and collected by PaymentAdjustmentRegistry.

Provider Module Description wallet_balance Wallet Wallet balance deduction before gateway payment (future) coupons / points Coupon / Loyalty modules Other deduction types through the same extension point

InvoiceService orchestrates adjustment providers and gateways without knowing deduction internals: 1. Apply registered adjustments → total applied amount 2. Compute gatewayAmount = invoice.amount - adjustmentAmount 3. Call gateway with explicit amount

docs.text: Gateway Module Purpose mock Payment (Service/Gateway/MockGateway.php) Deterministic test/development gateway wallet Wallet (Service/Payment/WalletGateway.php) Internal wallet balance payment wechat Wechat (Service/Payment/WechatPayGateway.php) WeChat Pay V3 adapter

docs.title: 8.4 Payment/Trade Integration Status
docs.text:
Current payment-result propagation is synchronous: InvoiceService dispatches InvoicePaidEvent, InvoiceFailedEvent, InvoiceCancelledEvent, and InvoiceRefundedEvent; Trade\EventListener\OrderInvoiceListener updates the Trade order in process.

The approved next migration is intentionally limited to Payment Outbox -> Trade Inbox. Payment will write versioned lifecycle events in the same transaction as an Invoice state mutation, and Trade will consume them idempotently. The first event is payment.invoice.paid.v1, followed by failed/cancelled/refunded events. Trade keeps the current synchronous InvoiceService calls for Invoice creation, payment initiation, cancellation, and refund during this phase. A Payment Inbox and trade.payment.requested.v1 Saga are explicitly deferred until Payment service extraction requires them.

The future payment Outbox publisher will join the automatic scheduler alongside Trade and Store publishers; the existing worker will consume its Messenger messages.

docs.title: 10.1 Architecture
docs.text:
Symfony Translation component with 4 locales. Translation files are YAML-based under translations/.

Locale File Language en translations/messages.en.yaml English (default, identity mapping) zh translations/messages.zh.yaml Chinese (Simplified) zh_Hant translations/messages.zh_Hant.yaml Chinese (Traditional) ja translations/messages.ja.yaml Japanese

~280 translation keys per locale covering: entity names (19), field names (96), status/enum values (17), authentication/JWT messages, WeChat errors, Core framework errors (View mixins, Service traits), success messages, Wallet/Trade/Payment/media/Storage errors, expression parser errors, and more.

docs.title: 10.2 Translation Flow
docs.text:
All user-facing messages pass through the translator:

Source Method Translation Point Uncaught exceptions (API routes) ExceptionInterceptor::onKernelException() $this->translator->trans($exception->getMessage()) Controller warnings RestController::warning() $this->getTranslator()->trans($error_msg) Auth/Otp/Login errors AuthController::error() etc. $this->translator->trans($message) JWT auth failures JwtAuthenticator::onAuthenticationFailure() $this->translator->trans($messageKey) Entity field names EntityController /system/entities/{name} $this->getTranslator()->trans($plainTextFieldName)

docs.title: 10.3 LocaleListener (src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php)
docs.text:
Registered at kernel.request priority 20. Language detection priority:

  1. ?_locale= query parameter — explicit override (e.g., ?_locale=ja)
  2. Accept-Language header — browser-sent preference with quality factor ordering
  3. zh-CN, zh-Hans → zh
  4. zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-Hant → zh_Hant
  5. ja-JP → ja
  6. en-US, en-GB → en
  7. Fallback — config/packages/translation.yaml default_locale: en

Sub-requests are ignored.

docs.title: 11. Storage Module
docs.text: Storage is an infrastructure module under src/Storage/. Common/Media depends only on MediaStorageInterface and MediaStorageRegistry; Storage does not depend on Common entities or controllers.

docs.title: 11.1 Drivers
docs.text:
Driver Class Configuration Notes local App\Storage\Service\LocalStorage media.local.upload_path, media.local.base_url Always available. Stores under public/uploads/{YYYYMM}/{random}.{ext} and returns /uploads/... URLs. qiniu App\Storage\Service\QiniuStorage common_setting keys Optional. Reads qiniu.access_key, qiniu.secret_key, qiniu.bucket, qiniu.domain at runtime.

Qiniu SDK note: qiniu/php-sdk is intentionally not required by composer.json because v7.14 emits PHP 8.5 vendor deprecations. QiniuStorage checks for Qiniu\Auth, Qiniu\Storage\UploadManager, and Qiniu\Storage\BucketManager only when storage=qiniu is used; if missing, it throws a clear runtime error. Server deployments that need Qiniu may install it locally with composer require qiniu/php-sdk.

docs.title: 11.2 Media Upload Flow
docs.text:
Endpoint Method Auth Description /api/v1/app/media/upload POST multipart ROLE_USER Upload current user's media. App media list/detail is scoped by ['user' => $this->getUser()]. /api/v1/app/media/{id} DELETE ROLE_USER Delete current user's own uploaded media. Uses app commonFilter() so other users' media returns 404; local files are best-effort removed. /api/v1/manage/media/upload POST multipart ROLE_ADMIN Admin upload endpoint, reuses App upload action via inheritance. Manage media CRUD uses no common filter. /api/v1/public/media GET PUBLIC Public read-only media list. Only returns media with nullable owner (user IS NULL). /api/v1/public/media/{id} GET PUBLIC Public read-only media detail. Only returns media with nullable owner (user IS NULL).

Multipart fields: - file: required uploaded file - storage: optional driver name, defaults to MEDIA_STORAGE_DEFAULT / media.storage.default (local) - category: optional common_category id; invalid ids return Category is not found - alt, title, width, height: optional metadata

MediaService::createFromUpload() validates file presence/size/MIME, resolves the selected storage driver, stores the physical file, persists Common\Entity\Media, assigns the current authenticated User when available, and binds an optional Category from multipart category. MediaService::remove() best-effort deletes the physical file via the media's stored driver before removing the entity. App media delete now reuses DeleteApiViewMixin, scoped by owner.

Media stores storage, nullable owner user (ManyToOne User, ON DELETE SET NULL), and nullable category (ManyToOne Category, ON DELETE SET NULL). Manage media create/update accepts category ids. Public media uses a QueryBuilder commonFilter() with media.user IS NULL because array criteria cannot express SQL IS NULL.

[] = no filter (admin), ['user' => $user] = user-scoped, ['id' => -1] = block all, DqlExpression('entity.getStoreUuid() == storeUuid') for readable Store scope, QueryBuilder required for IS NULL filters Payment via wallet Trade POST /app/orders/{id}/payment with payment: "wallet" creates Invoice → WalletGateway deducts user wallet Payment integration migration Payment -> Trade Next phase replaces synchronous Invoice domain-event consumption with Payment Outbox and Trade Inbox; Payment request Inbox/Saga remains deferred Balance audit Wallet GET /app/wallets/balance audits only current user's wallets; GET /manage/wallets/balance is global; POST /manage/wallets/reconcile fixes per-wallet gaps with TYPE_ADJUSTMENT Idempotent deposit Wallet POST /api/v1/manage/vouchers/deposit with referenceId — duplicate requests return existing transaction Voucher-backed deposit/withdrawal Wallet Single-sided credit/debit entries backed by wallet_voucher: deposit = fromWallet = null (TYPE_DEPOSIT), withdrawal = toWallet = null (TYPE_WITHDRAWAL); docs.title: 17. Testing
docs.text:
• Framework: PHPUnit 12.5 (brianium/paratest available for parallel runs)
  • Layout: tests are organized by layer, not by module — tests/UnitTest/ (pure unit tests, no kernel/DB), tests/Integration/ (kernel + DB + HTTP tests, plus helpers DatabaseBootstrapTrait/IntegrationWebTestCase/IntegrationKernelTestCase/StoreTradeFlowTestCase), tests/LowValue/ (deprecated/low-value tests excluded from the default run). Namespace App\Tests\ mirrors the layout: App\Tests\UnitTest\..., App\Tests\Integration\..., App\Tests\LowValue\.... Test-support resources: tests/bootstrap.php and JWT test keys under tests/Identity/Security/ (referenced by .env.test and CI).
  • Low-value exclusion mechanism: phpunit.dist.xml defines the "Project Test Suite" (UnitTest + Integration dirs) and a separate "Low Value" suite; a global <exclude><group>low-value</group></exclude> removes every test carrying #[Group('low-value')] (class- or method-level) from the default run — covering both whole LowValue files and individual flagged methods inside kept files (from the 2026-08-09 test audit). Run them explicitly with php bin/phpunit --group low-value (~480 tests).
  • DB: local tests default to SQLite var/test.db (paratest uses per-worker SQLite files); CI tests job runs on PostgreSQL 16; migrations.yml validates the migration chain on MySQL 8.4
  • Coverage: 90% minimum (enforced in CI), currently 99.46% lines (8511/8557) from latest local Xdebug run (2026-08-09); Authorization pilot adds 1 integration test (27 assertions) with DqlExpression + in coverage
  • Test count: 2394 tests / 8658 assertions in the default suite (UnitTest + Integration), plus ~480 low-value tests excluded by default; 31 skipped tests document real src/ bugs (see §23 and docs/issues/coverage-2026-08-09/); never delete or un-skip them without fixing the underlying bug
  • Suite runtime: serial ≈ 59 s (kernel-bootstrapping integration tests dominate). Run parallel with paratest for ~2.3× speedup: PARATEST=1 php vendor/bin/paratest --processes 8 --runner WrapperRunner (≈26 s; per-worker SQLite isolation is handled by tests/bootstrap.php)
  • PHPUnit Notices: 159 pre-existing mock/no-expectation noise (does not fail the run); new tests should avoid adding more
  • Memory: phpunit.dist.xml sets test-process memory_limit=512M (OpenAPI integration builds the full spec in-process)
  • Test-quality contract: docs/testing/crud-skeleton-production/ (TEST_STRATEGY, TEST_MATRIX, BUSINESS_INVARIANTS, FAILURE_MODES, PRODUCTION_VALIDATION) governs what evidence a change requires before merge/release
  • Static analysis: PHPStan Level 8 with zero errors in its configured scope (src/, excluding optional SDK code, exception classes, and documented false-positive suppressions). Generic contract via @template TEntity on BaseServiceInterface/BaseService + @extends on 18 concrete service pairs. Rector automates Doctrine Collection/Repository PHPDoc with composer rector:types; CI enforces composer rector:types:check as a dry-run.
  • Local PHP note: default php may point to PHP 7.4; use Homebrew PHP 8.5 at /opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.5/bin/php for local Symfony/PHPUnit commands.
  • HTML coverage report: XDEBUG_MODE=coverage ./vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-html var/coverage
  • Key test groups (after the 2026-08-09 layer re-organization; module folders now live under each layer):
  • tests/UnitTest/: 197 files — pure unit tests (entities, utils, DSL, strategies, mock-based services/controllers, workflow state machine, listeners)
  • tests/Integration/: 73 files — kernel+DB+HTTP (module integration flows, API regressions, outbox/inbox, concurrency, cross-module flows, health/metrics/rate-limit endpoints, AuthorizationContentPilotTest) plus the 4 shared helpers; Trade integration remains the slowest area (see test-audit)
  • tests/LowValue/: 43 files — flagged by the 2026-08-09 audit as duplicates/coverage-chasing; excluded from default runs (--group low-value to execute)
  • scripts/tests/api-smoke.sh: real HTTP auth/catalog/wallet/order/payment smoke; strict 401/403/404 checks
  • scripts/tests/store-smoke.sh: real HTTP Store-scoped order, Trade Outbox, Messenger consumer, Store Outbox, and store_accepted assertion
  • scripts/tests/inventory-smoke.sh: Inventory-scoped smoke (only when INVENTORY_ENABLED=1)

docs.text:
Var Purpose APP_ENV, APP_DEBUG Symfony environment DATABASE_URL DB connection (PostgreSQL/SQLite/MySQL) JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH, JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH RS256 key pair (Docker dev: generated once under mounted ./var/jwt if missing) JWT_PASSPHRASE Private key passphrase REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET HMAC-SHA256 secret OTP_REDIS_DSN Redis for OTP storage ALIYUN_SMS_* Alibaba Cloud SMS WECHAT_MINIAPP_APP_ID, WECHAT_MINIAPP_SECRET WeChat Mini Program WECHAT_OFFICIAL_APP_ID, WECHAT_OFFICIAL_SECRET, WECHAT_OFFICIAL_TOKEN, WECHAT_OFFICIAL_AES_KEY Official Account WECHAT_PAY_MCH_ID, WECHAT_PAY_SECRET_KEY, WECHAT_PAY_PRIVATE_KEY, WECHAT_PAY_CERTIFICATE, WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL WeChat Pay V3 MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN Async transport OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL Seconds between automatic Trade/Store Outbox relay runs (default 5) DEFAULT_URI Base URL for CLI contexts MAILER_DSN Mailer transport MEDIA_STORAGE_DEFAULT Default media storage driver (local by default) INVENTORY_ENABLED Toggle global inventory bypass (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, default 0)

Qiniu configuration is intentionally not environment-variable based. Configure these records in common_setting when storage=qiniu is needed: qiniu.access_key, qiniu.secret_key, qiniu.bucket, qiniu.domain.

docs.title: 19.1 Architecture
docs.text: 7 services in compose.yaml: nginx (reverse proxy), app (PHP-FPM 8.4), worker (Messenger async consumer), scheduler (Trade/Store Outbox relay; Payment joins when its Outbox is implemented), database (MySQL 8), redis (Redis 7 Alpine), mailer (Mailpit).

docs.title: 19.2 Development (zero-config)
docs.text:
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:authorization:seed
  • compose.override.yaml auto-loads — sets APP_ENV=dev, APP_DEBUG=1, source mount
  • docker/app/entrypoint.sh creates development JWT keys once under mounted ./var/jwt if missing; production fails fast when keys are missing
  • All optional features (WeChat, SMS) default to empty — disabled gracefully

docs.title: 19.3 Production
docs.text: Requires .env.prod.local copied from .env.prod.example with APP_SECRET, REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET, MYSQL_PASSWORD, and MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD. JWT keys are generated on the host at ./var/jwt/ and mounted into the container. Start production with docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build.

docs.title: 19.4 Environment Variables in Docker
docs.text: compose.yaml provides defaults for DATABASE_URL, MAILER_DSN, OTP_REDIS_DSN, and JWT key paths. Required vars use ${VAR:?required} which fails fast if missing. Optional vars use ${VAR:-} which defaults to empty.

docs.title: 20. Console Commands
docs.text: Command Module Purpose app:identity:user:create Identity Create user: email, username, password, --phone, --role, --admin, --phone-verified app:authorization:seed Authorization Seed permissions/roles/field-grants (11/3/4, idempotent, registry-validated) app:storage:qiniu:settings:init Storage Initialize missing Qiniu common_setting records (qiniu.access_key, qiniu.secret_key, qiniu.bucket, qiniu.domain) without overwriting existing values app:trade:outbox:publish Trade Relay unpublished Trade integration events to Messenger app:store:outbox:publish Store Relay Store acceptance/rejection events to Messenger app:inventory:outbox:publish Inventory Relay published Inventory integration events to Messenger app:inventory:reservations:release-expired Inventory Release expired confirmed reservations

docs.title: 21. Service Container Wiring
docs.text:
• Default: all src/ classes autowired/autoconfigured
  • Explicit exclusions: FlatNormalizer, EventListener classes (except OpenApiEnricherListener), Auth/Otp controllers, TokenManager, AliyunSmsProvider, RedisOtpStorage, Storage concrete drivers, WechatService, src/Wechat/Service/Payment/WechatPayGateway.php
  • OpenApiEnricherListener: registered with kernel.event_listener tag on kernel.response (priority -10)
  • AccessLogListener: registered with kernel.event_listener tag on kernel.response (priority -5)
  • LocaleListener: registered with kernel.event_listener tag on kernel.request (priority 20)
  • RestController subclasses get RequestStack, SerializerInterface, TranslatorInterface via #[Required] setter injection
  • PaymentGatewayInterface implementations auto-tagged payment.gateway, collected via #[AutowireIterator]
  • PaymentAdjustmentProviderInterface implementations auto-tagged payment.adjustment_provider, collected via #[AutowireIterator]
  • DepositProviderInterface / WithdrawProviderInterface implementations auto-tagged wallet.deposit_provider / wallet.withdraw_provider, collected via #[AutowireIterator] in the respective registries (voucher-type whitelist; assertPermitted() enforces per-provider permission)
  • MediaStorageInterface implementations tagged media.storage, collected via #[AutowireIterator]; LocalStorage/QiniuStorage are explicitly wired in src/Storage/Resources/config/services_storage.yaml because they need scalar/config/repository constructor arguments
  • PriceCalculatorInterface implementations auto-tagged trade.price_calculator, sorted by getPriority() — pipeline: BasePriceCalculator(-100) → QuantityCalculator(50) → TotalAggregator(55) (establishes subtotal) → PromotionCalculator(60) (applies order-level adjustments on the real subtotal)
  • PromotionCalculator (App\Promotion\Service\PromotionCalculator) implements PriceCalculatorInterface, tagged trade.price_calculator at priority 60, applies promotions after the subtotal is aggregated
  • Promotion strategies auto-tagged promotion.strategy via _instanceof rule, collected by #[AutowireIterator] in the strategy registry
  • WechatService explicitly defined in services_wechat.yaml with %env() parameter bindings
  • WechatPayGateway explicitly defined in services_wechat.yaml (excluded from global autowiring scan)
  • WalletGateway autowired in Wallet via PaymentGatewayInterface tag (no explicit exclusion needed)
  • AuthorizationVoter auto-tagged security.voter; AuthorizationResourceRegistry hardened with default common:content registry

docs.title: 22.1 Overview
docs.text:
The Inventory bundle (src/Inventory/) owns materials, per-store stock, Specification recipes, reservations, and the stock ledger. It implements the deferred reservation boundary defined in Store.

Preview safety notice: Inventory is implemented but is not production-ready. INVENTORY_ENABLED must remain 0 outside isolated development and testing until fulfillment-driven consumption, safe accepted-order expiry semantics, serialized confirmation/cancellation, and release-before-reserve handling are implemented and covered by concurrency tests. The disabled schema/module may be deployed safely.

docs.title: 22.2 Domain Model
docs.text: Entity Purpose Material Raw material or finished good. code is unique, immutably frozen upon stock mutation Stock Per-store per-material balance with onHandQuantity, reservedQuantity, allowNegativeStock flag SpecificationRecipe One active recipe per catalog Specification UUID; stores material BOM lines RecipeLine Quantity of a material required per unit of the parent Specification Reservation Idempotent reservation aggregate with status: requested, confirmed, rejected, released, consumed ReservationLine Immutable snapshot of material demand and reserved quantity per reservation LedgerEntry Append-only audit trail for every stock mutation InventoryConsumedEvent Inbox idempotency record InventoryOutboxMessage Durable integration event relay

docs.title: 22.3 Integration Flow
docs.text:
Trade order created
  → Store validates + creates StoreOrder
  → Store publishes inventory.reservation.requested.v1 (if INVENTORY_ENABLED)
  → Inventory resolves recipe or direct finished material
  → Inventory reserves stock atomically (checks allowNegativeStock per stock)
  → Inventory publishes confirmed or rejected outcome
  → Store accepts (confirmed) or rejects (rejected) StoreOrder
  → Store publishes store.order.accepted.v1 or store.order.rejected.v1
  → Trade applies workflow transition

docs.title: 22.4 Reservation Processing
docs.text: Recipes expand a Specification into material demand. Material demand is aggregated (same material from multiple specifications merged), then locked in deterministic Material UUID order. Each stock's allowNegativeStock flag controls whether reservation exceeds on-hand quantity. Reservation lines capture immutable material and quantity snapshots.

docs.title: 22.5 Compensation & Expiry
docs.text:
• Cancellation triggers release via Store -> Inventory release event
  • Expired confirmed reservations are released by app:inventory:reservations:release-expired (scheduler)
  • Release is idempotent; repeated release of same reservation is no-op

docs.title: 22.6 Management APIs
docs.text: Method Path Role Purpose GET/POST/PUT /api/v1/manage/inventory/materials ROLE_ADMIN Material master GET/POST/PUT /api/v1/manage/inventory/recipes ROLE_ADMIN Specification recipe GET /api/v1/manage/inventory/stocks/{storeUuid}/{materialUuid} ROLE_ADMIN Stock view (virtual zero if absent) POST /api/v1/manage/inventory/stocks/{storeUuid}/{materialUuid}/adjust ROLE_ADMIN Stock adjustment PUT /api/v1/manage/inventory/stocks/{storeUuid}/{materialUuid}/policy ROLE_ADMIN Toggle allowNegativeStock

docs.title: 22.7 Store Integration Changes
docs.text:
• TradeOrderCreatedHandler: when INVENTORY_ENABLED, creates reservationId and writes awaiting_inventory state + reservation request outbox
  • New handlers: ReservationConfirmedHandler, ReservationRejectedHandler, ReservationReleasedHandler
  • TradeOrderCancelledHandler: requests inventory release for cancelled orders with reservation
  • StoreTradeOrderCancellation tombstone entity: handles out-of-order cancellation events
  • Trade events use OrderItem.uuid as stable lineId (not specification UUID)

docs.title: 23. Production Readiness & Known Defects
docs.text: Source of truth: docs/issues/coverage-2026-08-09/README.md (74 bugs with file:line + proposed fixes) and docs/issues/test-audit-2026-08-09/README.md (412 redundant-test candidates). Do not re-discover these; fix or reference them.

docs.title: 23.1 Status summary (2026-08-09)
docs.text:
• Engineering maturity is high (module boundaries, PHPStan L8, 99.46% line coverage, dual-DB CI). Production-readiness is medium: deployment orchestration exists, but observability, rate limiting, and external-provider certification are missing, and a batch of known src/ bugs are unfixed.
  • Blocked for production until fixed (CRITICAL):
  • src/Core/Utils/RsaClient.php:51,99 signs with MD5 (forgeable, fails FIPS) — should be OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256.
  • src/Core/Utils/Location.php depends on php-curl-class, which is not installed — every call fatals Class "Curl\Curl" not found.
  • Blocked for production (HIGH, top 8):
  • src/Wechat/Service/Payment/WechatPayGateway.php:102-126 — notify never passes the request to EasyWeChat → every real WeChat Pay callback fails. Fix: setRequestFromSymfonyRequest($request) before serve().
  • src/Core/Utils/Math.php:85,91 — one-arg rand()/mt_rand() crash on PHP 8.5.
  • src/Core/Service/BaseService.php:77 + ReadListTrait:270 — $user is null for all HTTP requests → @dql/@sort/@hints 403 even for admins.
  • Payment retry deadlock: OrderService::createPayment() reuses failed/cancelled invoices → order permanently stuck in confirmed (only reuse when status ∈ {pending, paying}).
  • src/Trade/Controller/Manage/OrderController.php:329 /do/{transition} forwards raw body to update() → admin can tamper order fields, bypassing the whitelist.
  • src/Trade/MessageHandler/StoreOrderRejectedHandler.php:37 — Store rejection does not cancel the Trade order.
  • Identity controllers: unguarded json_decode(JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) → HTTP 500 on malformed bodies; numeric usernames cannot log in; CreateUserCommand persists empty email/username accounts.
  • src/Core/Controller/RestController.php:198 — @expands sets a dynamic __metadata property → PHP 8.5 deprecation (breaks failOnDeprecation).
  • Not production-ready by design: Inventory (§22.1) — INVENTORY_ENABLED must stay 0 outside isolated dev/test until consumption, expiry, serialized confirmation, and release-before-reserve handling are concurrency-tested.

docs.title: 23.2 Operational gaps (productization)
docs.text:
Closed in 2026-08-10 (see §24):

  • ✅ Health checks: /health/live + /health/ready (public, outside JWT firewall); nginx container healthcheck in compose.yaml uses /health/ready.
  • ✅ Rate limiting: symfony/rate-limiter — per-IP limits on login/register/OTP request/verify/WeChat login/payment initiation; 429 envelope + Retry-After; disabled (high limits) in test env.
  • ✅ Metrics: /metrics Prometheus text format — per-worker request counters/duration histogram/in-flight gauge plus live DB gauges (outbox backlog per topic, failed messenger queue).

Remaining productization gaps:

  • No alerting/APM ingestion: metrics are exposed but nothing scrapes them (add Prometheus/Grafana or Sentry); no alert channels for outbox backlog or error rates.
  • No rate-limit global cache: limiters use the default filesystem cache — per-process only; enable a shared Redis cache adapter for multi-worker deployments.
  • External providers unverified: WeChat Pay, SMS (Aliyun), and Qiniu have deterministic test adapters but no real sandbox certification evidence; WechatPayGateway::notify() is broken (see 23.1).
  • Smoke scripts not in CI: scripts/tests/*.sh require a disposable Docker environment and run only at release time.
  • Test-suite debt: 186 PHPUnit Notices; 412 redundant-test candidates (190 HIGH) from the coverage campaign — safe deletions are documented in docs/issues/test-audit-2026-08-09/ (verify coverage zero-delta before each deletion).

docs.title: 23.3 Rules for AI agents
docs.text:
• Skipped tests in the suite are intentional bug documentation — do not remove or "un-skip" them; fix the underlying src/ bug first, then un-skip.
  • Before implementing a known defect, read its report entry; the report contains the exact fix.
  • New changes must follow the evidence rules in docs/testing/crud-skeleton-production/TEST_STRATEGY.md (tests at the right layer, invariants protected, coverage gate 90%).
  • When adding tests, do not recreate the redundant *CoverageTest/*AdditionalTest patterns flagged by the audit.

docs.title: 24. Platform Operations Endpoints
docs.text:
Public infrastructure endpoints (no JWT; live outside the ^/api firewall):

Endpoint Purpose Response GET /health/live Process liveness probe 200 {"status":"ok"} GET /health/ready Readiness probe: DB required, Redis optional (enabled only when OTP_REDIS_DSN set) 200 {"status":"ok","checks":{...}} or 503 degraded GET /metrics Prometheus text exposition format (v0.0.4) 200 text/plain

Implementation notes:

  • src/Core/Controller/HealthController.php — Connection + a dependency-free RESP PING over TCP for Redis (no Predis needed in prod; predis/predis is dev-only).
  • src/Core/Controller/MetricsController.php + src/Core/Metrics/MetricsRegistry.php + src/Core/EventListener/MetricsListener.php:
  • In-memory per-worker: http_requests_total{method,route,status}, http_request_duration_seconds histogram (default buckets), http_requests_inflight.
  • Live DB gauges on scrape: app_outbox_backlog{topic=trade|store|inventory} (published_at IS NULL counts) and app_messenger_failed (messenger_messages.queue_name='failed'); these are accurate across workers.
  • The listener skips /health, /metrics, /api/doc, profiler paths, and sub-requests (404s are dispatched as sub-requests here).
  • src/Core/EventListener/RateLimitListener.php (kernel.controller, priority 10) — path → limiter map, keyed by getClientIp(); on limit: replaces the controller with a 429 {data:null, code:429, message} + Retry-After. Limiters defined in config/packages/rate_limiter.yaml; factories wired via !service_locator in config/services.yaml.
  • Test wiring: HealthController is defined explicitly (scalar $otpRedisDsn) with routing.controller + controller.service_arguments tags (both in main and when@test blocks, since explicit definitions drop autoconfig tags); when@test disables the Redis probe and sets all limiter limits to 100000.
  • compose.yaml nginx healthcheck runs wget -q -O /dev/null http://localhost/health/ready (full-path readiness: nginx → FPM → Symfony → DB/Redis).
  • Both endpoints are added to NelmioApiDoc path_patterns (tag System).
  • Tests: tests/Integration/Core/Controller/HealthControllerTest.php, tests/Integration/Core/Controller/MetricsControllerTest.php, tests/Integration/Core/EventListener/RateLimitListenerTest.php (real RateLimiterFactory + InMemoryStorage, so global test limits are untouched).

docs.title: 25. Authorization Module (Phase 1)
docs.text: Bundle: src/Authorization/ — independent Authorization boundary (see docs/design/bundles/authorization.md). - Entities: Permission (code/module/resource/action), Role (global/store, isSystem), Assignment (userUuid/role/scope, soft revoke), RoleFieldGrant (resource/action→fields json), AuditLog (append-only) - Services: AuthorizationService (admin bypass, global vs store can, allowedStoreUuids, effectivePermissions via cache.app authorization_effective_* 300s + DB fallback), FieldAuthorizationService (union of grants ∩ controller accepted*Properties, strict 403), AuthorizationResourceRegistry (common:content create/update), AuthorizationAuditService, AuthorizationCacheInvalidator - Security: AuthorizationScope (global/store), ScopedResourceInterface, AuthorizationVoter (permission string + scope subject) - Seed: app:authorization:seed — 11 permissions, 3 roles (store_content_editor, store_content_metadata_editor, authorization_administrator), 4 field grants - Manage APIs (ROLE_ADMIN, ApiView mixins): GET /manage/permissions (list), GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /manage/roles + POST /{uuid}/permissions + PUT /{uuid}/field-grants/{resource}/{action}, GET/POST/DELETE /manage/assignments (idempotent grant, scope-compat, soft revoke), GET /manage/audit-logs (paginated) - App: GET /app/authorization/me — effective permissions/storeScopes/fieldGrants for current user - Content pilot: common_content.store_uuid nullable indexed + metadata json; Common/Controller/Store/ContentController at POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /store/{storeUuid}/contents enforces Membership.isActive + common:content:* via AuthorizationScope::store + FieldAuthorizationService (metadata_editor vs editor); Common/Controller/Manage/ContentController now allows metadata in accepted*Properties - DqlExpression: src/Core/Query/DqlExpression + ExpressionDqlParser in/not in (array-bound, 1=0/1=1 for empty) used as readable row-scope primitive for future Authorization scopes

docs.title: API设计合约
docs.text: 统一响应格式、URL 约定、HTTP 方法语义、身份验证、分页和查询参数。 每个 API 端点必须遵守此合同。

docs.title: 1.统一响应包络
docs.text:
每个 API 响应都将数据包装在标准化信封中：

{
  "data": {},
  "code": 200,
  "message": "SUCCESS",
  "paginator": {}
}

docs.title: 1.1 字段
docs.text: 领域 类型 当存在时 描述 data 任何 永远 响应负载（对象、数组、null 或标量） code 整数 永远 HTTP 状态代码（镜像响应状态） message 字符串 永远 人类可读的状态（成功）或错误描述（警告） paginator 对象 分页时 分页元数据（当前页、总页数、总项目数、每页）

docs.title: 1.2 成功响应
docs.text:
由 RestController::success($data, $message, $status) 生成：

{
  "data": { "id": 1, "title": "..." },
  "code": 200,
  "message": "SUCCESS"
}
场景 状态 留言 获取列表/详细信息 200 200 “成功” 发布创建 201 201 “成功” 放置更新 200 200 “成功” 删除 删除 204 204 “成功”

docs.title: 1.3 错误响应
docs.text:
由 RestController::warning($error_msg, $error_code, $raw_data, $status) 生成：

{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Validation failed: email is required",
  "data": ""
}
场景 状态 验证错误 400 没有找到 404 认证失败 401 授权失败 403 服务器错误 500

docs.title: 1.4 分页器对象
docs.text:
{
  "paginator": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20,
    "pages": 5,
    "total": 100
  }
}

docs.title: 2.1 基本前缀
docs.text: 范围 前缀 认证 /api/auth 业务 API（公共） /api/v1/app 业务 API（管理员） /api/v1/manage 文档 /api/doc

docs.title: 2.2 资源命名
docs.text: 大会 示例 理由 小写，连字符 /api/v1/manage/order-items 可读的网址 复数名词 /categories 不是 /category 一致的休息 没有尾部斜杠 /categories/{id} 干净的网址 基本 URL 中没有动词 通过 POST /categories 创建 HTTP 方法语义 路径中的 ID /{id} 其中 id 是 \d+ 直接资源访问 子资源 /orders/{id}/items 关系范围

docs.title: 3. HTTP 方法语义
docs.text: 方法 增删改查 幂等 身体 路径 ID 获取 阅读（合集） 是的 没有 没有 获取 阅读（详细） 是的 没有 是的 发布 创建 没有 是的 没有 放置 更新（完全替换） 是的 是的 是的 删除 删除 是的 没有 是的

docs.title: 3.1 岗位专业化
docs.text: 变体 路径 身体 目的 创建单 POST / {} 单一实体创建 创建批次 POST / [{}, {}, ...] 一笔交易中的多个实体 批量更新插入 POST /batch-update [{}, {}, ...] 与 @basis + @mode=mixed 幂等批量同步 单例更新插入 PUT / {} 单行资源（获取或创建）

docs.title: 4.1 令牌格式
docs.text:
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
  • 访问令牌：RS256 JWT、7200s TTL（默认）
  • 刷新令牌：不透明的 HMAC-SHA256 哈希，存储在服务器端，1 年 TTL

docs.title: 4.2 公共端点（无需身份验证）
docs.text: 端点 方法 /api/auth/login 发布 /api/auth/otp/request 发布 /api/auth/otp/verify 发布 /api/auth/token/refresh 发布 /api/auth/logout 发布 /api/doc、/api/doc.json 获取

docs.title: 4.3 角色层次结构
docs.text:
ROLE_USER
  |-- ROLE_ADMIN
  • Public /api/v1/app/*：不需要角色（可以是只读）
  • 管理员/api/v1/manage/*：需要ROLE_ADMIN

docs.title: 5.1 列出端点参数(GET /)
docs.text: 参数 类型 描述 page 整数 页码（从 1 开始） limit 整数 每页项目 @filter 字符串 基于表达式的 WHERE 条件 @dql 字符串 原始 DQL WHERE 子条款 @order 字符串 以逗号分隔 field|ASC 或 field|DESC @select 字符串 DQL SELECT 子句覆盖 @groupBy 字符串 DQL 分组依据 @hints 字符串 教义查询提示 @sort 字符串 内存中排序表达式（后备） @expands 字符串 逗号分隔的嵌套实体扩展 @display 字符串 场投影模式（complex、reduce 或表达式） @showDQL 布尔 调试模式：返回已编译的 DQL 作为响应

docs.title: 5.2 创建/更新参数
docs.text: 参数 方法 类型 描述 @partial 发布、放置 布尔 非事务模式（跳过失败的项目） @transform 发布、放置 字符串 基于表达式的字段值转换 @mode POST（批量更新） 字符串 mixed（更新插入），strict（仅更新） @basis POST（批量更新） 字符串 用于 upsert

docs.title: 5.3 表达式语法 (@filter / @sort / @transform)
docs.text:
操作员 意义 示例 == 平等 entity.status == "active" != 不等于 entity.price != 0 > 大于 entity.age > 18 < 小于 entity.price < 100 >= 大于或等于 entity.count >= 5 <= 小于或等于 entity.rating <= 4.5 && 逻辑与 a == 1 && b == 2 \|\| 逻辑或 a == 1 \|\| b == 2 ! 逻辑非 !entity.deleted matches 文字子字符串或 /regex/flags 匹配 entity.title matches "paper"、entity.title matches "/^paper.*/i" 链接属性 属性遍历 entity.getCategory().getName()

普通的 matches 值在编译为 contains 样式的 LIKE 之前会被转义。 正则表达式文字支持 i、m、s 和 x； g 和 u 被接受，但没有 数据库副作用。未知的正则表达式标志被拒绝。

docs.title: 5.4 表达式函数（在表达式中可用）
docs.text: 命名空间 功能 Math abs、ceil、floor、round、max、min、add、sub、mul、div、mod、pow、sqrt ArrayCommon in_array、count、merge、push、key_exist、filter、map、reduce Datetime get($time, $timezone) -- 返回日期时间

docs.title: 6. 内容类型和请求正文
docs.text:
方向 内容类型 请求 application/json 回应 application/json
  • 请求正文必须是有效的 JSON
  • 无效的 JSON 返回 400 { message: "Invalid JSON" }

docs.title: 7.OpenAPI 文档
docs.text:
• 每个端点必须携带 NelmioApiDocBundle 的 #[OA\*] 属性
  • Swagger UI：/api/doc
  • OpenAPI JSON：/api/doc.json
  • 属性必须包括：方法标签、参数（带类型）、响应模式、请求主体模式

docs.title: 7.1 每个端点所需的属性
docs.text: 行动 属性 列表 #[OA\Get] 记录了所有查询参数 详情 #[OA\Get] 与 @expands 参数 创建 #[OA\Post] 与 @partial、@transform 参数、请求正文架构 更新 #[OA\Put] 与 @transform 参数，请求正文架构 删除 #[OA\Delete] 带有响应描述 批量更新 #[OA\Post] 与 @mode、@basis、@partial、@transform、请求正文架构 工作流程 #[OA\Get] / #[OA\Post] / #[OA\Put] 匹配动作

docs.title: 8.1 实体序列化
docs.text:
• 循环引用解析为{ "id": N, "__toString": "...", "__metadata": {} }
  • DateTime 字段序列化为 ISO 8601 字符串
  • JSON 字段自动从字符串解析为对象/数组
  • 条令代理/内部字段被剥离

docs.title: 8.2 字段选择 (@display)
docs.text: 模式 行为 complex 利用元数据进行深度扩展 reduce 浅薄，仅ID+toString用于关系 表达 通过表达式语法自定义字段映射 （无） 平坦归一化（默认）

docs.title: 8.3 嵌套扩展 (@expands)
docs.text:
示例：@expands=category,tags

折叠的实体关系通过 __metadata 扩展为嵌套对象。

docs.title: API文档合约
docs.text: /api/doc 是如何工作的，如何扩展它，以及每个新端点必须遵循的规则。

docs.title: 1. 架构
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    A["Controller #[OA\*] attributes"] --> B["swagger-php (zircote)"]
    B -->|"generates raw OpenAPI paths + generic tags"| C["NelmioApiDocBundle"]
    C -->|"merges config/packages/nelmio_api_doc.yaml<br/>(schemas, security, info)"| D["OpenApiEnricherListener"]
    D -->|"kernel.response event<br/>overrides tags, summaries, descriptions"| E["/api/doc (Swagger UI)<br/>/api/doc.json (raw JSON)"]

docs.title: 2. 单文件丰富器
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/EventListener/OpenApiEnricherListener.php

所有 API 文档丰富内容都位于一个文件中。无需更改控制器。

docs.title: 2.1 标签检测（detectTag()）
docs.text:
从路由的 operationId 中提取模块标签：

操作 ID 模式 标签 sys-auth-* 授权 manage-products-*、app-products-* 产品 manage-orders-*、app-orders-* 订单 manage-categories-*、app-categories-* 类别 manage-tags-*、app-tags-* 标签 manage-contents-*、app-contents-* 内容 manage-comments-*、app-comments-* 评论 manage-pages-*、app-pages-* 页数 manage-media-*、app-media-* 媒体 manage-settings-*、app-settings-* 设置 manage-wallets-*、manage-transactions-* 钱包 任何其他 manage-{X}-* 或 app-{X}-* {X}（自动标题大小写）

docs.title: 2.2 摘要/描述覆盖 (META)
docs.text:
META 常量提供关键端点的可选摘要和描述。如果端点不在 META 中，它仍然会获取正确的标记，但使用 #[OA\*] 属性中的默认摘要。

示例： 

'/api/v1/manage/orders/{id}/pay' => [
    'summary' => ['post' => 'Pay for order (wallet)'],
    'desc' => ['post' => 'User wallet → system wallet. Sets paidAt. Order must be confirmed.'],
],

docs.title: 2.3 添加新模块
docs.text:
1. 路由命名：使用manage-{resource}-{action}或app-{resource}-{action}约定
  2. 自动检测：资源名称自动标题大小写为标签
  3. 可选：添加到 detectTag() 中的 $known 映射以获取自定义显示名称： 
    'notification' => 'Notifications', 'notifications' => 'Notifications',
  4. 可选：向 META 添加关键端点的摘要/描述

docs.title: 3. 模式定义
docs.text:
文件：config/packages/nelmio_api_doc.yaml

实体模式在 documentation.components.schemas 下定义。每个架构都提供 Swagger UI 中可见的字段级类型、描述、枚举和示例值。

当前架构：订单、订单项、产品、规格、类别、标签、内容、评论、页面、媒体、设置、钱包、交易、TransferRequest、LoginResponse、UserRef。

docs.title: 3.1 添加新架构
docs.text:
components:
    schemas:
        NewEntity:
            type: object
            properties:
                id: { type: integer }
                name: { type: string, example: 'Example' }
                status: { type: string, enum: [active, inactive] }

docs.title: 4. 控制器属性要求
docs.text:
每个端点必须具有 OpenAPI 属性。 View 特征（ListApiViewMixin 等）已经提供了它们。自定义端点需要显式属性：

#[OA\Post(
    path: '/api/v1/manage/resource/custom-action',
    summary: 'Custom action description',
    requestBody: new OA\RequestBody(
        required: true,
        content: new OA\JsonContent(properties: [
            new OA\Property(property: 'field', type: 'string', example: 'value'),
        ])
    ),
    responses: [
        new OA\Response(response: 200, description: 'Success'),
    ]
)]
#[Route('/resource/custom-action', name: 'manage-resource-custom', methods: ['POST'])]
public function customAction(): Response { ... }

路由命名至关重要 — name: 前缀决定了 operationId，而 operationId 又决定了模块标签： - manage-products-custom → operationId: post_manage-products-custom → 标签：产品 - app-orders-export → operationId: get_app-orders-export → 标签：订单

docs.title: 5. 安全文档
docs.text:
承载 JWT 身份验证是全局配置的：

components:
    securitySchemes:
        bearerAuth:
            type: http
            scheme: bearer
            bearerFormat: JWT

公共端点（无需身份验证）使用 security: [] 覆盖每个路径。

docs.title: 6. 响应格式
docs.text:
所有端点返回统一的信封。这在 OpenAPI info.description 中有记录：

{
    "data": {},
    "code": 200,
    "message": "SUCCESS",
    "paginator": null
}

适用时的分页元数据： 

{
    "paginator": {
        "page": 1,
        "limit": 20,
        "pages": 5,
        "total": 100
    }
}

docs.title: 7. 动态查询参数
docs.text:
列表端点支持这些查询参数（记录在 ListApiViewMixin 中）：

参数 类型 描述 page 整数 页码（从 1 开始） limit 整数 每页项目 @filter 字符串 表达式 WHERE（例如 entity.status == "active"） @dql 字符串 原始 DQL 子查询 @order 字符串 排序：field\|ASC 或 field\|DESC @select 字符串 DQL SELECT 覆盖 @sort 字符串 内存中排序表达式 @expands 字符串 嵌套实体扩展 @display 字符串 场投影模式

docs.title: 8. 验证
docs.text:
# Check generated JSON
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/doc.json | python3 -m json.tool | head -50

# Check embedded HTML spec
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/doc | grep -o '"tags":\[.*\]' | head -1

# Count tags
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/doc.json | python3 -c "
import sys,json;from collections import Counter
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
tc=Counter()
for p,ms in d['paths'].items():
    for m,op in ms.items():
        if isinstance(op,dict): tc.update(op.get('tags',[]))
for t in sorted(tc): print(f'  {t}: {tc[t]}')
"

docs.title: 控制器设计合约
docs.text: 控制器层遵循 组合优于继承 模式，使用 PHP 特征作为“混合”契约。 这与 farm-neighbor (src/LamProject/CoreBundle/View/) 使用的合约完全相同。 控制器通过 use-ing 特征而不是通过深层类层次结构来组合行为（列表、详细信息、创建、更新、删除、工作流）。

docs.title: 1. 核心原理
docs.text:
Controller = RestController (base)
           + ApiView (service binding + common filter)
           + [ListApiViewMixin | DetailApiViewMixin | CreateApiViewMixin | ...]
           + Business-specific hook overrides

每个控制器都是通过组装特征来构建的，而不是通过扩展单一的 CRUD 基类来构建。

docs.title: 2. Trait Catalog（控制器合约工具包）
2.1 强制：ApiView
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/ApiView.php 必须由使用：每个控制器

声明服务绑定和数据范围的契约：

trait ApiView
{
    protected ?string $serviceClass = null;  // REQUIRED: set in controller

    protected function commonFilter()         // OVERRIDE: scope data
    {
        return [];  // return array criteria OR QueryBuilder
    }
}

合同： - 控制器必须将 $serviceClass 设置为相应服务的 FQCN - 控制器应该覆盖 commonFilter() 以应用所有权/范围过滤器 - commonFilter() 返回：(a) 标准关联数组，或 (b) QueryBuilder 实例

docs.title: 2.2 列表：ListApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/ListApiViewMixin.php

注册 GET / 并提供分页列表端点：

路线 方法 行动 GET / 列表动作 具有动态查询的分页集合

挂钩方法（可重写）：

钩 签名 当被呼叫时 目的 listFilter($filter) protected 在 service.list() 之前修改过滤条件 listProcessor($entities) protected 在 service.list() 之后转换结果集 listResponses($entities) protected JSON 序列化之前 最终反应塑造

OpenAPI 参数（已记录）： page、limit、@order、@dql、@select、@groupBy、@hints、@filter、@sort、@expands、@display、@showDQL

docs.title: 2.3 详细信息：DetailApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/DetailApiViewMixin.php

寄存器GET /{id}（需要数字ID）：

路线 方法 行动 GET /{id} 详细动作 按 ID 的单个实体

挂钩方法：

钩 签名 当被呼叫时 目的 detailFilter($filter) protected 在 mixIdToCommonFilter 之后，在 get 之前修改查找条件 detailProcessor($entity) protected 在 service.get() 之后 改造实体 detailResponse($entity) protected JSON 序列化之前 塑造反应

docs.title: 2.4 创建：CreateApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/CreateApiViewMixin.php

注册 POST / 以支持单个对象和数组输入：

路线 方法 行动 POST / 创建动作 创建单个或批量实体

查询参数：@partial（非事务性）、@transform（表达式转换器）

属性 控制器可以声明：

物业 类型 目的 $requiredCreateProperties string[] 输入中必须出现的字段 $acceptedCreateProperties string[] 输入

挂钩方法：

钩 签名 当被呼叫时 目的 defaultCreateValues() protected 加工前 提供默认值 processCreateContent(array $content, $entity) protected 变换后、保存前 修改/验证内容 processEntity($content, $entity) protected new() 之后，更新之前 修改新实体 afterCreated($entity) protected 保存成功后 创建后挂钩

输入模式： - 单个对象{}：直接返回创建的实体 - 数组[{}, {}, ...]：返回已创建实体的数组，包装在事务中（除非@partial=true）

docs.title: 2.5 更新：UpdateApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/UpdateApiViewMixin.php

注册两条路由：

路线 方法 行动 PUT /{id} 更新操作 单一实体更新 POST /batch-update 批量更新操作 批量更新插入（创建或更新）

查询参数：@mode=mixed|strict、@basis=field1,field2、@partial、@transform

属性 控制器可以声明：

物业 类型 目的 $requiredUpdateProperties string[] 更新输入中必须存在的字段 $acceptedUpdateProperties string[] 更新输入中可能存在的字段

挂钩方法（更新路径）：

钩 签名 当被呼叫时 目的 defaultUpdateValues() protected 加工前 提供更新的默认值 processUpdateContent(array $content, $entity) protected 变换后、保存前 修改/验证更新内容 afterUpdated($entity) protected 保存成功后 更新后挂钩

兼容性挂钩（默认情况下委托更新挂钩 - 仅在需要时覆盖）：

钩 默认代表 defaultValues() 如果没有特定的覆盖，则由创建和更新使用 processContent($content, $entity) 如果没有特定的覆盖，则由创建和更新使用 after($entity) 如果没有特定的覆盖，则由创建和更新使用

批量更新插入逻辑（POST /batch-update 和 @mode=mixed）： 1. 对于数组中的每个项目，尝试通过 @basis 字段查找现有实体 2. 如果找到：update() (MODE_UPDATE) 3. 如果没有找到：new() + update() (MODE_CREATE) 4. 使用@mode=strict：跳过不存在的项目（仅更新）

docs.title: 2.6 删除：DeleteApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/DeleteApiViewMixin.php

寄存器DELETE /{id}：

路线 方法 行动 DELETE /{id} 删除操作 删除实体

挂钩方法：

钩 签名 当被呼叫时 目的 deletionFilter($filter) protected 查找前 添加范围以防止未经授权的删除

docs.title: 2.7 单例：SingleCreateAndUpdateApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/SingleCreateAndUpdateApiViewMixin.php

对于每个范围只有一行的资源（例如，用户设置）：

路线 方法 行动 PUT / 更新操作 获取或创建单例，然后更新

挂钩方法：defaultCreateValues()、defaultUpdateValues()

docs.title: 2.8 单例详细信息：SingleDetailApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/SingleDetailApiViewMixin.php

路线 方法 行动 GET / 详细动作 获取单个资源（无 ID）

使用 commonFilter() 来标识哪一行。

docs.title: 2.9 工作流程：WorkflowApiViewMixin
docs.text:
文件：src/Core/View/WorkflowApiViewMixin.php

对于 Symfony Workflow 状态机管理的实体：

路线 方法 行动 GET /todo 待办事项行动 列出具有可用转换的实体 GET /{id}/transitions 可用的TransitionsAction 获取实体的启用转换 POST /{id}/do/{transition} 执行转换操作 执行工作流程转换 PUT /{id}/status-reset 重置标记操作 重置状态机标记（仅限管理员）

属性控制器必须声明： - protected $workflow; -- 工作流服务 ID（例如 'state_machine.order'）

docs.title: 3.1 标准管理 CRUD 控制器
docs.text:
#[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')]
class CategoryController extends RestController
{
    use ApiView;
    use ListApiViewMixin;
    use DetailApiViewMixin;
    use CreateApiViewMixin;
    use UpdateApiViewMixin;
    use DeleteApiViewMixin;

    protected ?string $serviceClass = CategoryService::class;

    protected array $requiredCreateProperties = ['name'];
    protected array $acceptedCreateProperties = ['name', 'slug', 'description', 'parent', 'enabled'];
    protected array $acceptedUpdateProperties = ['name', 'slug', 'description', 'parent', 'enabled', 'sortOrder'];
}

docs.title: 3.2 公共只读控制器
docs.text:
class CategoryController extends RestController
{
    use ApiView;
    use ListApiViewMixin;
    use DetailApiViewMixin;

    protected ?string $serviceClass = CategoryService::class;

    protected function commonFilter()
    {
        return ['enabled' => true];  // Only show enabled categories
    }
}

docs.title: 3.3 自定义业务逻辑控制器（超越 CRUD）
docs.text:
当控制器需要 mixins 未涵盖的端点时，请添加自定义操作方法：

class OrderController extends RestController
{
    use ApiView;
    use ListApiViewMixin;
    use DetailApiViewMixin;

    protected ?string $serviceClass = OrderService::class;

    #[Route('/my-orders', name: 'my-orders', methods: ['GET'])]
    public function myOrdersAction(): Response
    {
        $service = $this->get($this->serviceClass);
        $filter = $this->commonFilter();  // scopes to current user
        $entities = $service->list($filter);
        return $this->success($entities);
    }
}

docs.title: 3.4 支持工作流的控制器
docs.text:
#[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')]
class OrderController extends RestController
{
    use ApiView;
    use ListApiViewMixin;
    use DetailApiViewMixin;
    use UpdateApiViewMixin;           // For updating draft orders
    use WorkflowApiViewMixin;         // For state transitions

    protected ?string $serviceClass = OrderService::class;
    protected $workflow = 'state_machine.order';

    protected array $acceptedUpdateProperties = ['notes', 'metadata'];
}

docs.title: 4.1 获取列表管道
docs.text:
commonFilter()
  -> listFilter()
    -> service.list(filter)
      -> listProcessor(entities)
        -> listResponses(entities)
          -> success(response)

docs.title: 4.2 获取详细信息管道
docs.text:
commonFilter()
  -> mixIdToCommonFilter(id)
    -> detailFilter(filter)
      -> service.get(filter)
        -> detailProcessor(entity)
          -> detailResponse(entity)
            -> success(response)

docs.title: 4.3 POST 创建管道
docs.text:
json_decode(content)
  -> check input type (object vs array)
    -> service.new()
      -> requiredCreateProperties check
        -> acceptedCreateProperties filter
          -> defaultCreateValues()
            -> @transform (expression)
              -> processCreateContent(content, entity)
                -> processEntity(content, entity)
                  -> service.update(entity, content)
                    -> afterCreated(entity)
                      -> success(response)

docs.title: 4.4 PUT 更新管道
docs.text:
json_decode(content)
  -> mixIdToCommonFilter(id)
    -> service.get(filter)
      -> requiredUpdateProperties check
        -> acceptedUpdateProperties filter
          -> defaultUpdateValues()
            -> @transform (expression)
              -> processUpdateContent(content, entity)
                -> service.update(entity, content)
                  -> afterUpdated(entity)
                    -> success(response)

docs.title: 4.5 删除管道
docs.text:
mixIdToCommonFilter(id)
  -> deletionFilter(filter)
    -> service.get(filter)
      -> service.remove(entity)
        -> success(...) | warning(...)

docs.title: 5.1 必须规则
docs.text: ＃ 规则 R1 控制器必须扩展 RestController R2 控制器必须 use ApiView 特征 R3 控制器必须设置 protected ?string $serviceClass R4 应用程序（公共）控制器不得使用创建/更新/删除混合 R5 管理（admin）控制器必须由 #[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')] R6 管理 CRUD 控制器必须声明 $requiredCreateProperties 和 $acceptedCreateProperties R7 每个公共操作都必须具有 #[OA\*] OpenAPI 属性 R8 控制器不得直接调用 EntityManager R9 控制器不得直接调用存储库 R10 所有业务逻辑必须经过服务层

docs.title: 5.2 应该规则
docs.text: ＃ 规则 S1 应用程序控制器应该覆盖 commonFilter() 以范围数据 S2 自定义验证应该放在 processCreateContent() / processUpdateContent() 挂钩中 S3 保存后副作用应该进入 afterCreated() / afterUpdated() 钩子 S4 删除应通过 deletionFilter() 或 commonFilter() 验证所有权

docs.title: 5.3 不得制定规则
docs.text: ＃ 规则 N1 不得将 EntityManager 注入控制器 氮气 不得将业务逻辑放入钩子方法中（委托给服务） N3 不得绕过标准 CRUD 操作的 serviceClass 绑定 N4 不得使用 $_GET、$_POST、$_REQUEST 超全局变量（使用 Request 对象） N5 不得修改 mixin 特征文件以满足特定于模块的需求（而是覆盖钩子）

docs.title: 6. 与农场邻居的比较
docs.text:
该合同与农场邻居的合同结构相同：

方面 农场邻居 粗骨架 基类 LamProject\CoreBundle\Controller\RestController App\Core\Controller\RestController 混音地点 LamProject\CoreBundle\View\ App\Core\View\ 性状名称 相同（ListApiViewMixin、CreateApiViewMixin 等） 相同的名字 钩子方法签名 相同 相同 服务绑定 $serviceClass $serviceClass 字段白名单 $requiredCreateProperties等 相同 @ 查询语法 相同的表达引擎 相同 混合批量更新插入 @mode=mixed + @basis 相同

差异很小（命名空间、Symfony 版本 3.4→8.1、注释→属性），但合约语义是相同的。

docs.title: 数据模型设计合约
docs.text: 抽象实体约定、属性要求、关系模式、生命周期挂钩和字段规则。 每个学说实体必须遵守本合同。

docs.title: 1. 实体基础合约
docs.text:
每个实体必须具备：

元素 要求 命名空间 App\{Module}\Entity PHP 8 属性 #[ORM\Entity]、#[ORM\Table]、#[ORM\HasLifecycleCallbacks] 主键 $id（int，自动递增） 创建时间戳 $createdAt（日期时间不可变） 更新时间戳 $updatedAt（日期时间不可变） __toString() 方法 返回人类可读的标识符 
#[ORM\Entity(repositoryClass: XxxRepository::class)]
#[ORM\Table(name: 'module_table_name')]
#[ORM\HasLifecycleCallbacks]
class Xxx
{
    #[ORM\Id]
    #[ORM\GeneratedValue]
    #[ORM\Column]
    private ?int $id = null;

    #[ORM\Column]
    private ?\DateTimeImmutable $createdAt = null;

    #[ORM\Column]
    private ?\DateTimeImmutable $updatedAt = null;

    public function __toString(): string { return (string)$this->id; }

    #[ORM\PrePersist]
    public function touch(): void
    {
        $this->createdAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
        $this->updatedAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
    }
}

docs.title: 2.1 表名
docs.text: 规则 示例 小写，下划线分隔 common_category 模块前缀 common_*、trade_*、payment_*、wallet_*、identity_* 单数名词 wallet 不是 wallets 连接表 {left}_{right}（例如，common_content_tag）

docs.title: 2.2 列名
docs.text: 规则 示例 PHP 中的驼峰命名法 sortOrder、createdAt 数据库中的snake_case sort_order、created_at 外键列 {entity}_id（例如，category_id） 布尔列 动词或形容词（例如 is_deleted、enabled） 状态栏 名词（例如，status） 时间戳列 *_at 后缀（例如 expires_at、completed_at）

docs.title: 2.3 PHP 中的属性命名
docs.text: 规则 示例 驼峰式 $createdAt、$sortOrder 布尔值获取器 isEnabled()、isDeleted() 集合属性 复数名词（例如，$tags、$items） 关系属性 单数表示 M:1/O:O ($category)，复数表示 1:M/M:M ($items)

docs.title: 3.1 标量类型
docs.text: PHP 类型 学说类型 数据库类型 使用案例 ?int integer INT ID、计数器、排序顺序 int bigint 大智 金额（分） ?string string VARCHAR(n) VARCHAR(n) string text 文本 正文内容、描述 bool boolean TINYINT(1) 标志、状态切换 ?float decimal 小数(p,s) 如果需要小数钱 array json JSON 元数据、配置、快照

docs.title: 3.2 日期时间类型
docs.text:
PHP 类型 学说类型 数据库类型 使用案例 ?\DateTimeImmutable datetime_immutable 日期时间 所有时间戳

规则：始终使用 DateTimeImmutable，切勿使用 DateTime。

docs.title: 3.3 整体金额（美分合约）
docs.text: 规则 详情 存储类型 bigint（整数分） PHP 属性类型 int 外部API 十进制（例如，20.00） 写入时转换 * 100 读取时转换 / 100 转换机制 @transform表达或服务方法

docs.title: 4.1 属性要求
docs.text: 每个关系都必须声明： - targetEntity (FQCN) - inversedBy / mappedBy（双向） - cascade策略（显式） - fetch策略（显式，默认LAZY可接受）

docs.title: 4.2 关系基数
docs.text: 类型 PHP 属性 拥有方 数据库专栏 多对一 #[ORM\ManyToOne] 当前实体（此处为FK） FK专栏 一对多 #[ORM\OneToMany] 对面 无列 (mappedBy) 多对多 #[ORM\ManyToMany] 任一侧 连接表 一对一 #[ORM\OneToOne] 当前实体（此处为FK） FK + 独特

docs.title: 4.3 自引用关系
docs.text: 图案 示例 属性 树/父 类别 -> 家长/孩子 ManyToOne(targetEntity: self::class)、OneToMany(mappedBy: 'parent') 邻接 评论 -> 家长/回复 ManyToOne(targetEntity: self::class)、OneToMany(mappedBy: 'parent')

docs.title: 5.1 强制
docs.text: 元素 要求 主键 单个自增整数 id 外键 所有 FK 列必须有显式索引 独特的约束 关于自然键（slug、电子邮件、电话、用户名、referenceId）

docs.title: 5.2 可选（性能）
docs.text: 图案 何时添加 综合指数 (entity_id, status) 上的频繁查询过滤 全文索引 body/title 上的内容搜索 状态索引 频繁的WHERE status = ?查询

docs.title: 6.1 所需的生命周期回调
docs.text: 回拨 方法 目的 #[ORM\PrePersist] touch() 设置 createdAt 和 updatedAt

docs.title: 6.2 可选的生命周期回调
docs.text: 回拨 使用案例 #[ORM\PreUpdate] 更新 updatedAt 修改 #[ORM\PrePersist] 计算派生字段（例如，price = unitPrice * quantity） #[ORM\PrePersist] 保存实体快照（例如，productSnapshot）

docs.title: 7.1 用于外部和跨境身份的 UUID
docs.text:
实体为本地 Doctrine 关系、连接和连接保留整数自动增量 id 存储效率。 UUID 是一个独立的、稳定的身份，用于离开其实体的实体 有界上下文。

当实体属于以下任一情况时，它必须具有 UUID：

  • 可通过公共 API、URL、Webhook 或第三方集成进行寻址。
  • 包含在跨模块或跨服务事件负载中。
  • 域聚合，稍后可能会移动到自己的数据库/服务。
  • 由幂等性、审计、支付、库存或外部关联流引用。

纯粹的内部实现记录不需要单独的实体 UUID。示例 包括私有连接表或已由其唯一标识的收件箱记录 传入eventId。通过 API 公开的独立管理关系应该 仍然收到 UUID。

Local database key / Doctrine relation: integer id
Public API path and response identity: uuid
Cross-module/service reference: uuid or immutable business key
Event aggregateId, sourceId, correlationId: uuid

新的跨界实体使用规范的 UUID 字符串和整数 id：

#[ORM\Column(type: 'string', length: 36, unique: true)]
private string $uuid;

public function __construct() {
    $this->uuid = UUID::v4();
}

UUID 不是授权机制。每次查找仍然需要行级 授权和所有权检查。

docs.title: 7.1.1 UUID 版本策略
docs.text:
• 使用 UUID v4 的现有实体保留其当前标识符；迁移不得 重写标识符仅仅是为了版本统一。
  • 一旦共享 UUID 实用程序支持，新的跨服务聚合应该使用 UUID v7 它，因为时间排序提高了索引局部性。
  • 在 UUID v7 可用之前，UUID v4 对于新实体和事件是可接受的。
  • UUID 格式和版本是外部 UUID 字符串背后的实现细节 合同。消费者不得从 UUID 字节推断业务含义。

docs.title: 7.2 软删除
docs.text:
#[ORM\Column]
private bool $isDeleted = false;

使用时间：实体永远不应该被硬删除（审计跟踪、法律要求）。

结果：所有查询必须过滤 isDeleted = false （通过控制器中的 commonFilter()）。

docs.title: 7.3 价值快照
docs.text:
当一个实体捕获另一个实体状态的时间点副本时：

#[ORM\Column(type: 'json', nullable: true)]
private ?array $snapshot = null;

在创建时填充（在 #[ORM\PrePersist] 或服务方法中），从未更新。

docs.title: 7.4 乐观锁
docs.text:
#[ORM\Version]
#[ORM\Column]
private int $version = 1;

使用时间：对同一记录的并发更新存在数据损坏的风险（例如钱包余额）。

docs.title: 7.5 多态关联
docs.text:
对于引用不同实体类型的评论/反应：

#[ORM\Column(length: 100)]
private string $entityType;  // e.g., 'App\Common\Entity\Content'

#[ORM\Column]
private int $entityId;

无 FK 约束（在应用层解决）。

docs.title: 7.6 JSON 元数据/额外数据
docs.text:
#[ORM\Column(type: 'json', nullable: true)]
private ?array $metadata = null;

#[ORM\Column(type: 'json', nullable: true)]
private ?array $extraData = null;

使用时间：不需要专用列的可扩展字段。

docs.title: 8. 存储库合约
docs.text:
每个实体必须有一个专用的存储库：

namespace App\{Module}\Repository;

use App\{Module}\Entity\Xxx;
use Doctrine\Bundle\DoctrineBundle\Repository\ServiceEntityRepository;
use Doctrine\Persistence\ManagerRegistry;

class XxxRepository extends ServiceEntityRepository
{
    public function __construct(ManagerRegistry $registry)
    {
        parent::__construct($registry, Xxx::class);
    }
}

docs.title: 8.1 自定义查询方法
docs.text:
• 存储库可以在基本 ServiceEntityRepository 之外添加自定义查询方法
  • 自定义方法返回实体、数组或标量值 - 永远不要使用 QueryBuilder（这是服务层负责组合的）
  • 如果需要跨模块消费，可以为存储库创建接口（例如，ContentRepositoryInterface）

docs.title: 8.2 用于 IDE 支持的 PHPDoc
docs.text: • 添加 @method Xxx|null find($id) 和 @method Xxx[] findAll() 文档块

docs.title: 9. 验证合约
docs.text:
实体通过属性或注释定义验证规则：

use Symfony\Component\Validator\Constraints as Assert;

#[Assert\NotBlank]
private ?string $name = null;

#[Assert\Email]
private ?string $email = null;

通过 Symfony Validator 在 BaseService::update() 中调用验证。实体必须声明以下约束： - 必填字段 (NotBlank) - 格式限制（Email、Url、Regex） - 长度限制 (Length) - 范围约束（Range、Positive、PositiveOrZero） - 选择约束（Choice 用于枚举/状态）

docs.title: 10. 反模式（禁止）
docs.text: 反模式 该怎么办？ 扩展 RestController 或 BaseService 的实体 实体是纯粹的数据对象 实体方法中的业务逻辑 移至服务层 将服务注入实体 实体不得使用 DI 实体中直接 $em->persist() 使用Service层 可变 DateTime 使用 DateTimeImmutable 将内部 ID 公开为外部标识符 使用 UUID 进行面向外部的引用 在代码中将钱存储为浮点/小数 存储为 int（分），在 API 边界处转换 JSON 中的循环引用无需处理 使用 CircularReferenceHandler 或序列化器组

docs.title: 扩展点目录
docs.text: 系统中每个可插拔扩展点的中央目录： 自动标签、合约接口、所属模块、注册表 收集实现、具体提供者所在的位置以及谁在消费 他们。使用本文档无需 grep 即可发现或添加提供程序。

docs.title: 1. 放置规则
docs.text:
有两条规则决定扩展点及其实现所在的位置：

  1. 合约（接口+注册表）存在于拥有/使用该行为的模块中。 Payment 定义了PaymentGatewayInterface，因为它协调网关。 钱包定义了 DepositProviderInterface 因为它控制着每一个信用。 Trade 定义了 PriceCalculatorInterface，因为它运行着价格管道。
  2. 实现位于拥有副作用的模块中。 WalletGateway 存在于 Wallet 中，因为它会移动钱包余额； WechatPayGateway 住在微信里，因为它驱动 EasyWeChat； ManualDepositProvider 居住在 钱包，因为它授权钱包信用。一个实现可能存在于 与接口不同的模块，只要依赖方向是 允许（实现模块导入接口的模块）。

使 Payment 保持通用外观的规则是契约性的：

付款不得依赖于电子钱包（服务或实体）。钱包、微信、 和其他模块可以实现支付定义的接口。任何提供商支持 钱包积分因此实现了 Wallet 的 wallet.deposit_provider 扩展 点，而不是付款点 - 即使资金来源是付款发票。

docs.title: 2. 自动标记
docs.text:
每个扩展点都集中注册在 config/services.yaml 下 _instanceof。任何实现该接口的类——在任何模块命名空间中—— 自动接收标签。不需要每个提供商的接线：

services:
    _instanceof:
        App\Payment\Service\PaymentGatewayInterface:
            tags: ['payment.gateway']
        App\Payment\Service\Adjustment\PaymentAdjustmentProviderInterface:
            tags: ['payment.adjustment_provider']
        App\Wallet\Service\Deposit\DepositProviderInterface:
            tags: ['wallet.deposit_provider']
        App\Wallet\Service\Withdraw\WithdrawProviderInterface:
            tags: ['wallet.withdraw_provider']
        App\Storage\Service\MediaStorageInterface:
            tags: ['media.storage']

标签与 #[AutowireIterator('tag.name')] 一起使用。

docs.title: 3.目录
docs.text: 标签 接口（所有者） 登记处 消费者 实现（模块） payment.gateway App\Payment\Service\PaymentGatewayInterface（付款） PaymentGatewayRegistry InvoiceService MockGateway（支付）、WalletGateway（钱包）、WechatPayGateway（微信） payment.adjustment_provider App\Payment\Service\Adjustment\PaymentAdjustmentProviderInterface（付款） PaymentAdjustmentRegistry InvoiceService WalletBalanceAdjustmentProvider（钱包） wallet.deposit_provider App\Wallet\Service\Deposit\DepositProviderInterface（钱包） DepositProviderRegistry DepositService ManualDepositProvider（钱包），InvoiceDepositProvider（钱包） wallet.withdraw_provider App\Wallet\Service\Withdraw\WithdrawProviderInterface（钱包） WithdrawProviderRegistry WithdrawService ManualWithdrawProvider（钱包） media.storage App\Storage\Service\MediaStorageInterface（存储） MediaStorageRegistry MediaService LocalStorage、QiniuStorage（存储） trade.price_calculator App\Trade\Service\Pricing\PriceCalculatorInterface（贸易） 在 OrderService 中内联收集OrderService::calculatePrices() BasePriceCalculator、QuantityCalculator、TotalAggregator（贸易）； PromotionCalculator（促销） promotion.strategy App\Promotion\Strategy\PromotionStrategyInterface（促销） 在 PromotionService 中内联收集PromotionCalculator 7 个策略（促销）

docs.title: 3.1 注册表模式
docs.text:
注册表通过 ::getName() 索引提供程序并公开类型化访问：

final class DepositProviderRegistry
{
    /** @param iterable<DepositProviderInterface> $providers */
    public function __construct(#[AutowireIterator('wallet.deposit_provider')] iterable $providers) {}

    public function has(string $name): bool;
    public function get(string $name): DepositProviderInterface;   // throws when unknown
    public function forVoucherType(string $voucherType): ?DepositProviderInterface; // whitelist routing
}

支持多个具体名称的提供者使用supports()进行路由；一个 本身就是一个名称的提供者从 supports() 返回其 getName()。

docs.title: 4.1 优惠券支持的提供商（存款/取款）
docs.text:
DepositProviderInterface 和 WithdrawProviderInterface 具有相同的形状：

方法 合同 getName() 稳定的提供商/凭证类型名称 supports(string $type) 该提供商是否处理所请求的优惠券类型 assertPermitted(array $options) 拥有权限规则；当不允许调用者时抛出 AccessDeniedException。没有活动的安全上下文（CLI/队列/系统）是可信的调用者并且必须通过 authorize(Voucher, array $options) 验证支持凭证的来源是否已准备好（例如发票已支付且匹配）。存款/取款交易内部调用 reverse(Voucher, string $reason, array $options) 已申请的凭证被冲销时的源端处理。在钱包移动交易后运行

当安全上下文处于活动状态时，内置 manual 提供程序仅适用于管理员 并使用 authorize()/reverse() 作为无操作。域支持的提供商（例如 InvoiceDepositProvider) 在 authorize() 中编码其源检查。

docs.title: 4.2 支付网关
docs.text: PaymentGatewayInterface 接收 显式 $amount 参数，并且不得 从发票中得出应付金额或检查调整选项。参见 docs/design/bundles/payment.md §6。

docs.title: 4.3 支付调整提供商
docs.text: PaymentAdjustmentProviderInterface 减少网关必须处理的数量 （例如钱包余额扣除）。实现位于所属模块中，并且 仅返回通用 PaymentAdjustmentResult 数据。参见payment.md§5.3。

docs.title: 5.跨模块卫士（服务装饰）
docs.text:
并非每个跨模块规则都需要注册表。拦截现有规则的规则 服务入口点可以分层为服务装饰器：

  • App\Wallet\Service\Payment\InvoiceDepositRefundGuard 装饰 App\Payment\Service\InvoiceService 并在 APPLIED 时阻止 refund() invoice存款凭证已存在。派生的“已存”状态（已付发票 +已使用的优惠券）当优惠券被撤销时自动解锁。
  • config/services.yaml中的接线： 
    App\Wallet\Service\Payment\InvoiceDepositRefundGuard:
    decorates: App\Payment\Service\InvoiceService
    arguments: ['@.inner']
App\Payment\Service\InvoiceServiceInterface: '@App\Wallet\Service\Payment\InvoiceDepositRefundGuard'
  • 一旦装饰创建两个候选者，就需要显式接口别名 对于接口。

装饰适用于接口的每个消费者（控制器、贸易），所以没有 需要更改调用站点。

docs.title: 6. 添加新的提供商
docs.text:
1. 决定副作用的所有者 → 该模块托管实现。 将合约保留在其所属模块中，除非添加的行为是 合同本身。
  2. 实现接口（第 3 节中的合同）。依赖全局_instanceof 标签 — 不要手动注册服务。
  3. 如果注册表不需要更改（它通过标签收集），则到此为止。如果新的 提供者拥有新的权限规则或源检查，将其放入 assertPermitted()/authorize() 根据合同。
  4. 为提供商可以抛出的每条面向用户的消息添加翻译键。
  5. 为提供者添加单元测试（成功 + 每个拒绝路径）和 驱动真实注册表的集成测试，以及生命周期测试 任何域派生的防护。
  6. 验证 PHPStan Level 8 和 90% 覆盖率门。
