  3. Service interface + service — {Thing}ServiceInterface extends BaseServiceInterface; ThingService extends BaseService implements ThingServiceInterface, with parent::__construct($container, Thing::class).
  4. Controllers — App (read-only public) and Manage (admin CRUD) extending RestController and composing the view mixins.
  5. Routes — register in config/routes.yaml.
  6. Migration — bin/console make:migration / review & apply.

Autowiring handles everything: App\: is auto-registered, RestController deps are wired via _instanceof, and the $service property is injected through the constructor.

docs.title: Database & Migrations
docs.text: Everything about how crud-skeleton persists data: Doctrine configuration, the schema conventions every entity follows (UUID identity, timestamps, JSON columns, money), and the migration workflow you use day-to-day.

docs.title: 1.1 config/packages/doctrine.yaml
docs.text:
doctrine:
    dbal:
        url: '%env(resolve:DATABASE_URL)%'
        profiling_collect_backtrace: '%kernel.debug%'
    orm:
        validate_xml_mapping: true
        naming_strategy: doctrine.orm.naming_strategy.underscore_number_aware
        identity_generation_preferences:
            Doctrine\DBAL\Platforms\PostgreSQLPlatform: identity
        auto_mapping: true
        mappings:
            App:
                type: attribute
                is_bundle: false
                dir: '%kernel.project_dir%/src'
                prefix: 'App'
                alias: App
        dql:
            string_functions:
                regexp: DoctrineExtensions\Query\Mysql\Regexp
            numeric_functions:
                rand: DoctrineExtensions\Query\Mysql\Rand
            datetime_functions:
                date_format: DoctrineExtensions\Query\Mysql\DateFormat
  • Attribute mapping for the entire src/ tree with prefix App. Entities are plain PHP classes anywhere under src/<Module>/Entity/ annotated with #[ORM\Entity], #[ORM\Table], etc. — no YAML/XML/annotation mapping, and each new module needs zero mapping config.
  • Naming strategy underscore_number_aware — allocationKey → allocation_key, sourceItemSnapshot → source_item_snapshot, and numeric suffixes are kept (api2 stays distinct from api).
  • auto_mapping: true maps the whole App namespace; controller_resolver.auto_mapping is left off so controllers are resolved explicitly.
  • DBAL URL comes from DATABASE_URL:
Environment DATABASE_URL Compose (app) mysql://app:***@database:3306/app?serverVersion=8.0&charset=utf8mb4 Local dev (native PHP) any of the commented examples in .env / README.md, e.g. mysql://app:!ChangeMe!@127.0.0.1:3306/app?serverVersion=8.0&charset=utf8mb4 Tests sqlite:///%kernel.project_dir%/var/test.db (.env.test) CI (migration chain) mysql://app:app@127.0.0.1:3306/crud_skeleton_test?serverVersion=8.4&charset=utf8mb4

Tests run on SQLite (per-process files under paratest so parallel workers never race); production and the migration CI use MySQL.

docs.title: 1.2 config/packages/doctrine_migrations.yaml
docs.text:
doctrine_migrations:
    migrations_paths:
        'DoctrineMigrations': '%kernel.project_dir%/migrations'
    enable_profiler: false

Migration classes live in the project root migrations/, in the DoctrineMigrations namespace (deliberately not autoloadable, so they are never loaded except when running a migration command).

docs.title: 2. Migration files
docs.text:
Each migration is a final class Version⟨YYMMDDHHMMSS⟩ extends AbstractMigration (generated timestamps use the date, e.g. Version20250620000000, Version20260725010000, Version20260819000000). It implements getDescription() plus up() / down():

namespace DoctrineMigrations;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Schema\Schema;
use Doctrine\Migrations\AbstractMigration;

final class Version20260725020000 extends AbstractMigration
{
    public function getDescription(): string
    {
        return 'Create Trade integration outbox table';
    }

    public function up(Schema $schema): void
    {
        $this->addSql("CREATE TABLE trade_outbox_message (
            id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
            event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
            topic VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
            aggregate_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
            aggregate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            payload JSON NOT NULL,
            occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '(DC2Type:datetime_immutable)',
            available_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '(DC2Type:datetime_immutable)',
            published_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '(DC2Type:datetime_immutable)',
            attempts INT NOT NULL,
            last_error LONGTEXT DEFAULT NULL,
            UNIQUE INDEX uniq_trade_outbox_event_id (event_id),
            INDEX idx_trade_outbox_unpublished_available (published_at, available_at),
            PRIMARY KEY(id)
        ) DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ENGINE = InnoDB");
    }

    public function down(Schema $schema): void
    {
        $this->addSql('DROP TABLE trade_outbox_message');
    }
}

Current chain (excerpt):

Migration Contains Version20250514000000 identity users, content Version20250516000000 common CMS: category, tag, content_tag, media, page, comment, setting Version20250517000000 wallet, wallet_transaction Version20250620000000 trade product, specification, order, order_item Version20260624223701 payment invoice, wechat_user, messenger_messages Version20260725010000 store, store_membership, store_order, store_consumed_event, store_outbox_message Version20260725020000 trade_outbox_message Version20260726000000 inventory material/stock/recipe/reservation/ledger + inbox/outbox + store_trade_order_cancellation Version20260819000000 settlement_rule, settlement_rule_version, settlement_plan, settlement_allocation, settlement_consumed_event, settlement_outbox_message Version20260819000001 + source_item_id, source_item_snapshot on settlement_allocation

docs.title: 3.1 Global rules
docs.text:
• Engine / charset: every table is InnoDB, character set utf8mb4, collation utf8mb4_unicode_ci.
  • Surrogate key: auto-increment id — INT for most tables, BIGINT where volume or event throughput is high (ledger, outbox/inbox tables, messenger_messages). Declared in attributes: #[ORM\Id] #[ORM\GeneratedValue] #[ORM\Column(type: 'bigint')].
  • datetime_immutable everywhere for time columns, with the COMMENT '(DC2Type:datetime_immutable)' marker in generated SQL so the DBAL/ORM types line up on both MySQL and SQLite.
  • Named constraints: UNIQUE INDEX uniq_<table>_<cols>, INDEX idx_<table>_<purpose>, CONSTRAINT FK_<TABLE>_<COL>. The attribute declarations use the same names, so doctrine:migrations:diff produces clean no-op diffs.
  • FK ON DELETE policy: RESTRICT for ownership relationships that must not silently disappear (store→store_order, inventory FK chains), CASCADE for child collections (recipe lines, reservation lines, settlement allocations), SET NULL for optional cross-entity refs (trade_order.user).

docs.title: 3.2 UUID identity
docs.text:
Every aggregate carries a business-facing uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL UNIQUE, generated application-side at construction with App\Core\Utils\UUID::v4() — never by the database, and never exposed as the numeric id:

#[ORM\Entity(repositoryClass: StoreOrderRepository::class)]
#[ORM\Table(name: 'store_order')]
#[ORM\UniqueConstraint(name: 'uniq_store_order_uuid', columns: ['uuid'])]
class StoreOrder
{
    #[ORM\Id, ORM\GeneratedValue, ORM\Column(type: 'integer')]
    private ?int $id = null;

    #[ORM\Column(type: 'string', length: 36, unique: true)]
    private string $uuid;

    public function __construct(/* ... */)
    {
        $this->uuid = UUID::v4();
        $this->createdAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
    }
}
  • UUIDs are the stable key across module boundaries: store_uuid, trade_order_uuid, store_order_uuid, reservation_id, plan_uuid, allocation_uuid appear as plain VARCHAR(36) FK-style references that are deliberately not real FKs, because the referenced row may live in another module's aggregate.
  • UUIDs are what appear in event envelopes and API payloads; the numeric id is internal. Inventory and the event handlers re-validate UUID format with the strict v4 regex ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.

docs.title: 3.3 Timestamps and lifecycle callbacks
docs.text:
Two timestamp conventions, both using datetime_immutable:

  • created_at — set once in the constructor (new \DateTimeImmutable()).
  • updated_at — nullable in most modules (Trade, Store, Inventory); NOT NULL in Settlement (SettlementPlan, SettlementAllocation).

Timestamps are maintained by touch(), wired to the ORM lifecycle callbacks:

#[ORM\Entity(...)]
#[ORM\HasLifecycleCallbacks]
class SettlementAllocation
{
    #[ORM\Column(name: 'created_at', type: 'datetime_immutable')]
    private \DateTimeImmutable $createdAt;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'updated_at', type: 'datetime_immutable')]
    private \DateTimeImmutable $updatedAt;

    #[ORM\PrePersist]
    #[ORM\PreUpdate]
    public function touch(): void
    {
        $this->updatedAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
    }
}

Trade's Order shows the other pattern — no #[ORM\PreUpdate]; every mutator calls $this->touch() explicitly, plus a #[ORM\PrePersist] that initialises createdAt:

#[ORM\PrePersist]
public function prePersist(): void
{
    if (!isset($this->createdAt)) {
        $this->createdAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
    }
}

丰富的模块在审核时间戳旁边添加域时间戳（paid_at、cancelled_at、 accepted_at、rejected_at、expires_at、released_at、posted_at ...）。

docs.title: 3.4 JSON 列
docs.text:
无模式负载、快照和元数据存储为 JSON，其中 #[ORM\Column(type: 'json')] 映射到 array 属性（当列可为空时也可为空）：

/** @var array<string, mixed>|null */
#[ORM\Column(type: 'json', nullable: true)]
private ?array $metadata = null;

典型用途：trade_order.metadata、trade_order_item.spec_snapshot/ product_snapshot、store_order.order_snapshot、inventory_reservation_line. source_specification_uuids 和结算工作量证明列 settlement_plan.context_snapshot / funding_snapshot / rule_snapshot / calculation_trace 和 settlement_allocation.recipient_snapshot / source_item_snapshot。因为这些表在MySQL中携带JSON，所以它们不能使用标准 这些列上的索引（utc 样式的功能索引除外）；通过查询他们 应用程序端字段也存储为普通列（例如 context_hash、 funding_fingerprint）。

docs.title: 3.5 货币：整数美分与结算量
docs.text:
有两种货币表示形式，重要的是不要混合它们。

经典商业货币（整数小单位/分）。 trade_order.total_amount， trade_specification.price、trade_order_item.unit_price / price / cost / profit、 payment_invoice.amount / refunded_amount、store_order.total_amount都是 BIGINT 列存储 cents 和 options: ['default' => 0]：

#[ORM\Column(type: 'bigint', options: ['default' => 0])]
private int $totalAmount = 0;

帮助程序转换为主要单位以进行显示：Order::getTotalAmountAsFloat() 是 $this->totalAmount / 100； Order::__toString() 打印 $this->totalAmount / 100。 故意避免使用 31 位 INT — 美分有时会超过 215·并且总和会溢出 INT； BIGINT 确保算术安全。

结算量子货币（任意精度）。结算必须分配资金 数量准确，因此它以固定比例存储规范的以 10 为基数的整数字符串 （默认 18），在 VARCHAR(128) 列中，并使用 brick/math 进行算术运算 (BigInteger) 而不是浮点数或整数：

柱状图案 示例专栏 意义 …_quantum funding_amount_quantum、exact_amount_quantum calculation_scale 处的精确整数（量子/10^比例单位） posting_amount posting_amount、funding_posting_amount 转换为 posting_scale 的金额（默认 2 = 小单位） 
// SettlementAllocation
#[ORM\Column(name: 'exact_amount_quantum', type: 'string', length: 128)]
private string $exactAmountQuantum;

#[ORM\Column(name: 'posting_amount', type: 'string', length: 128)]
private string $postingAmount;

#[ORM\Column(name: 'posting_scale', type: 'smallint')]
private int $postingScale;
  • App\Settlement\Service\Money\QuantumAmount 是值对象：非负精确 整数 quantum、scale (0..18)、大写 currency； toPostingMinor()楼层 趋向于零并且 postingRemainder() 保留丢弃的分数。
  • App\Settlement\Service\Money\AllocationRoundingService::distribute()执行 最大剩余资金分配给具有确定性抢七的发布单位 （余数递减，然后 allocationKey 升序），保证残差为 总是完全分配或者抛出。
  • brick/math (^0.19.1) 位于 composer.json 中并直接导入到这些服务中。

数量（不是金钱，而是相同的想法）。 库存将数量存储为 NUMERIC(20,6) App\Inventory\Service\Quantity 值对象对十进制字符串进行操作 ('12.500000') 具有固定的 6 位小数刻度，拒绝任何不适合的内容 列（最多 14 个整数数字）— 请参阅 Quantity::normalize()。

docs.title: 3.6 唯一约束和索引
docs.text:
唯一性规则在实体上和迁移中声明两次 相同的名字：

#[ORM\UniqueConstraint(name: 'uniq_store_order_trade_order_uuid', columns: ['trade_order_uuid'])]
#[ORM\Index(name: 'idx_store_order_store_status_created', columns: ['store_id', 'operational_status', 'created_at'])]

显着的商业特色：

约束 专栏 为什么 uniq_<agg>_uuid (uuid) 每个聚合的稳定外键 uniq_store_order_trade_order_uuid (trade_order_uuid) 每个贸易订单一份商店订单 uniq_inventory_reservation_store_order (store_order_uuid) 每个商店订单一次预订 uniq_inventory_stock_store_material (store_uuid, material_id) 每个商店+材料一行库存 uniq_store_membership_store_user (store_id, user_uuid) 商店中每个用户拥有一个会员资格 uniq_settlement_plan_funding (funding_id) 每个资助活动一个计划 uniq_settlement_plan_source (source_type, source_id, funding_kind) 每个来源事实一个计划 uniq_settlement_allocation_plan_key (plan_uuid, allocation_key) 每个规则键一次分配 uniq_settlement_allocation_posting_key / …_reversal_key (posting_idempotency_key) / (reversal_idempotency_key) 幂等凭证发布/反向 uniq_inventory_ledger_operation (type, reference_id, store_uuid, material_id) 账本幂等性 uniq_trade_outbox_event_id（以及其他发件箱/收件箱表） (event_id) 事务性发件箱/收件箱重复数据删除

为应用程序实际运行的查询模式添加索引： (status, <time>) 列表屏幕、(published_at, available_at) 发件箱轮询、 (status, next_attempt_at) 结算重试，以及 (store_uuid, material_id, created_at) 分类帐。

docs.title: 4.1 标准循环
docs.text:
# 1. Change an entity (add/remove attributes, constraints, indexes)

# 2. Generate the migration from the entity metadata diff
php bin/console doctrine:migrations:diff

# 3. Review the generated SQL (in migrations/Version<timestamp>.php) — rename it to a
#    descriptive Date(Version20260819…) if you prefer, and give it a getDescription()

# 4. Apply
php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate

# 5. Verify
php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status

在 Docker 内部，这些变成 docker compose exec app php bin/console …。

有用的命令：

命令 目的 doctrine:migrations:migrate 应用所有挂起的迁移（CI/脚本中的--no-interaction） doctrine:migrations:diff 从实体↔架构差异生成迁移 doctrine:migrations:status 显示当前版本以及可用/执行的内容 doctrine:migrations:list 列出所有迁移及其描述 doctrine:migrations:generate 创建一个空骨架来手写SQL doctrine:migrations:execute 运行/回滚特定版本（--down 表示相反）

docs.title: 4.2 经验法则
docs.text:
• 切勿编辑已合并并应用的迁移，因为它可能存在于 您看不到的数据库。相反，添加新的迁移。
  • 保留手写的getDescription()，以便doctrine:migrations:list和status 可读。
  • 始终提供一个 down() 来反转 up() （删除您想要的表/列/约束） 以相反的顺序添加 — 将 FK 放在其表之前）。
  • doctrine:migrations:diff需要一个与配置相匹配的可访问数据库 DATABASE_URL。在 CI 和新的开发设置中，首先运行 doctrine:migrations:migrate 创建基线。
  • 当迁移影响发件箱/收件箱或结算表时，请记住约束 上面的命名和 ON DELETE 策略约定，使 CI 模式检查保持干净。
  • 测试在 SQLite 上运行，因此保持生成的 SQL 可移植：避免手册中仅使用 MySQL 语法 迁移编辑。

docs.title: 5. CI 迁移链（MySQL 8.4）
docs.text:
.github/workflows/migrations.yml 运行 mysql-migration-chain 作业 ubuntu-latest。当 migrations/ 时，它会在针对 main/master 的推送/PR 上触发， config/、bin/、composer.json、composer.lock、symfony.lock 或工作流程本身 变化。

它的作用：

  1. 启动 MySQL 8.4 服务容器（crud_skeleton_test 数据库、app/app 用户）。
  2. 检查代码并通过以下方式安装带有 pdo_mysql 扩展的 PHP 8.4 shivammathur/setup-php。
  3. 运行composer install。
  4. 运行 php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction --env=dev 通过 DATABASE_URL 的 MySQL 服务 — 这练习了完整的迁移链开始 在生产引擎上完成，这是基于 SQLite 的单元/功能测试永远不会做的 (JSON (DC2Type:…)备注、BIGINT自增、无符号/内联索引选项全部 在 MySQL 上的行为有所不同）。
  5. 验证 php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status --env=dev 以确认架构是 完全迁移。

这是捕获仅出现在 MySQL 上的损坏 SQL 的门。如果您的公关触及 schema，等待这个作业通过。

docs.title: 6.参考：一个实体，端到端
docs.text:
结合 UUID 身份、生命周期回调的代表性属性映射实体 时间戳、JSON 和 bigint 货币 — App\Store\Entity\StoreOrder（表 store_order）：

#[ORM\Entity(repositoryClass: StoreOrderRepository::class)]
#[ORM\Table(name: 'store_order')]
#[ORM\UniqueConstraint(name: 'uniq_store_order_uuid', columns: ['uuid'])]
#[ORM\UniqueConstraint(name: 'uniq_store_order_trade_order_uuid', columns: ['trade_order_uuid'])]
#[ORM\Index(name: 'idx_store_order_store_status_created', columns: ['store_id', 'operational_status', 'created_at'])]
class StoreOrder
{
    #[ORM\Id, ORM\GeneratedValue, ORM\Column(type: 'integer')]
    private ?int $id = null;

    #[ORM\Column(type: 'string', length: 36, unique: true)]
    private string $uuid;

    #[ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity: Store::class)]
    #[ORM\JoinColumn(name: 'store_id', referencedColumnName: 'id', nullable: false, onDelete: 'RESTRICT')]
    private Store $store;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'total_amount', type: 'bigint')]
    private int $totalAmount;                         // cents

    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    #[ORM\Column(name: 'order_snapshot', type: 'json')]
    private array $orderSnapshot;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'operational_status', type: 'string', length: 40)]
    private string $operationalStatus = self::STATUS_PENDING_VALIDATION;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'created_at', type: 'datetime_immutable')]
    private \DateTimeImmutable $createdAt;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'updated_at', type: 'datetime_immutable', nullable: true)]
    private ?\DateTimeImmutable $updatedAt = null;

    public function __construct(Store $store, string $tradeOrderUuid, /* … */ )
    {
        $this->uuid = UUID::v4();
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->createdAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
    }

    private function touch(): self { $this->updatedAt = new \DateTimeImmutable(); return $this; }
}

docs.title: Docker Deployment
docs.text: This document is the operational reference for running the CRUD Skeleton in Docker. It mirrors the README "Docker Deployment" section (starting at README.md:646) and documents every service, variable, and startup step in detail.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    Client[Client / Browser] -->|:8080| Nginx[nginx:alpine]
    Nginx -->|/api/*| Fpm["PHP-FPM 8.4<br/>(app, Symfony)"]
    Nginx -->|/api/doc| Swagger[Swagger UI<br/>NelmioApiDoc]
    Fpm --> MySQL[(MySQL 8)]
    Fpm --> Redis[(Redis 7<br/>OTP / cache)]
    Fpm --> Mailpit[Mailpit<br/>email dev]
    Fpm --> Worker[Messenger worker<br/>handlers / outbox]
    Fpm --> Scheduler[Scheduler<br/>outbox publish]

All services join a single internal Docker network; no container is exposed to the public internet except nginx (and the database / mailer host ports in the dev override).

docs.title: Services
docs.text: Service Image / build Purpose app built from Dockerfile PHP-FPM 8.4, the Symfony application worker extends app Runs messenger:consume async (async message handlers) scheduler extends app Infinite loop publishing outbox + housekeeping commands nginx nginx:alpine Reverse proxy → app:9000, static files from public/ database mysql:${MYSQL_VERSION:-8.4} MySQL 8.4, persistent via mysql_data volume redis redis:7-alpine OTP storage + cache, persistent via redis_data volume mailer axllent/mailpit Catches outbound SMTP mail, web UI at :8025 (dev ports)

docs.title: Per-service notes
docs.text:
• app — runs php-fpm, listens on port 9000. Startup is guarded by the container entrypoint (see JWT keys). It depends_on the database service's healthcheck and the redis container. ./var is bind-mounted to /var/www/html/var so cache, logs, and JWT keys persist across container rebuilds.
  • worker — same image and environment as app, but overrides the command to consume the async transport indefinitely:
php bin/console messenger:consume async --time-limit=3600 --memory-limit=256M --no-interaction

The process restarts every hour (or earlier when memory exceeds 256M) to avoid leaks. app must be healthy before the worker starts.

  • scheduler — non-Dockerized cron replacement. Runs a while : loop that executes the outbox publish and housekeeping commands on an interval (OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL, default 5 s):
php bin/console app:trade:outbox:publish --no-interaction
php bin/console app:store:outbox:publish --no-interaction
php bin/console app:inventory:outbox:publish --no-interaction
php bin/console app:inventory:reservations:release-expired --no-interaction
php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction

See Scheduler commands for what each one does.

  • nginx — the only published service. The APP_PORT variable (default 8080) maps host → container port 80. It mounts public/ read-only and the vhost config docker/nginx/default.conf. Its healthcheck requests http://localhost/health/ready through the full stack (nginx → PHP-FPM → Symfony → DB/Redis), so the container is only "healthy" once the application can actually serve traffic.
  • database — MySQL 8.4 by default (MYSQL_VERSION, e.g. 8.4 or 8.0). Data lives in the named mysql_data volume. Healthcheck uses mysqladmin ping with the app credentials.
  • redis — Redis 7, used for OTP storage and cache. No port is exposed in the base compose file; the dev override opens the DB and mailer ports only.
  • mailer — Mailpit (axllent/mailpit). SMTP on 1025 inside the network, UI published on MAILPIT_UI_PORT (default 8025). Accepts auth-free SMTP so smtp://mailer:1025 works out of the box.

docs.title: Compose files
docs.text:
File Role compose.yaml Base definition: all services, safe development defaults for secrets compose.override.yaml Auto-loaded in dev: APP_ENV=dev, debug on, full source bind-mount, exposes 3306 + 1025 compose.prod.yaml Production: enforces prod, debug off, requires real secrets

compose.override.yaml is applied automatically by docker compose (because of the compose.yaml/compose.override.yaml neighbor rule). For production you must explicitly pass both files:

docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build

compose.prod.yaml forces APP_ENV=prod / APP_DEBUG=0 and uses :?required for APP_SECRET, REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET, MYSQL_PASSWORD, and MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD — the stack refuses to start without them.

docs.title: Core Symfony (always required)
docs.text: Variable Default (dev) Purpose APP_ENV prod (base) / dev (override) Symfony environment APP_DEBUG 0 (override 1) Debug mode APP_SECRET dev-secret-change-me Symfony application secret DATABASE_URL mysql://app:!ChangeMe!@database:3306/app?... Doctrine DSN, built from the MYSQL_* variables DEFAULT_URI http://localhost Canonical app URI

docs.title: JWT / authentication
docs.text: 变量 默认 目的 JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH /var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_private.pem 容器中的RSA私钥路径 JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH /var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_public.pem 容器中的RSA公钥路径 JWT_PASSPHRASE （空） 私钥的密码 ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL 7200 访问令牌生命周期（秒） REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL 31536000（1 年） 刷新令牌生命周期（秒） REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET dev-refresh-secret-change-me 用于刷新令牌的 HMAC-SHA256 密钥

docs.title: OTP / SMS（可选 - 空则禁用）
docs.text:
变量 默认 OTP_REDIS_DSN redis://redis:6379/0 ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID （空） ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET （空） ALIYUN_SMS_REGION cn-hangzhou ALIYUN_SMS_SIGN_NAME （空） ALIYUN_SMS_TEMPLATE_LOGIN_OTP （空） ALIYUN_SMS_TEMPLATE_VERIFY_PHONE （空） ALIYUN_SMS_DRY_RUN true

OTP_REDIS_DSN 还门控 /health/ready 探针的 Redis 部分 — 空值报告 disabled 并被视为健康。

docs.title: 微信（可选 — 空则禁用）
docs.text:
小程序：WECHAT_MINIAPP_APP_ID、WECHAT_MINIAPP_SECRET。

公众号：WECHAT_OFFICIAL_APP_ID、WECHAT_OFFICIAL_SECRET、 WECHAT_OFFICIAL_TOKEN、WECHAT_OFFICIAL_AES_KEY。

微信支付V3：WECHAT_PAY_MCH_ID、WECHAT_PAY_SECRET_KEY、 WECHAT_PAY_PRIVATE_KEY、WECHAT_PAY_CERTIFICATE、WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL （加上 WECHAT_PAY_PLATFORM_CERT、WECHAT_PAY_PUB_KEY_ID、 WECHAT_PAY_PUB_KEY_PATH — 参见 .env.example）。

docs.title: 基础设施
docs.text: 变量 默认 目的 MAILER_DSN smtp://mailer:1025 网络内的Mailpit MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN doctrine://default?auto_setup=0 信使async运输（主义） INVENTORY_ENABLED 0 布尔值；切换库存功能路径 OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL 5 调度程序循环睡眠（秒） MYSQL_DATABASE / MYSQL_USER / MYSQL_PASSWORD / MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD app / app / !ChangeMe! / !RootChangeMe! MySQL 设置 MYSQL_VERSION 8.4 MySQL 镜像标签 APP_PORT 8080 nginx 的主机端口 MAILPIT_UI_PORT 8025 Mailpit UI 的主机端口

docs.title: 环境文件设置
docs.text:
Symfony 和 Docker Compose 从不同的文件读取环境变量。的 下表显示了每种情况下加载的文件：

场景 文件读取 笔记 原生 PHP（本地） .env 然后 .env.local .env.local 覆盖 .env；永远不要犯 Docker Compose（开发） .env（或--env-file） compose.yaml 具有安全的开发默认值，因此不需要任何文件 Docker Compose（产品） .env.prod.local 通过 --env-file 复制自 .env.prod.example

docs.title: 开发.env.local
docs.text:
对于原生 PHP 开发，将您需要的变量从 .env.example 复制到 .env.local。一个完整的例子：

### Symfony
APP_ENV=dev
APP_DEBUG=1
APP_SECRET=dev-secret-do-not-use-in-production

### Database (native PHP)
DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:!ChangeMe!@127.0.0.1:3306/app?serverVersion=8.0&charset=utf8mb4

### JWT / Auth
JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=var/jwt_dev_private.pem
JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH=var/jwt_dev_public.pem
JWT_PASSPHRASE=
ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL=7200
REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL=31536000
REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET=dev-refresh-secret-do-not-use-in-production

### OTP / Redis
OTP_TTL=300
OTP_REDIS_DSN=redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0

### Aliyun SMS (leave empty to disable)
ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET=
ALIYUN_SMS_REGION=cn-hangzhou
ALIYUN_SMS_SIGN_NAME=
ALIYUN_SMS_TEMPLATE_LOGIN_OTP=
ALIYUN_SMS_TEMPLATE_VERIFY_PHONE=
ALIYUN_SMS_DRY_RUN=true

### WeChat (optional — leave empty to disable)
WECHAT_MINIAPP_APP_ID=
WECHAT_MINIAPP_SECRET=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_APP_ID=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_SECRET=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_TOKEN=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_AES_KEY=
WECHAT_PAY_MCH_ID=
WECHAT_PAY_SECRET_KEY=
WECHAT_PAY_PRIVATE_KEY=
WECHAT_PAY_CERTIFICATE=
WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL=

docs.title: 生产.env.prod.local
docs.text:
将.env.prod.example复制到.env.prod.local并填写实际值。的 compose.prod.yaml 覆盖层使用 :?required 作为 APP_SECRET， REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET、MYSQL_PASSWORD 和 MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD — 堆栈 拒绝在没有他们的情况下开始。

APP_ENV=prod
APP_SECRET=<generate-a-long-random-string>
REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET=<generate-a-long-random-string>

# Public ports
APP_PORT=8080
MAILPIT_UI_PORT=8025

# MySQL container
MYSQL_DATABASE=app
MYSQL_USER=app
MYSQL_PASSWORD=<strong-db-password>
MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=<strong-root-password>
MYSQL_VERSION=8.4

# JWT keys are expected at ./var/jwt on the host and mounted into the app volume.
JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=/var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_private.pem
JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH=/var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_public.pem
JWT_PASSPHRASE=
ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL=7200
REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL=31536000

# Infrastructure
MAILER_DSN=smtp://mailer:1025
MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN=doctrine://default?auto_setup=0
OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL=5
OTP_REDIS_DSN=redis://redis:6379/0
DEFAULT_URI=https://example.com

# Optional: leave empty to disable.
ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
ALIYUN_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET=
ALIYUN_SMS_REGION=cn-hangzhou
ALIYUN_SMS_SIGN_NAME=
ALIYUN_SMS_TEMPLATE_LOGIN_OTP=
ALIYUN_SMS_TEMPLATE_VERIFY_PHONE=
ALIYUN_SMS_DRY_RUN=false

WECHAT_MINIAPP_APP_ID=
WECHAT_MINIAPP_SECRET=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_APP_ID=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_SECRET=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_TOKEN=
WECHAT_OFFICIAL_AES_KEY=
WECHAT_PAY_MCH_ID=
WECHAT_PAY_SECRET_KEY=
WECHAT_PAY_PRIVATE_KEY=
WECHAT_PAY_CERTIFICATE=
WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL=
WECHAT_PAY_PLATFORM_CERT=
WECHAT_PAY_PUB_KEY_ID=
WECHAT_PAY_PUB_KEY_PATH=

docs.title: 生成秘密
docs.text:
# APP_SECRET / REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET (32+ random bytes)
openssl rand -hex 32

# Strong DB passwords
openssl rand -base64 24

切勿提交 .env.local 或 .env.prod.local。保守生产秘密 提交的 .env 文件。

docs.title: JWT 密钥
docs.text:
容器入口点 docker/app/entrypoint.sh 管理密钥对：

  • 如果两个密钥都已存在，则它们将按原样重用。
  • 在非产品环境中，丢失的密钥会自动生成到 标准路径（2048 位 RSA）并保留在已安装的 ./var/jwt 下 目录（主机上的var/jwt）。私钥是用mode写的 600。
  • 在 prod (APP_ENV=prod) 中，缺少键会中止启动并出现错误 — 必须首先在主机上生成密钥。

开始之前在主机上生成生产密钥：

mkdir -p var/jwt
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out var/jwt/jwt_private.pem -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048
openssl rsa -pubout -in var/jwt/jwt_private.pem -out var/jwt/jwt_public.pem
chmod 600 var/jwt/jwt_private.pem

如果私钥有密码，则设置JWT_PASSPHRASE .env.prod.local。

docs.title: 构建图像
docs.text:
Dockerfile 的目标是一个小的最终图像（约 90 MB）： php:8.4-fpm-alpine + 扩展（pdo、pdo_mysql、intl、zip、 opcache) + 作曲家。首先安装依赖项（缓存层） composer install --no-dev --no-scripts，然后复制应用程序源并 --no-dev --optimize 自动装载机已转储。 var/ 创建并拥有 www-data。

# Dev — build and start everything
docker compose up -d --build

# Explicit env file (custom ports / credentials / integrations)
cp .env.example .env.docker.local
docker compose --env-file .env.docker.local up -d --build

# Production
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build

不要将生产机密放入提交的 .env 文件中。

docs.title: 首次运行和迁移
docs.text:
开发（覆盖自动应用）：

docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin

生产：

docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin

迁移链也经过 CI (.github/workflows/migrations.yml) 验证， 它针对新的 MySQL 8.4 从头开始应用每次迁移，并且 检查doctrine:migrations:status。

有用的迁移命令：

docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status   # pending?
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate   # apply

docs.title: 健康检查
docs.text: 两个端点都位于 src/Core/Controller/HealthController.php 中并且是 公共（在 /api 防火墙之外），因此协调器和负载均衡器 可以在没有令牌的情况下轮询它们。

docs.title: /health/live
docs.text: 活性探针。当 PHP 可以服务时总是回答 200 {"status":"ok"} 请求。用它来检测楔入过程。

docs.title: /health/ready
docs.text:
就绪探针。回应：

// 200 — ready
{"status": "ok", "checks": {"database": "ok", "redis": "ok"}}
// 200 — ready, redis optional
{"status": "ok", "checks": {"database": "ok", "redis": "disabled"}}
// 503 — degraded
{"status": "degraded", "checks": {"database": "error", "redis": "ok"}}
  • database — SELECT 1 通过默认的 Doctrine 连接。错误是 记录，从不回显（避免将驱动程序详细信息泄露给匿名呼叫者）。
  • redis — 无依赖性 TCP PING（RESP PING → +PONG）。已报道 当OTP_REDIS_DSN为空时disabled，否则ok/error。

仅当数据库为 ok 并且 redis 为时，服务才准备就绪 ok 或 disabled。在测试环境中Redis探针被迫 disabled 用于确定性 CI 结果。

nginx 容器健康检查通过完整堆栈使用 /health/ready， 因此，绿色的 nginx 容器意味着应用程序 + DB（+ 可选的 Redis）是可访问的。

docs.title: 调度程序命令
docs.text:
scheduler 服务取代了 cron 作业。它永远循环，运行 下面的命令，然后休眠 OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL （默认 5 秒）：

命令 模块 目的 app:trade:outbox:publish 贸易 将待处理的 trade.order.created.v1 / trade.order.cancelled.v1 事件发布到 Messenger app:store:outbox:publish 商店 发布待处理的商店集成事件 app:inventory:outbox:publish 库存 发布待处理的库存集成事件 app:inventory:reservations:release-expired 库存 释放过期库存预订 app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due 结算 将需要重试的分配过帐重新排队 app:settlement:outbox:publish 结算 发布待处理的结算整合事件

每个发件箱发布者都遵循相同的模式 (src/{Module}/Command/PublishOutboxCommand.php)： 可标记行通过租约 (claim()) 声明，并根据已知进行验证 主题，使用版本化信封分派到 messageBus 上，然后 markPublished()；失败会被延迟并显示错误消息并重试 稍后。该循环可以容忍崩溃的迭代（每次运行都干净地退出），使得 作为计划作业运行是安全的。

docs.title: 有用的命令
docs.text:
开发（生产变体添加 -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local）：

docker compose logs -f app                       # tail app logs
docker compose exec app php bin/console about    # run a Symfony command
docker compose exec app bash                     # shell into the app container
docker compose exec app php bin/console cache:clear
docker compose ps                                # service / health status
docker compose down                              # stop everything
docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build   # reset (WARNING: deletes all data)

docs.title: 部署后验证
docs.text:
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health/live
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health/ready
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"identifier":"admin@example.com","password":"P@ssw0rd"}'

应用程序：http://localhost:8080 — Swagger UI：http://localhost:8080/api/doc。

docs.title: 升级
docs.text:
发展：

git pull
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose exec app php bin/console cache:clear

生产：

git pull
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console cache:clear

docs.title: 自定义 nginx 配置
docs.text:
将 docker/nginx/default.conf 替换为您自己的配置。常见变化：

  • 添加 TLS/SSL 证书并监听 443
  • 将 server_name 更改为您的域名
  • 添加速率限制或IP白名单

然后只重建 nginx：

docker compose up -d --build nginx

默认配置通过 index.php （前端控制器）路由 location /， 通过 FastCGI 将 ^/index\.php(/|$) 转发到 app:9000，internal 是 PHP 位置（从未直接提供），为任何其他 .php 文件返回 404，以及 client_max_body_size 上限为 20m。

docs.title: Development Contracts
docs.text: The rules that keep the modular monolith coherent: layer boundaries, cross-module communication, service boundaries, naming, code style, performance, and security. These are the developer-facing companion to the normative design docs (docs/design/system-architecture.md, docs/design/system-contracts.md, docs/design/module-design.md, docs/design/naming-convention.md).

docs.title: 1. Layer Rules
docs.text:
Requests move through a strict, one-directional chain:

HTTP (Controllers / View mixins)  →  Service  →  Repository  →  Entity  →  Infrastructure
Rule From To Allowed? Why R1 Controller Service YES Normal flow R2 Controller Entity YES Type hints / returns only R3 Controller Repository NO Go through Service R4 Controller EntityManager NO Go through Service R5 Service Repository YES Data access R6 Service Entity YES Domain operations R7 Service EntityManager YES Transactions R8 Service Other Services YES DI, interface-first R9 Entity Repository NO Entities are pure R10 Entity Service NO No business-logic deps R11 Entity EntityManager NO Persistence is external

docs.title: Transaction contract
docs.text:
• Transactions live in the Service layer only — controllers never call beginTransaction() / commit() / rollback() (T4).
  • Multiple mutations on related entities are wrapped in wrapInTransaction() (T1).
  • Wallet transfers use explicit beginTransaction/commit/rollback with entity locks (PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) (T2), and the EntityManager is recovered after a rollback with an $em->isOpen() guard (T3).
  • Mixin-driven mutations (createAction, batchUpdateAction) wrap automatically unless @partial=true. @partial=true processes each item independently; otherwise all items commit or roll back together.

docs.title: Where exceptions are thrown and caught
docs.text:
Layer May throw Must catch Entity NO — Repository Doctrine exceptions only — Service Business exceptions (InsufficientFundsException, OrderInvalidTransitionException, …) — Controller NO — convert to warning() domain exceptions → warning() with 400/404/500

Unhandled exceptions on /api/* turn into JSON {code, message, class} via the ExceptionInterceptor (bypassed in dev).

docs.title: 2. Cross-Module Communication
docs.text:
Modules share one kernel, one EntityManager, one cache, and one Messenger bus — but must behave as if they were independent services.

Concern Contract Doctrine associations No cross-module associations. An entity never references another module's entity as a relation/FK Durable references Reference aggregates across modules by UUID (App\Core\Utils\UUID) or an explicitly documented business key — never a local auto-increment id Contracts in, scalar data out Cross-module service calls exchange scalars / snapshots / DTOs only — never entities, repositories, or an EntityManager Writes Outbox: the publishing module persists a *OutboxMessage entity in the same transaction as the change; a app:{module}:outbox:publish command flushes it to Messenger Reads Inbox / message handlers: consuming modules read another module's state through their own MessageHandler/ handlers, which enforce integrity and idempotency Direct repository reads across modules Forbidden Dependency direction Business modules may autowire Core and (interface-first) each other; Core must never import a business module; circular module dependencies are forbidden

docs.title: Messenger routing (async transport)
docs.text: Registered messages include: Trade order created/cancelled / store accepted/rejected, Inventory reservation request/confirm/reject/release, Settlement funding-confirmed and allocation-posting. Handlers live in the consuming module's MessageHandler/ directory (e.g. src/Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler.php, src/Inventory/MessageHandler). Failure transport is failed with a 3-retry, doubling backoff.

docs.title: Registries for cross-cutting extension instead of direct wiring
docs.text: Hot-swappable collaborators are collected with tagged iterators and resolved through a registry — not hard-wired: PaymentGatewayRegistry (payment.gateway), PaymentAdjustmentRegistry, DepositProviderRegistry, WithdrawProviderRegistry, MediaStorageRegistry, SettlementContextResolverRegistry, and the trade.price_calculator pricing chain (priority-ordered, Promotion at 60).

docs.title: Service shape
docs.text:
• Every service implements a module interface: {Entity}ServiceInterface extends App\Core\Service\BaseServiceInterface.
  • Implementations extend App\Core\Service\BaseService, which composes BaseServiceInfrastructureTrait (container/EM/repository/logger/serializer, transaction wrapper, validators), BaseServiceReadListTrait (get/list, QueryBuilder listing, DQL compilation), and BaseServiceMutationTrait (new/update/remove, relation/date mapping, Serializer + Validator integration).
  • Services must not return raw HTTP responses (controller's job) and must not touch Request directly — use getCurrentRequest().

docs.title: Repository shape
docs.text:
• Repositories extend ServiceEntityRepository, take ManagerRegistry in the constructor, and return entities/arrays/scalars.
  • Repositories must not return raw QueryBuilder to consumers — that is the service layer's concern — and may expose a *RepositoryInterface when consumed by other modules.
  • Doctrine 3.6+ repositories carry the @extends ServiceEntityRepository<...> PHPDoc (enforced by Rector's AddAnnotationToRepositoryRector).

docs.title: Controller shape
docs.text:
• App controllers (public read) extend RestController with ApiView, DetailApiViewMixin, ListApiViewMixin; they set $serviceClass and may override commonFilter() for row-level scoping. No create/update/delete.
  • Manage controllers (admin CRUD) add Create/Update/DeleteApiViewMixin and are guarded #[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')] at class level.
  • Controllers declare only module-specific constructor dependencies — RequestStack, SerializerInterface, TranslatorInterface, container arrive via #[Required] setter injection on RestController.

docs.title: 4. Naming Conventions
docs.text:
The namespace carries the module; the class name carries the domain concept. docs/design/naming-convention.md is authoritative; the four rules are:

# Rule N1 Class name = domain concept (bare preferred); ownership lives in the namespace N2 Add a module prefix only on (a) cross-module collision/ambiguity, or (b) intra-module infrastructure (outbox / registry / gateway / provider) N3 Service / Controller / Repository / Event / Exception strictly mirror the entity name: {Entity}Service, {Entity}Controller, {Entity}Repository N4 Prefix policy is consistent within a module — never a mix of prefixed and bare

docs.title: Protected cross-module conflict groups (never drop the prefix)
docs.text:
Concept Reserved class names Order Trade\Order, Store\StoreOrder User Identity\User, Wechat\WechatUser OutboxMessage Trade\TradeOutboxMessage, Store\StoreOutboxMessage, Inventory\InventoryOutboxMessage ConsumedEvent Store\StoreConsumedEvent, Inventory\InventoryConsumedEvent

(The 2026-08-15 prefix refactor removed Wallet*/Inventory*/Store* prefixes for unique concepts — WalletTransaction→Transaction, InventoryStock→Stock, StoreMembership→Membership — with zero migration or API breakage; table names, URLs and route names were unchanged.)

Forbidden: inventing a service suffix (CategoryService for an entity Category is fine, but adding an arbitrary XxxService name for a non-service class is not), inconsistent prefixes inside a module, non-mirrored controller/service names.

docs.title: 5. Code Style
docs.text: Area Rule PHP >= 8.4, declare(strict_types=1) in new code Properties / returns Explicit types, never docblock-only; nullable as ?Type Namespace PSR-4 App\ under src/ Use statements Alphabetically ordered Files One class/trait/interface per file, filename = classname Classes PascalCase; methods/properties camelCase; constants UPPER_SNAKE Interfaces *Interface suffix; abstracts Abstract* / Base*; traits *Trait or descriptive (ListApiViewMixin) Tests *Test suffix, namespaced App\Tests\... Comments PHPDoc on interfaces/abstract methods; no comments on self-documenting code; @deprecated + migration notes for removals

docs.title: 6. Performance
docs.text: Practice Where it shows up Paginate every list RestController::pagination() — default limit 100, Doctrine Paginator for QueryBuilder Project columns instead of fetching everything @select, @display (e.g. reduce = id + __toString only) Push filtering to the database Expression DSL compiles to DQL (ExpressionDqlParser); the in-memory fallback is only a fallback Avoid implicit relation loading Relations load lazily; expand relation trees explicitly via @expands Concurrent writes are guarded Wallet uses optimistic locking (version column) and pessimistic writes for transfers; token rotation uses reuse detection Costly lookup is indexed/short UUID/IAM references on aggregates; repositories expose targeted queries Bulk admin writes stay transactional @partial=true for per-item mode, else single-transaction Long-running work goes async Messenger async transport + outbox publish commands

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
• JwtAuthenticator extracts and validates the Authorization: Bearer JWT and builds the Passport; TokenManager issues/revokes tokens and manages refresh-token lifecycle.
＃ 规则 S1 访问令牌：RS256 签名、7200s TTL S2 刷新令牌：不透明，在数据库中进行 HMAC-SHA256 哈希处理，1 年 TTL S3 刷新令牌在每次使用时轮换 S4 重复使用已撤销/替换的刷新令牌会撤销所有用户的令牌 S5 已撤销的访问令牌 JTI 将被列入黑名单，直至自然到期 S6 私钥永远不会被提交 S7 生产中的 HTTPS

docs.title: 授权
docs.text:
• 访问控制集中在config/packages/security.yaml：/api/v1/manage → ROLE_ADMIN; /api→IS_AUTHENTICATED_FULLY；公共列表（授权流程， 注册、微信登录、付款通知、文档、GET /api/v1/public）是 PUBLIC_ACCESS。
  • 行级范围是通过 commonFilter()/listFilter() 覆盖的每个控制器 （例如，用户只能看到自己的记录；应用程序端过滤器强制执行）。 commonFilter() 可能会返回一个数组 (['user' => $this->getUser()]) QueryBuilder，或服务器拥有的DqlExpression，例如 new DqlExpression('entity.getUser() == this.getUser()') 或 new DqlExpression('entity.getStoreUuid() in storeUuids', ['storeUuids' => $allowed])。 DqlExpression 共享 @filter 语法（包括带有空的 in/not in） 集合安全），但故障关闭并且从不使用内存中回退。的 设计的 Authorization 捆绑包 (docs/design/bundles/authorization.md) 将在此基础上构建 用于范围 RBAC、存储范围授权、字段授权和审计日志记录的原语。
  • 管理控制器还带有类级别#[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')]。
  • 角色层次结构：ROLE_ADMIN: [ROLE_USER]。

docs.title: 验证顺序
docs.text:
Controller field whitelist ($requiredCreateProperties / $acceptedCreateProperties)
  → controller hook validation (processCreateContent / processUpdateContent)
    → @transform expression
      → Service::update() → Symfony Validator → entity #[Assert\*] constraints

docs.title: 速率限制
docs.text:
资源 限制 OTP 请求（每部电话） 每 60 秒冷却时间 1 次 OTP 验证（每部手机） 最多尝试 5 次

由 Redis (OTP_REDIS_DSN) 或本地缓存后备 (LocalCacheOtpStorage) 支持。

docs.title: 记录卫生
docs.text:
• PUT/POST 上的请求正文记录在 INFO 中，用户 ID、URI、正文被截断为 1 KB。
  • 切勿在生产中记录明文密码、令牌、OTP 代码或 PII。
  • 通道：app、doctrine（开发）、security。

docs.title: 金钱和身份
docs.text:
• 货币是整数美分或固定规模的量子（QuantumAmount，18 位十进制， brick/math) — 永远不会浮动。
  • 跨模块的聚合引用是 UUID——绝不是原始 FK 或自动增量 id。

docs.title: 8. 重大变更政策
docs.text: 改变 允许吗？ 具有默认实现的新 mixin 特征/钩子 是的，已记录 更改钩子签名/删除 mixin 方法/更改响应信封 否 — 主要版本 添加查询参数 是（向后兼容） 删除支持的查询参数 否 — 弃用 + 主要版本 更改 BaseServiceInterface 否 — 跨模块影响评估 添加模块 是的，遵循模块清单 (docs/design/module-design.md)

docs.title: 9. 另请参阅
docs.text:
• Development Workflow — 分支、CI、静态分析门
  • Testing — 套件、助手、90% 覆盖率门
  • API Contracts — 信封、身份验证、URL、分页、webhooks
  • Architecture — 模块模型和模式的实用概述
  • 规范性合同：docs/design/system-architecture.md、system-contracts.md、 module-design.md、naming-convention.md、controller-design.md、每个模块 docs/design/bundles/*.md

docs.title: 开发工作流程
docs.text: 如何在 CI 中对该存储库进行分支、审查、分析和验证。按照这个 处理每一项更改，从单行修复到新模块。

docs.title: 1. 分支模型
docs.text:
该存储库使用基于主干的流程和长期集成分支：

main  ──────────────────────────────────────────────►  stable / release (PR target)
   \                                                /
    └── dev ───────────────────────────────►  integration (PR target for features)
           \
            ├── feat/xxx         feature branch (merged into dev)
            ├── fix/yyy          bug-fix branch (merged into main or dev)
            └── chore/zzz        tooling / docs / refactor branches
分公司 目的 CI 运行于 main 稳定的树干；只有经过审查、测试、迁移验证的代码才会出现在此处 推 + 拉请求 dev 发布前功能积累的集成分支 仅 pull_request (ci/migrations)，推送文档部署 feat/*、fix/*、chore/* 短期工作分支，每个 PR 一个 pull_request（定位 main/dev）

规则：

  • 切勿直接推送到 main 或 dev。 所有更改均通过拉取请求到达。
  • 针对 main（版本、修补程序）或 dev（功能、较大更改）打开 PR。
  • 经常变基或合并，使分支保持接近目标。
  • 较新的推送取代了对同一 PR 或分支的正在进行的检查（CI 已配置） 与 concurrency: cancel-in-progress: true）。

docs.title: 2. 编码标准
docs.text:
所有工具都需要 PHP 8.4+。

要求 标准 PHP版本 >= 8.4 (composer.json require.php) 命名空间 PSR-4 App\ 位于 src/ 下，App\Tests\ 位于 tests/ 下 标量/返回类型 尽可能明确；新代码中需要严格类型 (declare(strict_types=1)) 物业类型 显式（绝不仅限文档块） 可空 ?Type 语法 使用语句 按字母顺序排列 每个文件一个类 文件名等于类/特征/接口名称 评论 PHPDoc 仅针对接口和抽象方法；对自文档化代码没有评论 命名 参见naming convention——模块命名空间携带所有权，服务/控制器/存储库镜像实体名称

docs.title: 3.静态分析
docs.text: 静态分析的运行方式与 CI 的运行方式完全相同——在本地，它们必须在 PR 之前是绿色的。

docs.title: 3.1 PHPStan（8 级）
docs.text:
composer phpstan

在phpstan.neon中配置：

设置 价值 水平 8 路径 src/ 排除 src/*/Exception/*、src/Identity/Sms/AliyunSmsProvider.php 引导程序 vendor/autoload.php Symfony 集成 vendor/phpstan/phpstan-symfony/extension.neon（读作var/cache/dev/App_KernelDevDebugContainer.xml） 学说整合 vendor/phpstan/phpstan-doctrine/extension.neon 与 objectManagerLoader: phpstan-bootstrap.php PHPDoc 确定性 treatPhpDocTypesAsCertain: false（控制器使用特征混合中的$this->service/$this->get()） 通用物品箱 易微信AccessToken / Server合约

phpstan-bootstrap.php 启动一个最小的 App\Kernel 并返回 Doctrine EntityManager 因此 PHPStan 可以解析存储库/Doctrine 元数据。在 CI 中它运行 具有独立的 SQLite URL (var/phpstan.db)，因此它永远不会接触真正的数据库。

生成或刷新基线（仅当严格性要求强制时）：

composer phpstan-baseline

docs.title: 3.2 Rector（仅在 CI 中键入规则）
docs.text:
composer rector:types:check      # dry-run — the CI gate
composer rector:types            # actually apply the type rules

rector-types.php 在 src/ 上仅启用两个规则：

规则 它强制执行什么 AddAnnotationToRepositoryRector Doctrine 3.6+ 存储库必须携带 @extends ServiceEntityRepository<...> CompleteReturnDocblockFromToManyRector ->mappedBy/->inversedBy OneToMany/ManyToMany 返回 PHPDoc 集合

composer rector（更广泛的选择加入重构）不是 CI 的一部分 — 查看其差异 申请前请仔细：

composer rector      # dry-run of the broad rule set
composer rector:fix  # apply it

docs.title: 3.3 添加修复/基线条目
docs.text: 不要让 PHPStan 批发沉默。如果无法输入真正的边界情况，请添加 phpstan.neon 中的范围 ignoreErrors 条目 带有解释原因的注释 — 现有条目均带有解释（可选 SDK、特征混合、生命周期 回调）。

docs.title: 4. 提交约定
docs.text:
• 常规提交，仅英文。
  • 格式：type(scope): subject — 例如feat(settlement): add rule version diffing, fix(inventory): recover EM after rollback、test(wallet): cover concurrent transfers。
类型 用于 feat 新能力 fix 错误修正 refactor 行为保留重组 test 仅测试 docs 文档/评论 chore 工具、CI、依赖项、内务处理 ci 工作流程文件更改 perf 表演工作
  • 主语：祈使语气，无句号，小写（名词/专有名称除外）。
  • 正文（可选）：内容和原因，而不是如何。 Closes #123 的参考问题。
  • 保持每次提交的重点；每次提交一个逻辑更改。
  • 提交消息仅以英文书写——这是一条硬性规定。

docs.title: 5. 拉取请求清单
docs.text:
每个 PR 必须满足存储库模板 (.github/pull_request_template.md)：

  • [ ] Branch is up-to-date with main
  • [ ] Summary describes the change; related issues linked
  • [ ] Type of change flagged (bug / feature / docs / tests / refactor / CI / i18n)
  • [ ] ./vendor/bin/phpunit — all tests pass
  • [ ] Coverage does not drop below 90%
  • [ ] composer phpstan — Level 8 check passes
  • [ ] composer rector:types:check — no PHPDoc type changes required
  • [ ] Manual smoke test performed (described in the PR)
  • [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
  • [ ] New features include tests
  • [ ] API changes documented with #[OA\*] attributes
  • [ ] Behaviour changes reflected in docs/ai/context.md where appropriate
  • [ ] i18n translation keys added for new user-facing messages (en, zh, zh_Hant, ja)

docs.title: 6. CI Pipeline
docs.text: Three workflows live in .github/workflows/. All are path-triggered — unrelated changes do not re-run the whole pipeline.

docs.title: 6.1 ci.yml — PHPStan + PHPUnit (with coverage) + Rector
docs.text:
Triggers — push to main/master and pull requests against main, master, or dev, limited to these paths:

src/**            tests/**          config/**         migrations/**
bin/**            composer.json     composer.lock     symfony.lock
phpunit.dist.xml  phpstan.neon      phpstan-bootstrap.php
rector*.php       .env.test         .github/workflows/ci.yml

Jobs (PHP 8.4 on ubuntu-latest):

Job What it runs Notes phpstan composer phpstan DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///.../var/phpstan.db tests composer install → boot Postgres 16 service → create app_test_1..4 → run ParaTest with 4 workers + PCOV coverage → enforce 90% line threshold matrix: php: ['8.4'] rector composer rector:types:check (dry-run) DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///.../var/rector.db

The parallel test job in detail:

  1. shivammathur/setup-php with coverage: pcov, ini-values: pcov.directory=src — so PCOV measures only application code under src/.
  2. A postgres:16 service container is started with app/app_secret credentials and health checks.
  3. app_test_1 … app_test_4 databases are created via psql.
  4. Tests run with:
PCOV_ENABLED=1 PARATEST=1 php vendor/bin/paratest \
  --processes=4 --coverage-text=/tmp/coverage.txt --display-deprecations

Each ParaTest worker (tokens 1–4) gets its own Postgres database through PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE=postgresql://.../app_test_{token}?... — concurrent schema drops/creates can never race. 5. The 90% gate parses Lines: <pct> from the coverage text and fails via bc comparison if it drops below 90.0.

Full env for the tests job mirrors .env.test (JWT keys at tests/Identity/Security/, APP_ENV=test, MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN=doctrine://default?auto_setup=0, MAILER_DSN=null://null, OTP_REDIS_DSN, Aliyun SMS test values with dry-run on).

docs.title: 6.2 migrations.yml — MySQL migration chain
docs.text:
Triggers — push to main/master and PRs against main/master/dev, on migrations/**, config/**, bin/**, composer.json, composer.lock, symfony.lock, and the workflow file itself.

Job mysql-migration-chain:

  1. Start mysql:8.4 service (crud_skeleton_test database, user app/app).
  2. composer install with DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@127.0.0.1:3306/crud_skeleton_test?serverVersion=8.4&charset=utf8mb4.
  3. php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction --env=dev
  4. php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status --env=dev

This proves the full migration chain works against a real MySQL 8.4 instance (downstream of the schema-tool-based test schema).

docs.title: 6.3 docs.yml — Docs build & GitHub Pages deploy
docs.text:
Triggers — push to main/dev and PRs against main/master/dev, on docs/**, README*.md, scripts/build-docs.sh, scripts/translate-docs.py, mkdocs.yml, and the workflow file itself.

Job Runs on Action build pull_request only pip install mkdocs-material deep-translator → bash scripts/build-docs.sh (bilingual site build) deploy push only same build, then peaceiris/actions-gh-pages publishes ./site to the gh-pages branch

scripts/translate-docs.py + build-docs.sh produce the bilingual (English/Chinese) mkdocs site — do not bypass it by committing generated files.

docs.title: 7. Local vs CI Database
docs.text:
Context Database How it is isolated tests job (CI) PostgreSQL 16 (app_test_1..4) one DB per ParaTest token Local parallel run SQLite per worker (var/test_paratest_{pid}.db) one file per process Local serial run SQLite (var/test.db) single file

tests/bootstrap.php decides: if PARATEST=1 and no explicit DATABASE_URL template is provided, it switches each worker to its own var/test_paratest_{pid}.db and eagerly creates the schema. When CI provides PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE, it substitutes the worker token instead. An explicit DATABASE_URL from the real environment is never clobbered by the sqlite fallback.

Coverage is always measured with PCOV (PCOV_ENABLED=1 / coverage: pcov). Xdebug-based coverage (XDEBUG_MODE=coverage) works locally but is not used in CI.

docs.title: 8. Definition of Done
docs.text:
A change is done when, on top of the PR checklist:

  1. composer phpstan — Level 8 clean (no new baseline entries without justification).
  2. composer rector:types:check — no required type-rule changes.
  3. ./vendor/bin/phpunit (or PARATEST=1 ./vendor/bin/paratest --processes 8 --runner WrapperRunner) — green, coverage ≥ 90% Lines.
  4. Migration chain verified against MySQL (CI migrations.yml job).
  5. OpenAPI #[OA\*] attributes updated for any endpoint change.
  6. User-facing strings have translation keys (en, zh, zh_Hant, ja).

docs.title: 从整体中提取服务
docs.text:
CRUD Skeleton 是一个 单一模块化整体 — 一个 Symfony 应用程序，一个作曲家 项目，一棵带有命名空间模块的 src/ 树（App\Trade、App\Wallet、 App\Settlement，...）。它不是一个多应用程序单一存储库。本指南解释了 如何使用一个模块并将其变成一个独立的服务/应用程序 以现有模块边界为蓝图。

好消息：代码库的设计使这成为可能。的 结算 ↔ 钱包关系是服务的一个工作示例 边界看起来像。本指南正式化了该过程。

docs.title: 1.预提取规则
docs.text: 在移动任何代码之前，模块必须已经是边界干净的。以下 三个规则使得拔牙变得机械化而不是手术化。

docs.title: 1.1 无跨模块学说关联
docs.text:
实体决不与另一个实体中的实体保持 ORM 关联 模块。没有 ManyToOne/OneToMany 属性指向外部 模块，并且不同模块拥有的表之间没有外键。

检查是否有违规行为：

# In the module you intend to extract, grep for cross-module entity imports
rg "use App\\\\(Trade|Payment|Store|Inventory|Identity)\\\\Entity" src/Settlement

目标模块中的每个表都必须是独立的。跨模块查找 是通过 UUID 或标量引用 手动完成的，而不是通过连接键。

docs.title: 1.2 UUID 引用而不是对象/ID 链接
docs.text:
实体内部的外部身份是一个包含远程信息的纯字符串列 聚合的 UUID，不是数据库级外键，也不是对象引用。

src/Settlement/Entity/SettlementAllocation.php 是典型的例子：

#[ORM\Column(name: 'uuid', type: 'string', length: 36)]
private string $uuid;

#[ORM\Column(name: 'plan_uuid', type: 'string', length: 36)]
private string $planUuid;

#[ORM\Column(name: 'rule_version_uuid', type: 'string', length: 36, nullable: true)]
private ?string $ruleVersionUuid;
  • 本地行保留整数代理键 (id) 和 UUID。
  • 远程身份存储为 string(36) UUID 列，并建立索引以供查找。
  • 永远不要假设引用的行存在；服务层重新验证。

使用类型/id 对来表示事物是所使用的模式 结算合约 — SettlementSubject 是 type : id 作为字符串：

final readonly class SettlementSubject
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $type,
        public string $id,
        public string $version,
    ) { }
}

docs.title: 1.3 跨边界的标量合约
docs.text:
模块通过接口和不可变的 DTO 进行交互——绝不是通过 实例化另一个模块的实体或调用另一个模块的服务 直接。跨模块合约位于 Contract/ 中（只读值对象） 和 Port/ （消费者实现或注入的接口）。

结算定义了它需要的边界：

  • src/Settlement/Contract/* - ConfirmedAllocation，PostedAllocation， ReversalRequest、VoucherPostingReceipt、SettlementSubject、...全部 final readonly class 仅包含标量的 DTO。
  • src/Settlement/Port/SettlementVoucherPort.php — 拥有的接口 结算，由托管方（钱包）执行：
interface SettlementVoucherPort
{
    public function post(ConfirmedAllocation $allocation): VoucherPostingReceipt;
    public function reverse(PostedAllocation $allocation, ReversalRequest $request): VoucherPostingReceipt;
}

该实现位于消费者自己的命名空间中： src/Wallet/Integration/Settlement/WalletSettlementVoucherPort.php。主持人 模块拥有实现；消费模块拥有该接口。

规则 1.3 的结果： 一个只涉及 Contract/* 的模块 来自其他模块的 Port/* 可以被取出并指向不同的主机 实现（一个 HTTP 客户端、另一个服务、测试中的假冒），无需 改变自己的代码。

docs.title: 2. 选择模块并映射其边界
docs.text:
src/Settlement 是第一次提取的最佳候选者，因为它是 最独立的。它的布局是模板：

src/Settlement/
├── Command/          # app:settlement:* console commands (scheduler loop)
├── Context/          # SettlementContextResolver registry pattern
├── Contract/         # immutable cross-module DTOs (scalar-only)
├── Controller/       # API controllers (Manage/ namespace)
├── Entity/           # Doctrine entities — self-contained tables
├── Exception/        # module exception hierarchy
├── Integration/      # Fake/ and Fixture/ test doubles
├── Message/          # Messenger message classes (async)
├── MessageHandler/   # MessageHandler::__invoke consumers
├── Port/             # interfaces the module depends on (implemented elsewhere)
├── Repository/       # Doctrine repositories
├── Resources/config/ # services_settlement.yaml (service wiring)
└── Service/          # domain services + *ServiceInterface aliases

其他模块遵循相同的形状（钱包、贸易、库存、商店……）， 每个都有相同的子命名空间。唯一的区别是细节——例如 钱包将 Service/ 拆分为 Deposit/、Withdraw/、Transfer/、 Payment/功能文件夹并具有应用程序Controller/和管理Controller/。

docs.title: 映射依赖关系
docs.text:
对于每个模块，有两个列表：

  1. 它依赖于其他什么 — 合约、端口和消息 进口。对于结算，这些是无；只取决于它自己 Contract//Port/。 （钱包则相反：它实现 SettlementVoucherPort并消耗App\Settlement\Contract\*。）
  2. 其他人依赖它 - 谁实现它的端口 (App\Wallet\Integration\Settlement\WalletSettlementVoucherPort)，谁 使用它的合约，以及它的哪些消息被路由到 config/packages/messenger.yaml。

“依赖于其他”列表为空（或仅合同）的模块是 可按原样提取。端口指向的模块（结算←钱包）保留 它的域并在接线时交换端口实现。

docs.title: 每个模块的提取清单
docs.text:
• [ ] 模块内没有 use App\...\Entity 跨模块导入
  • [ ] 所有跨模块引用都是Contract/*和Port/*
  • [ ] 每个出站事件都是一个 OutboxMessage 行 + Messenger 消息
  • [ ] 每个入站事件均从收件箱/已消耗事件表中消耗
  • [ ] 命令名称遵循 app:{module}:{...} 并列在 compose.yaml 中
  • [ ] Resources/config/services_{module}.yaml 保存所有模块接线
  • [ ] config/services.yaml App\|: 自动装配仅排除基础类

docs.title: 3. 创建应用程序骨架
docs.text:
创建一个新的独立 Symfony 应用程序（或在 monorepo 中创建一个新的 Composer 包） 顶级）将托管该模块：

composer create-project symfony/skeleton settlement-service
cd settlement-service
composer require symfony/orm-pack symfony/messenger symfony/translation

您正在复制的内容（按顺序）：

  1. src/Kernel.php — MicroKernel 引导程序。
  2. composer.json — 自动加载 PSR-4 地图："App\\": "src/"。
  3. config/services.yaml — 导入模块配置+全局自动装配。
  4. 模块配置接线（参见Wiring）。

框架故意被最小化：没有 templates/，没有 webpack，什么都没有 API 框架超出了模块实际使用的部分。

docs.title: 4.移动代码
docs.text:
将模块的目录物理移动到新应用程序中：

# Inside the new app
mkdir -p src
mv ../crud-skeleton/src/Settlement src/Settlement

因为模块是命名空间隔离的 (App\Settlement\...)，所以命名空间 零重命名后保持有效。保留它 App\Settlement 除非你愿意 重命名新服务的根命名空间；如果这样做，命名空间重命名是 机械查找/替换。

docs.title: 移动必须跟随的部分
docs.text: 随模块一起发货 示例（结算） 实体+存储库 Entity/*、Repository/* 领域服务 Service/*、Service/Money/* 服务接口+别名 *ServiceInterface + services_settlement.yaml 控制器 Controller/Manage/* 控制台命令 Command/PublishOutboxCommand.php、RequeueDuePostingCommand.php 消息+处理程序 Message/*、MessageHandler/* 合同和港口 Contract/*、Port/* 测试双打 Integration/Fake/*、Integration/Fixture/* 模块迁移文件 migrations/Version2026...*.php（结算表）

docs.title: 留下
docs.text:
• 其他模块拥有的端口实现。 钱包的 WalletSettlementVoucherPort 留在整体中（或者变成一个小的 萃取上游的适配器）。结算从不直接进口； 这取决于接口App\Settlement\Port\SettlementVoucherPort。
  • 任何非特定于模块的全局自动装配 (config/services.yaml App\: 块，_instanceof 标记规则）。这些仅以新的形式移动 应用程序需要自己的模块。

docs.title: 5. 基线迁移
docs.text:
该模块的表当前位于单体的单一迁移中 历史。在提取之前，生成一个基线，以便新服务可以 仅从其自己的模式开始。

  1. **将创建/修改模块表的所有迁移压缩为一个 新应用程序内的新 Version{time}BaselineSettlement.php：
final class Version20260820000000BaselineSettlement extends AbstractMigration
{
    public function up(Schema $schema): void
    {
        // CREATE TABLE settlement_plan (...)
        // CREATE TABLE settlement_rule (...)
        // CREATE TABLE settlement_allocation (...)
        // ... module tables only
    }
}

  1. 从整体迁移中删除模块的表语句 导出数据的直接迁移之后的历史记录。保留 Monolith 的历史线性：提取版本带来了一次迁移 将数据迁移出去后，新服务会进行一次基线迁移。

  2. 从第一次部署新服务时将 version_control 设置为开启： doctrine:migrations:version --add --all 应用基线后，或 latest_as_of 在迁移配置中，因此独立历史记录匹配 内置架构。

  3. 使用与 .github/workflows/migrations.yml 相同的作业模式进行验证： 将链从头开始应用于新的 MySQL 8.4 并断言 doctrine:migrations:status 报告最新的基线。

docs.title: 6. 接线
docs.text:
在新应用程序中重现模块的服务接线。每个模块都拥有一个 已包含其依赖关系图的配置文件：

  • src/Core/Resources/config/services.yaml
  • src/Identity/Resources/config/services_identity.yaml
  • src/Settlement/Resources/config/services_settlement.yaml
  • ...每个模块一个

src/Settlement/Resources/config/services_settlement.yaml 显示模式：

services:
    _defaults:
        autowire: true
        autoconfigure: true

    App\Settlement\Service\SettlementServiceInterface:
        alias: App\Settlement\Service\SettlementService

    # ...

    App\Settlement\Port\ClockInterface:
        alias: App\Settlement\Service\SystemClock

    App\Settlement\Port\SettlementVoucherPort:
        alias: App\Wallet\Integration\Settlement\WalletSettlementVoucherPort   # <-- host impl

    when@test:
        services:
            App\Settlement\Integration\Fake\InMemorySettlementVoucherPort:
                public: true
            App\Settlement\Port\SettlementVoucherPort:
                alias: App\Settlement\Integration\Fake\InMemorySettlementVoucherPort

从 config/services.yaml 导入：

imports:
    - { resource: '../src/Settlement/Resources/config/services_settlement.yaml', ignore_errors: true }

docs.title: 重新指向端口
docs.text:
在整体中，SettlementVoucherPort 的别名为 App\Wallet\Integration\Settlement\WalletSettlementVoucherPort。在新的 服务，端口必须解析为随服务一起提供的实现：

  • 迁移过程中：如果您也移动了电子钱包适配器，请保留它 进入新应用程序（它拉入钱包实体/服务 - 事实上是一个钱包 提取也）。
  • 独立服务：针对新服务自己实现端口 存储或对钱包服务的出站 HTTP 调用：
final class HttpSettlementVoucherPort implements SettlementVoucherPort
{
    public function post(ConfirmedAllocation $allocation): VoucherPostingReceipt { /* POST to wallet.svc /api/... */ }
    public function reverse(PostedAllocation $allocation, ReversalRequest $request): VoucherPostingReceipt { /* ... */ }
}

并更改 services_settlement.yaml 中的别名。无结算代码 变化——这就是端口间接的全部意义。

docs.title: 消息传递
docs.text: 将 config/packages/messenger.yaml 中的模块条目移动到新应用程序 （例如routing: App\Settlement\Message\SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage: async）。 在整体中，删除这些路由，如果模块的消息现在是 流程外交付，通过集成取代剩余的消费者 点（webhook/HTTP 调度或共享传输）。

docs.title: 调度程序和控制台命令
docs.text:
已导出的命令 (app:settlement:...) 由 scheduler服务于compose.yaml。在新的部署中：

  • 从整体的scheduler循环中移除沉降线。
  • 在运行的新服务中添加scheduler（或主机cron） app:settlement:outbox:publish 和 app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due 在相同的循环模式上：
while :; do
  php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction
  php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
  sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
done

docs.title: 7. 测试
docs.text:
The module already ships its own test doubles, so the new service can test the module in complete isolation:

  • App\Settlement\Integration\Fake\InMemorySettlementVoucherPort — implements the host port with no database.
  • App\Settlement\Integration\Fixture\FundingSnapshotContextResolver — a tagged settlement.context_resolver fixture for integration tests.

Reuse the monolith's testing conventions (see docs/design/system-contracts.md §7 and docs/testing/crud-skeleton-production/):

Contract Requirement Coverage ≥ 90% line coverage, enforced in CI Test DB Clean schema per test, built by schema tool Unit tests PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase — no kernel Kernel tests IntegrationKernelTestCase — booted kernel Web tests IntegrationWebTestCase — full HTTP cycle when@test wiring Ports/fakes + when@test sections in the module config

Copy the relevant test files from tests/UnitTest/Settlement and tests/Integration that exercise the module, then delete them from the monolith. Static analysis stays identical:

composer phpstan            # Level 8, isolated SQLite DATABASE_URL
composer rector:types:check # Rector type rules dry-run

docs.title: 8. CI
docs.text:
The monolith's CI is three jobs in .github/workflows/*. Re-produce them in the new repo:

Job Source workflow Command Static analysis ci.yml → phpstan composer phpstan (PHP 8.4, SQLite DB URL) Rector ci.yml → rector composer rector:types:check (SQLite DB URL) Tests ci.yml → tests Paratest with coverage ≥ 90%, PostgreSQL 16 Migrations migrations.yml Fresh MySQL 8.4 chain apply + status

Reference DATABASE_URL values used by CI:

# phpstan / rector (no DB server needed)
DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///%kernel.project_dir%/var/phpstan.db"

# tests matrix
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://app:app_secret@127.0.0.1:5432/app_test?serverVersion=16&charset=utf8"
PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE="postgresql://app:app_secret@127.0.0.1:5432/app_test_{token}?serverVersion=16&charset=utf8"

# migrations
DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:app@127.0.0.1:3306/...?serverVersion=8.4&charset=utf8mb4"

docs.title: 9. Docker
docs.text:
Re-use the existing Dockerfile and compose layout as the template for the new service. The production picture after extraction:

# monolith compose.yaml — Settlement lines removed from scheduler's loop,
# Settlement messages removed from messenger routing
scheduler:
  command:
    - /bin/sh
    - -ec
    - |
      while :; do
        php bin/console app:trade:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:store:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:reservations:release-expired --no-interaction
        sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
      done

# settlement-service compose.yaml — same shapes, own database volume
services:
  app:
    build: .                     # same Dockerfile style
    environment: &app-env
      APP_ENV: prod
      APP_SECRET: ${APP_SECRET:?required}
      DATABASE_URL: "mysql://...@settlement-db:3306/..."
      MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN: ${MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN:?required}   # shared/broker
    volumes:
      - ./var:/var/www/html/var   # JWT keys + cache, persisted

  worker:
    extends: { service: app }
    command: ["php", "bin/console", "messenger:consume", "async", "--time-limit=3600", "--memory-limit=256M", "--no-interaction"]

  scheduler:
    extends: { service: app }
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -ec
      - |
        while :; do
          php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction
          php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
          sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
        done

  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports: ["${APP_PORT:-8081}:80"]      # separate port from the monolith
    volumes:
      - ./public:/var/www/html/public:ro
      - ./docker/nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O", "/dev/null", "http://localhost/health/ready"]

  settlement-db:
    image: mysql:${MYSQL_VERSION:-8.4}
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${MYSQL_DATABASE:-settlement}
      MYSQL_USER: ${MYSQL_USER:-app}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD:?required}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:?required}
    volumes: [settlement_db_data:/var/lib/mysql]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine

  mailer:
    image: axllent/mailpit

networks:
  internal:

volumes:
  settlement_db_data:

Key points carried over unchanged:

  • The entrypoint (JWT key bootstrap + prod validation) and healthcheck endpoints (/health/live, /health/ready) move with the app — they live in src/Core, so copy src/Core (or at least the parts the module uses) with the extraction.
  • nginx publishes on its own host port and health-checks through /health/ready.
  • Cross-service messaging is the only genuinely new piece: the two services either share a transport (same MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN broker) or the consuming service calls a port implementation via HTTP.
  • Production rollout is additive: deploy the new service, migrate the data (one cutover migration on the monolith, one baseline on the new service), then remove the module's scheduler lines, messenger routes, and tables.

docs.title: Practice: Settlement vs Wallet
docs.text:
Concern Settlement (extract first) Wallet (currently the host) Owns contracts Contract/*, Port/SettlementVoucherPort consumes App\Settlement\Contract\* Implements ports — Integration/Settlement/WalletSettlementVoucherPort DB tables settlement_* only, no FKs out wallet_*, voucher_*, transaction_*, ... Cross-module refs UUID columns (plan_uuid, rule_version_uuid) deposit('settlement', ...) + voucher fields Async edges outbox publish + SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage, SettlementAllocationPostingMessage consumes settlement postings synchronously via port Test seams InMemorySettlementVoucherPort, FundingSnapshotContextResolver — (it provides them)

Extracting Settlement = taking the domain, contracts, commands, and test doubles, implementing SettlementVoucherPort as an HTTP/queue adapter, and shipping its baseline migration + CI + compose. Because Wallet only ever touches Settlement through Contract/* and Port/SettlementVoucherPort, the monolith side needs no business-logic changes — only the alias in services_settlement.yaml (which leaves the monolith) and the messenger routing entries (which leave the monolith).

Extracting Wallet (a later step) then uses the identical recipe, with the extra step that the module that hosted its port (Settlement) must now call it remotely.

docs.title: 开始使用
docs.text: 此页面使应用程序运行并向您展示如何验证它的工作原理。 支持两种路径：Docker Compose（推荐，包含所有内容）和 本机 PHP（使用本地安装的 PHP 工具链）。

docs.title: 先决条件
docs.text:
工具 版本 目的 Docker 引擎 + Compose v2 最新稳定 运行完整的服务堆栈 (compose.yaml) PHP 8.4+（项目约束>=8.4） 本机设置； CLI 需要 pdo_mysql、openssl、zip、intl 扩展 作曲家 2.x 依赖关系和自动加载管理 OpenSSL 任何最近的 生成 RSA JWT 密钥对 MySQL 8 客户端 8.x 可选 — 用于检查容器数据库的本机 mysql CLI

在装有 Homebrew 的 macOS 上，该项目已针对 PHP 8.5 进行了测试 (/opt/homebrew/opt/php)。 Homebrew 的 PHP 8.4 也可以工作 — 请参阅 Troubleshooting 如果 php 解析为旧版本。

docs.title: compose.yaml 中的服务
docs.text:
docker compose up -d --build 启动单个网络堆栈。只有nginx， database、redis和mailer发布主机端口； PHP 容器从来不会这样做。

服务 图像/构建 目的 主机端口（默认） app 从 Dockerfile 构建PHP-FPM 为 Symfony API 提供服务 — worker 同一张图片 async 传输的信使消费者 — scheduler 同一张图片 循环运行发件箱-发布和预订/结算管家 — nginx nginx:alpine PHP-FPM 的反向代理；服务 / → public/ ${APP_PORT:-8080}:80 database mysql:8.4 主存储（学说） 3306:3306 通过 compose.override.yaml redis redis:7-alpine 缓存、OTP 存储、速率限制器支持 — mailer axllent/mailpit 电子邮件捕获器（Mailpit UI） ${MAILPIT_UI_PORT:-8025}:8025

worker 和 scheduler extends: app，因此它们共享相同的图像和环境。 nginx 有一个到 GET /health/ready 的全路径就绪探测。

docs.title: Docker 快速入门
docs.text:
# 1. Build images and start every service
docker compose up -d --build

# 2. Apply the latest database schema
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction

# 3. Create an administrator account (email, screen name, password)
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:authorization:seed

这足以登录并使用 API。最后一行种子授权权限/角色/字段授予（幂等；请参阅Authorization Setup）。 JWT密钥对已生成 在第一个容器上自动由 docker/app/entrypoint.sh 启动 var/jwt/。首次运行不需要环境文件 - compose.yaml 提供安全的开发默认值。

常用后续命令：

# Tail app logs
docker compose logs -f app

# Reset the database (dev only)
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:schema:drop --force
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction

# Stop the stack (keep volumes)
docker compose down

docs.title: 本机 PHP 设置
docs.text:
可选的 compose.override.yaml 绑定源树并公开 MySQL 和 Mailpit 本地，但您也可以直接在主机上运行所有内容：

# 1. Install dependencies (Docker is not required for this step)
composer install

# 2. Create your local environment file
cp .env .env.local

在执行后续步骤之前配置 .env.local：

APP_ENV=dev
APP_SECRET=your-secret
DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:!ChangeMe!@127.0.0.1:3306/app?serverVersion=8.0&charset=utf8mb4"

JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=%kernel.project_dir%/var/jwt/jwt_private.pem
JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH=%kernel.project_dir%/var/jwt/jwt_public.pem
JWT_PASSPHRASE=
REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET=your-refresh-secret

docs.title: 生成 JWT 密钥对
docs.text:
JWT 身份验证器使用 RS256 签署访问令牌，因此私有/公共 RSA 对 是必需的。在 var/jwt/ (.gitignored) 下创建它：

mkdir -p var/jwt

# Private key (optionally guarded by a passphrase)
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 \
  -out var/jwt/jwt_private.pem

# Public key derived from the private key
openssl rsa -in var/jwt/jwt_private.pem -pubout -out var/jwt/jwt_public.pem

# Restrict permissions: the private key must not be world-readable
chmod 600 var/jwt/jwt_private.pem

如果您设置了 JWT_PASSPHRASE，请使用以下命令重新运行私钥生成 -aes256 和（可选）-pass pass:...，并将 JWT_PASSPHRASE 设置为相同 .env.local 中的值。

docs.title: 创建数据库并运行迁移
docs.text:
php bin/console doctrine:database:create
php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate

docs.title: 提供 API 服务
docs.text:
php -S localhost:8000 -t public/

APP_ENV=dev中内置的服务器足以满足本地工作；该应用程序也完全 nginx 背后的功能（请参阅 docker/nginx/default.conf 了解生产形态）。

docs.title: JWT 环境变量
docs.text:
变量 默认（撰写） 目的 JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH /var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_private.pem 用于签署访问令牌的 RSA 私钥 (PEM) 的路径 JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH /var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_public.pem 用于验证的 RSA 公钥 (PEM) 的路径 JWT_PASSPHRASE （空） 保护私钥的可选密码 REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET dev-refresh-secret-change-me 用于刷新令牌散列和轮换的 HMAC 秘密 ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL 7200（秒） 访问令牌生命周期 REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL 31536000（秒） 刷新令牌生命周期

相关可选变量：OTP_REDIS_DSN、ALIYUN_*（短信）、WECHAT_* （微信登录/支付）、MAILER_DSN、MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN、INVENTORY_ENABLED。 完整参考请参见.env.example。

docs.title: 验证设置
docs.text:
# Swagger UI (also available at http://localhost:8000/api/doc natively)
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/doc | head -c 200

# Health/readiness returns JSON when the app, DB, and Redis are reachable
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health/ready

登录并捕获令牌：

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"P@ssw0rd"}'

使用返回的 token 进行经过身份验证的调用：

curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/v1/profile \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"

docs.title: 故障排除
docs.text: Symptom Likely cause Fix Doctrine\DBAL\Exception\DriverException: could not find driver The pdo_mysql PHP extension is missing Check php -m \| grep -i mysql. On macOS Homebrew: brew install php bundles it; ensure /opt/homebrew/opt/php/bin/php is first on PATH JWT ... key not found / 401 on protected routes JWT keys not generated, or paths mismatch .env.local Run the openssl commands above and verify JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH / JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH are absolute and point at existing PEM files Permission denied when the app reads the private key Private key mode too open chmod 600 var/jwt/jwt_private.pem (it is git-ignored) Address already in use: 8080 / 8000 Another process occupies the port docker compose — set APP_PORT=8090 docker compose up -d; native — pick another port, e.g. php -S localhost:8001 -t public/ php is an old version (e.g. 7.4) on macOS Homebrew php not linked/first Run /opt/homebrew/opt/php/bin/php bin/console ... or PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/php/bin:$PATH" php ... Migrations fail with Unknown database 'app' Database not created docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:database:create (native: run the same without exec) Mail not arriving Mailpit not running or wrong DSN Native: start Mailpit (docker compose up -d mailer) and use MAILER_DSN=smtp://127.0.0.1:1025; check the UI at http://localhost:8025

docs.title: 国际化 (i18n)
docs.text: 该项目使用 Symfony 的翻译组件来处理面向用户的字符串和 通过构建管道自动将文档翻译成中文。 本文档涵盖这两个系统。

docs.title: 1.1 配置
docs.text:
config/packages/translation.yaml：

framework:
    default_locale: zh
    translator:
        default_path: '%kernel.project_dir%/translations'
        providers:
  • 翻译从 translations/ 加载。
  • default_locale 是 zh — 不携带区域设置信号的新请求 解析为简体中文。
  • 消息存储为名为 messages.{locale}.yaml 的 YAML 文件。

docs.title: 1.2 支持的语言环境
docs.text:
语言环境 文件 语言 en translations/messages.en.yaml 英语 zh translations/messages.zh.yaml 中文（简体） zh_Hant translations/messages.zh_Hant.yaml 中文（繁体） ja translations/messages.ja.yaml 日语

这四个代码是规范的SUPPORTED_LOCALES src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php。

docs.title: 1.3 键约定——英文字符串是键
docs.text:
翻译键是原始英文消息字符串本身，而不是 符号ID：

# translations/messages.en.yaml
"Wallet": "Wallet"
# translations/messages.zh.yaml
"Wallet": "钱包"

因此 messages.en.yaml 主要是文档 - 它将每个键映射到 本身 - 因为 Symfony 的翻译器会在不存在时退回到返回密钥 找到翻译了。该文件记录了每个可翻译的字符串：

  • 实体名称（Category、Order、Transaction、...）
  • 实体字段名称（Id、Uuid、Name、Slug、camelCase → 纯文本）
  • 错误/状态消息用作异常键

docs.title: 1.4 翻译发生的地方
docs.text:
框架通过 $translator->trans($key) 在这些处读取消息 点：

网站 机制 异常响应 ExceptionInterceptor — /api/* 上的每个未捕获的异常都通过 $this->translator->trans($exception->getMessage()) 路由；异常消息是关键 控制器错误 RestController::warning()、AuthController::error()、OtpController::error()、LoginController::error()都经过翻译器 JWT 失败 JwtAuthenticator::onAuthenticationFailure() 在返回 JSON 之前转换错误 实体元数据 /system/entities/{entityName} 翻译字段描述（例如 createdAt → 创建时间）

因此，呈现了抛出 new \RuntimeException('Insufficient funds') 的服务 如果 "Insufficient funds" 存在于相应的请求语言环境中 区域设置文件。

docs.title: 2. 区域设置检测
docs.text:
src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php 在 kernel.request 运行（优先级 20) 并应用以下决议顺序：

flowchart TD
    A[Request] --> B{_locale query param?}
    B -- yes, supported --> C[setLocale canonical]
    B -- yes, unsupported --> D[silently ignored<br/>request keeps default locale]
    B -- no --> E{Accept-Language header?}
    E -- yes --> F[parse by q-weight,<br/>highest supported wins]
    E -- no --> G[request keeps default_locale `zh`]
  1. ?_locale= 查询参数 — 最高优先级。支持的值 (en、zh、zh_Hant、ja) 直接应用；不受支持的一个是 被忽略（请求保留其现有区域设置）。这也会短路 标题检查。
  2. Accept-Language header — 已解析（尊重 q 权重，最高的在前） 并映射到规范的语言环境：
标头值 规范 zh-CN、zh-Hans zh zh-TW、zh-HK、zh-Hant、zh-Hant-TW zh_Hant en-US、en-GB en ja-JP、ja_JP ja

裸露的 zh/en/ja/zh_Hant 也可以解析（它们位于 直接SUPPORTED_LOCALES）。映射表为LOCALE_MAP 听众。 3. 后备 — 如果没有任何匹配项，请求将保留框架 default_locale，配置为zh。

注意：听众的 PHPDoc 和 README（§“国际化”）说 后备是en。实际运行时配置 config/packages/translation.yaml设置了default_locale: zh，所以不支持 或缺少语言环境信号当前解析为 简体中文，而不是 英语。如果更改 default_locale，请同时更新配置和 评论保持一致。

仅处理主要请求（$event->isMainRequest()）；子请求 （ESI 等）保持不变。

docs.title: 3.1 向现有语言环境添加新密钥
docs.text:
1. 使用英文字符串作为messages.en.yaml中的key（key = value）。
  2. 将与翻译后的值相同的键添加到messages.zh.yaml中， messages.zh_Hant.yaml、messages.ja.yaml。 3、服务层抛出异常/返回消息；的 现有的拦截器/控制器路径会为您翻译它。

docs.title: 3.2 添加新语言
docs.text:
1. 创建translations/messages.{locale}.yaml。 Symfony 自动发现文件 在 translations/ 目录中 — 不需要配置注册。
  2. 将区域设置代码添加到 SUPPORTED_LOCALES，如果您需要详细代码 像 xx-XX 一样映射到它，添加一个条目到 LOCALE_MAP src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php。

docs.title: 4. 翻译文档管道
docs.text: 文档（docs/，英文 Markdown）通过 a 镜像到 docs-zh/（中文） 脚本，并且两者都通过 mkdocs 内置到双语静态站点中。

docs.title: 4.1 scripts/translate-docs.py
docs.text:
使用免费的 deep-translator Google 端点镜像 docs/ → docs-zh/ （无 API 密钥）。

  • 先决条件： pip install deep-translator
  • 用途： 
    python scripts/translate-docs.py                          # full mirror
python scripts/translate-docs.py design/bundles/payment.md # single file
  • 跳过research/和ai/目录。
  • 保留：YAML frontmatter、围栏代码块、内联代码、HTML 注释、 图像和链接 - 每个都在翻译之前“隐藏”并在翻译之后恢复， 所以代码和 URL 永远不会被破坏。
  • 将正文拆分为段落并按块进行翻译（< 4500 个字符到 遵守免费 API 限制）。失败的块保留为原始英语 带有 WARN 行。

docs.title: 4.2 scripts/build-docs.sh
docs.text:
完整的双语版本（bash scripts/build-docs.sh）。它：

  1. 运行 translate-docs.py（文档 → 文档-zh）。
  2. 复制不应翻译的二进制/文本资源（assets/、 research/、openapi/、ai/、javascripts/)从docs/到docs-zh/。
  3. 从单个 mkdocs.yml 生成两个 mkdocs 配置：
  4. mkdocs-en.yml — 英语，site_dir: site，添加语言 alternate 链接 (/crud-skeleton/ ↔ /crud-skeleton/zh/)。
  5. mkdocs-zh.yml — docs_dir: docs-zh、site_dir: site/zh、 主题 language: zh，通过静态 MAP 翻译的导航标签 (Home → 首页, Wallet → Wallet (钱包), ...) 未知短标签的谷歌翻译后备。
  6. 构建两者，mkdocs build -f ... --clean。

输出：

网站 配置 URL（本地预览） 英语 mkdocs-en.yml site/index.html 中文 mkdocs-zh.yml site/zh/index.html

topic/nav 的真实来源是 mkdocs.yml （site_name: CRUD Skeleton，Material 主题，美人鱼支持来自 extra_javascript）。生成的mkdocs-en.yml / mkdocs-zh.yml是 构建工件 - 编辑 mkdocs.yml （以及 build-docs.sh 中的 MAP）并 重新运行脚本。

docs.title: 4.3 翻译自述文件
docs.text:
该存储库还提供手动维护的翻译自述文件变体（请参阅自述文件） §“国际化”）：

语言 文件 中文（简体） README.zh-cn.md 中文（繁体） README.zh-hant.md 日语 README.ja.md

这些独立于 docs-zh/ 机器翻译并得到维护 手动。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• API字符串：key为translations/messages.*.yaml中的英文消息字符串； 四个区域设置（en、zh、zh_Hant、ja），默认 zh。
  • 检测：?_locale= → Accept-Language（q 加权，通过映射 LOCALE_MAP) → 框架default_locale。
  • 文档：docs/→docs-zh/通过translate-docs.py；双语网站建立者 build-docs.sh 分为 site/ 和 site/zh/。

docs.title: 集成事件（发件箱/收件箱模式）
docs.text:
本项目中的模块（交易、店铺、库存、结算、钱包、支付）共用一个 内核、一个 Doctrine EntityManager 和一个 Messenger 总线，但它们不得触及 彼此的实体或存储库。跨模块通信是事件驱动的 持久：模块通过发件箱发出它拥有的事实，并消耗*来自其他模块的事实 通过 收件箱** 模块，通过 Symfony Messenger 连接。

该模式可防止两种故障模式：

  • 丢失事件 — 事件被写入与业务相同的数据库事务中 更改（事务发件箱），因此即使进程在运行中终止，它也永远不会丢失。
  • 重复交付 — 消费者在同一事务中记录消费事件行 作为业务效果，以 eventId （幂等收件箱）为键。
flowchart LR
    subgraph Producer["Producer (module A)"]
        A[Business operation]
        O[Outbox table<br/>*_outbox_message]
        P[Publish command<br/>app:*:outbox:publish]
    end

    subgraph Consumer["Consumer (module B)"]
        H[Worker / handlers]
        I[Inbox table<br/>*_consumed_event]
        B[Business effect]
    end

    A -- "same DB transaction" --> O
    O -- "poll + claim" --> P
    P -- "Messenger 'async'<br/>(Doctrine transport)" --> H
    H -- "same DB transaction" --> I
    H -- "apply" --> B
  • 生产者端（发件箱）： *OutboxService::record(topic, aggregateType, aggregateId, payload) 将一行插入模块的 *_outbox_message 表中。发布命令 （app:<module>:outbox:publish，每个模块一个）轮询表、声明行、构建 一个信封，并将 Messenger 消息分派到 async 传输上。
