  • 消费者端（收件箱）： #[AsMessageHandler] 验证信封，检查 模块的 *_consumed_event 表用于 eventId，并且在一个数据库事务内 应用效果并记录消耗事件行。

docs.title: 1. 传输配置
docs.text:
config/packages/messenger.yaml：

framework:
    messenger:
        failure_transport: failed          # dead-letter queue (doctrine://default?queue_name=failed)

        transports:
            async:
                dsn: '%env(MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN)%'   # default: doctrine://default?auto_setup=0
                options:
                    use_notify: true
                    check_delayed_interval: 60000
                retry_strategy:
                    max_retries: 3
                    multiplier: 2
            failed: 'doctrine://default?queue_name=failed'

        routing:
            App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCreatedMessage: async
            App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCancelledMessage: async
            App\Trade\Message\StoreOrderAcceptedMessage: async
            App\Trade\Message\StoreOrderRejectedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRequestedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationConfirmedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRejectedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleasedMessage: async
            App\Settlement\Message\SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage: async
            App\Settlement\Message\SettlementAllocationPostingMessage: async
  • 所有集成消息路由到单个 async 传输（一个 Doctrine 表 messenger_messages)，由 worker Compose 服务使用： messenger:consume async --time-limit=3600 --memory-limit=256M。
  • Messenger 应用自己的传输中重试（3 次重试，指数乘数 2）； 耗尽的消息将转到 failed 传输。
  • 发件箱在顶部添加了自己的声明/延迟层（请参阅 Publishing flow) 所以同一个信封永远不会被交给 Messenger 两次，即使两个调度程序发生争用。

docs.title: 2.1 消息类
docs.text:
大多数模块消息都是单个 array $envelope 的瘦 final readonly 载体：

final readonly class TradeOrderCreatedMessage
{
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $envelope */
    public function __construct(public array $envelope) {}
}
留言 制作者 消耗于 信封型 App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCreatedMessage 贸易发件箱 商店 ✅ envelope App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCancelledMessage 贸易发件箱 商店 ✅ envelope App\Store\Message… → StoreOrderAcceptedMessage、StoreOrderRejectedMessage 商店发件箱 贸易 ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRequestedMessage 商店发件箱 库存 ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage 商店发件箱 库存 ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationConfirmedMessage 库存发件箱 商店 ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRejectedMessage 库存发件箱 商店 ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleasedMessage 库存发件箱 商店 ✅ envelope App\Settlement\Message\SettlementAllocationPostingMessage 结算发件箱 结算 ❌ 显式字段（allocationUuid、planUuid） App\Settlement\Message\SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage 外部生产者（异步） 结算 ❌ 显式字段

位于 Target 模块命名空间中的 Store 消息类被导入到 生产者命令；例如StoreOrderAcceptedMessage/StoreOrderRejectedMessage 是 App\Trade\Message\* 类被 App\Trade\MessageHandler\* 使用，而 ReservationRequestedMessage/ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage 是 App\Inventory\Message\*被App\Inventory\MessageHandler\*消耗。

docs.title: 2.2 信封结构
docs.text:
发布命令从发件箱行组装版本化信封。贸易 出版商展示了最完整的形状：

$envelope = [
    'eventId'       => $message->getEventId(),                       // UUID v4, unique
    'type'          => str_replace('.v1', '', $message->getTopic()), // 'trade.order.created'
    'version'       => 1,
    'occurredAt'    => $message->getOccurredAt()->format(DATE_ATOM), // ISO-8601
    'aggregateType' => 'trade_order',
    'aggregateId'   => $message->getAggregateId(),                   // source aggregate uuid
    'correlationId' => $message->getAggregateId(),                   // trace scope
    'causationId'   => null,                                         // parent event (none at source)
    'payload'       => $message->getPayload(),
];
信封键 贸易 商店 库存 目的 eventId ✅ ✅ ✅ UUID v4；收件箱的幂等键 type ✅ ✅ ✅ 不带 .v1 后缀的主题 version ✅ ✅ ✅ 1 occurredAt ✅ — — 源事实何时发生 (ISO-8601 ATOM) aggregateType ✅ — — 来源聚合种类 aggregateId ✅ ✅ ✅ 源聚合 uuid correlationId ✅ — — 追踪范围（按 Trade 设置为订单 uuid） causationId ✅ — — 父事件 ID（源事件为空） payload ✅ ✅ ✅ 业务数据（数组）

aggregate_type、aggregate_id、payload、occurred_at、available_at、published_at、 attempts 和 last_error 也保留在发件箱表本身中。

和解 AllocationPostingMessage 和 SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage 代替 携带 显式标量字段 而不是信封（请参阅 Settlement flow）。

docs.title: 2.3 主题目录
docs.text: 主题（.v1后缀=版本） 发射器外箱 消费者 trade.order.created.v1 trade_outbox_message 商店 (TradeOrderCreatedHandler) trade.order.cancelled.v1 trade_outbox_message 商店 (TradeOrderCancelledHandler) store.order.accepted.v1 store_outbox_message 贸易 (StoreOrderAcceptedHandler) store.order.rejected.v1 store_outbox_message 贸易 (StoreOrderRejectedHandler) inventory.reservation.requested.v1 store_outbox_message 库存 (ReservationRequestedHandler) inventory.reservation.release.requested.v1 store_outbox_message 库存 (ReservationReleaseRequestedHandler) inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1 inventory_outbox_message 商店 (ReservationConfirmedHandler) inventory.reservation.rejected.v1 inventory_outbox_message 商店 (ReservationRejectedHandler) inventory.reservation.released.v1 inventory_outbox_message 商店 (ReservationReleasedHandler) settlement.allocation.post.requested.v1 settlement_outbox_message 结算 (SettlementAllocationPostingHandler) settlement.funding.confirmed.v1 —（异步，外部） 结算 (SettlementFundingConfirmedHandler)

docs.title: 3. 发布流程
docs.text:
每个带有发件箱的模块都有一个 Command/PublishOutboxCommand.php 注册为 app:<module>:outbox:publish。 compose.yaml 中的调度程序每隔 OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL（默认5）。

scheduler:
  extends:
    service: app
  command:
    - /bin/sh
    - -ec
    - |
      while :; do
        php bin/console app:trade:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:store:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:reservations:release-expired --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
      done

三个标准步骤（与贸易、商店、库存、结算相同）：

  1. 选择早于其 available_at 的未发布行 （findUnpublished() — published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= now ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 100）。
  2. Claim — claim($id, now + 1 minute) 运行一个原子 UPDATE … SET available_at = :until WHERE id = :id AND published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= now 仅当更新一行时才返回 true。这是并发防护： 第二个刻度（或重新启动的调度程序）将跳过其他工作人员已声明的行。
  3. 调度匹配的总线消息。成功markPublished()邮票 published_at。关于任何\Throwable（或不受支持的主题）defer($id, $error, now + 5 min) 递增 attempts，存储 last_error，并将 available_at 推出，以便该行 可以稍后重试。最后 EntityManager 被刷新一次。

Trade 的发布者还将主题列入白名单，并将其他任何内容视为不受支持的主题：

if (!in_array($message->getTopic(), ['trade.order.created.v1', 'trade.order.cancelled.v1'], true)) {
    $this->repository->defer($id, 'Unsupported Trade outbox topic: ' . $message->getTopic(), new \DateTimeImmutable('+5 minutes'));
    continue;
}

Inventory 发布者是异常值：它选择 数组投影 (findUnpublishedForPublishing()) 并标记通过直接发布/记录的尝试 存储库更新而不是通过工作单元，因此它不会刷新实体状态。

交付保证与订购。 交付至少一次并在 1 分钟内重试 索取租约和 5 分钟退让。尽最大努力在id之前按发件箱订购；消费者 必须是顺序容忍的（它们保护工作流/状态 can()），这正是 处理程序会这样做。

docs.title: 4.1 收件箱（消费事件）表
docs.text:
表 编号 事件 ID 有效负载跟踪列 store_consumed_event 大智 VARCHAR(36) 独特 aggregate_id、payload_hash(64) inventory_consumed_event 大智 VARCHAR(36) 独特 aggregate_id、payload_hash(64) settlement_consumed_event INT VARCHAR(64) 独特 source_aggregate_type、source_aggregate_id、payload_hash(64)

所有三个共享 topic、processed_at 和 payload_hash（JSON 编码的 SHA-256） 信封）。 Trade 没有收件箱表：它的处理程序由工作流程的保护 can(transition) 检查加上事务内的 store-uuid 快照匹配，因此 重复的 store.order.accepted.v1 / store.order.rejected.v1 是无操作。

docs.title: 4.2 eventId 的幂等性
docs.text:
规范的消费者形状 - 读取检查，然后在交易内重新检查，以及 以原子方式写入消耗的行，效果如下：

public function __invoke(TradeOrderCreatedMessage $message): void
{
    $eventId = $message->envelope['eventId'] ?? null;
    $payload = $message->envelope['payload'] ?? null;
    // ...validate...

    if ($this->consumedEventRepository->findOneBy(['eventId' => $eventId]) !== null) {
        return; // already processed
    }

    $this->entityManager->wrapInTransaction(function () use ($eventId, ...): void {
        if ($this->consumedEventRepository->findOneBy(['eventId' => $eventId]) !== null) {
            return; // re-check under the transaction (closes the race window)
        }
        $this->entityManager->persist(new StoreConsumedEvent(
            $eventId,
            'trade.order.created.v1',
            (string) ($payload['orderUuid'] ?? ''),
            hash('sha256', json_encode($message->envelope, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),
        ));
        // ...apply the business effect...
    });
}

库存进一步收紧。它的isAlreadyConsumed()比较存储的 payload_hash 以及使用 hash_equals 到达的信封的哈希值；一个重复使用的 eventId 具有 不同 有效负载会引发 InventoryMessageIntegrityException （“事件 ID 已与不同的有效负载一起重复使用”）。结算的exists($eventId)支票是 更简单：重复使用的 id 会被默默地跳过。

docs.title: 4.3 验证
docs.text:
处理程序在接触数据库之前会防御性地验证其信封：

  • type / version 完全匹配（例如 'inventory.reservation.released' / 1）。
  • 必需的键存在于正确的标量类型中（eventId 是 商店管理员；库存处理程序还要求它是格式正确的 UUID）。
  • 库存另外验证：aggregateId === payload['reservationId']， 每个 id 的 UUID 格式 ^[0-9a-f]{8}-…-[1-8]…-[89ab]…$，ISO-8601 时间戳 （允许使用小数秒）、唯一的线路 ID 和数量字符串匹配 ^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,6})?$。
  • 相关性交叉检查（例如ReservationReleaseRequestedHandler验证 信封中的 storeUuid / tradeOrderUuid / storeOrderUuid 与存储的匹配 保留，否则会抛出InventoryMessageIntegrityException）。
  • 使重试无害的业务防护：仅限ReservationConfirmedHandler 接受仍为 awaiting_inventory 且其 reservationId == payload['reservationId']； SettlementService::postAllocation() 对于已经 posted / cancelled / reversed 分配提前返回。

docs.title: 5. 相关性/因果关系追踪
docs.text:
• 交易 分配 correlationId = aggregateId （交易订单 uuid）和 causationId = null 在每个出站信封上 — 整个订单传奇（订单创建 → 店铺受理→库存预约→取消）共享该关联范围。
  • 结算 是唯一将跟踪保存到其域模型中的模块： SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage 带有 correlationId/causationId，并且 settlement_plan 存储 correlation_id 和 causation_id 列。的 SettlementFundingConfirmedHandler 将它们复制到 SettlementFunding 合约中。
  • 商店/库存信封不带有相关性/因果关系标头；血统是 根据有效负载相关键重建 - orderUuid、storeUuid、 tradeOrderUuid、storeOrderUuid、reservationId — 以及来自消费事件 aggregate_id 列。

docs.title: 6.1 贸易订单→商店→库存预订
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant T as Trade
    participant TO as Trade Outbox
    participant S as Store
    participant SO as Store Outbox
    participant I as Inventory
    participant IO as Inventory Outbox

    T->>T: OrderService::createOrder()<br/>(txn) workflow store_submit
    T->>TO: (txn) += trade.order.created.v1
    TO->>S: app:trade:outbox:publish → TradeOrderCreatedMessage
    S->>S: (txn) inbox += trade.order.created.v1
    alt store inactive
        S->>SO: (txn) += store.order.rejected.v1 (STORE_UNAVAILABLE)
    else INVENTORY_ENABLED=0
        S->>S: accept immediately
    else reserve
        S->>SO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.requested.v1
        SO->>I: app:store:outbox:publish → ReservationRequestedMessage
        I->>I: (txn) inbox += requested; InventoryService::reserve()
        alt shortfall
            I->>IO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.rejected.v1
        else success
            I->>IO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1
        end
        IO->>S: app:inventory:outbox:publish → ReservationConfirmed/Rejected
        S->>S: (txn) inbox += outcome; accept/reject storeOrder
        S->>SO: (txn) += store.order.rejected.v1 (if rejected)
        SO->>T: app:store:outbox:publish → StoreOrderRejectedMessage
        T->>T: workflow store_reject / store_accept
    end

docs.title: 6.2 订单取消→商店→库存释放
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant T as Trade
    participant TO as Trade Outbox
    participant S as Store
    participant SO as Store Outbox
    participant I as Inventory
    participant IO as Inventory Outbox

    T->>T: OrderWorkflowListener (transition 'cancel')
    alt order has store metadata
        T->>TO: (txn) += trade.order.cancelled.v1
        TO->>S: app:trade:outbox:publish → TradeOrderCancelledMessage
        S->>S: (txn) inbox += trade.order.cancelled.v1
        alt store order exists
            S->>S: cancel it
            S->>SO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.release.requested.v1
            SO->>I: app:store:outbox:publish → ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage
            I->>I: (txn) inbox += release.requested; InventoryService::release()
            I->>IO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.released.v1
            IO->>S: app:inventory:outbox:publish → ReservationReleasedMessage
            S->>S: inbox dedup only
        else store order missing
            S->>S: persist StoreTradeOrderCancellation (applied later)
        end
    end

docs.title: 6.3 过期预订
docs.text: app:inventory:reservations:release-expired → InventoryService::releaseExpiredReservations() 查找过去的 confirmed 预订 expires_at 并以原因 reservation expired 释放它们，从而重新进入 上面的标准 inventory.reservation.released.v1 发件箱流程。

docs.title: 6.4 结算分配过帐
docs.text:
结算是一个收件箱优先模块：资金确认从外部到达 显式字段消息。

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant P as External producer
    participant H as SettlementFundingConfirmedHandler
    participant S as SettlementService
    participant SO as Settlement Outbox
    participant A as SettlementAllocationPostingHandler
    participant V as Wallet voucher port

    P->>H: SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage (async)
    H->>H: dedup exists(eventId)
    H->>S: (txn) createPlanFromFunding()
    S->>S: build SettlementPlan + SettlementAllocation rows
    S->>SO: (txn) += settlement.allocation.post.requested.v1 (per allocation)
    H->>H: (txn) persist SettlementConsumedEvent
    SO->>A: app:settlement:outbox:publish → SettlementAllocationPostingMessage
    A->>A: mark posting_requested (flush first)
    A->>V: voucherPort->post() (posting_idempotency_key)
    alt success
        V-->>A: markPosted(reference)
    else retryable
        V-->>A: markRetryableFailure (next +60s)
    else fatal
        V-->>A: markFailed
    end
    A->>A: reconcilePlanState()
    Note over SO: app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due<br/>re-queues retryable_failure rows

结算重试循环使用的状态：分配planned → posting_requested → posted（终端cancelled/failed/reversed/reversal_pending）， retryable_failure喂养requeue-due。在测试装置中，凭证边界是 InMemorySettlementVoucherPort。

docs.title: 7. 操作注意事项
docs.text:
• 死信在failed传输上累积（messenger_messages与 queue_name = 'failed');发件箱行未发布，因此可以手动 重新排队或修复。
  • 卡住的行显示为带有非空 last_error 的 published_at IS NULL；他们是 在 available_at 通过后自动重新尝试。
  • 比赛安全依赖于有条件的索赔更新（published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= now），加上每个发件箱上的索引(published_at, available_at) 表（库存附加id）。
  • INVENTORY_ENABLED环境切换决定商店是否跳过库存 完全并立即接受订单，或等待 inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1。

docs.title: Project Structure
docs.text: Map of the repository and the conventions that keep it consistent. See Architecture for the rules that shape this layout.

docs.text:
crud-skeleton/
├── src/                    # All application code (PSR-4 namespace App\)
├── config/                 # Symfony + module routing & service configuration
├── migrations/             # Doctrine versioned migrations (DoctrineMigrations\)

├── var/                    # Cache, logs, JWT keys, test DBs (git-ignored)

├── templates/              # Twig templates (dev/profiler pages)
├── assets/                 # Asset-map sources (js/css imports)

docs.title: src/ — application modules
docs.text:
Each business module is a vertical slice. Core is the framework layer; all other modules plug into it.

docs.title: config/
docs.text:
config/
├── bundles.php                     # Enabled bundles (env-conditional)

docs.title: migrations/
docs.text:
Versioned Doctrine migrations (VersionYYYYMMDDHHMMSS.php) — the only acceptable way to change the schema. Migration classes are NOT autoloaded into App\; they use the DoctrineMigrations namespace. Generate new ones with:

php bin/console doctrine:migrations:diff
php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction

docs.title: tests/
docs.text:
PHPUnit suites are grouped by execution tier (phpunit.dist.xml):

tests/
├── UnitTest/       # Pure unit tests (fast, no container/db) — Core, Common, Identity,
│                   #   Trade, Store, Inventory, Payment, Promotion, Settlement,
│                   #   Storage, Wallet, Wechat
├── Integration/    # Kernel-aware integration & API regression tests (real HTTP-ish),
│                   #   e.g. CoreDynamicQueryApiTest, PaymentTradeIntegrationTest
├── LowValue/       # Lower-value/lighter suites run separately
├── Smoke/          # Smoke tests (e.g. Settlement)
└── Identity/Security/   # Auth-focused tests
    ├── bootstrap.php, IntegrationKernelTestCase.php, IntegrationWebTestCase.php

Run them:

vendor/bin/phpunit                       # UnitTest + Integration (default suite)
vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite="Low Value"
XDEBUG_MODE=coverage vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.dist.xml --testsuite="Project Test Suite"

docs.title: Naming Conventions
docs.text: Thing Convention Example Module namespace App\{Module}\ (StudlyCase module name) App\Trade, App\Wallet Controller namespace {Module}\Controller + a scope sub-namespace App\Trade\Controller\Manage\OrderController Controller scopes App (read-mostly user API), Manage (admin CRUD), Webhook (callbacks), Public, Staff Controller/Manage, Controller/Webhook Entity namespace {Module}\Entity App\Payment\Entity\Invoice Repository namespace {Module}\Repository App\Trade\Repository\OrderRepository Service namespace {Module}\Service App\Promotion\Service\PromotionService Service interface {Name}ServiceInterface beside the implementation OrderServiceInterface Message / handler {Module}\Message\*Message + {Module}\MessageHandler\*Handler ReservationRequestedMessage → ReservationRequestedHandler CLI commands Registered under app:{module}:{verb} app:identity:user:create, app:trade:outbox:publish Module DI file Resources/config/services_{module}.yaml services_settlement.yaml

docs.title: Where to Put New Code
docs.text: You are adding… Put it in A REST endpoint on an existing module src/{Module}/Controller/App/ (user) or Controller/Manage/ (admin) using a View mixin + a service method Business logic for an entity src/{Module}/Service/{Name}Service.php implementing {Name}ServiceInterface Domain object / persistence src/{Module}/Entity/ + src/{Module}/Repository/; schema change via a new migration in migrations/ A new repository query src/{Module}/Repository/{Entity}Repository.php (used from the service, never the controller) Cross-module data flow An outbox message in the source module (Entity/*OutboxMessage) + a MessageHandler/ in the consuming module; register the message in config/packages/messenger.yaml A new payment provider / deposit method Implement the module's interface and register it — payment.gateway tag, DepositProviderRegistry, WithdrawProviderRegistry, etc. A new pricing step Implement App\Trade\Service\Pricing\PriceCalculatorInterface and tag with trade.price_calculator A new module Copy the vertical-slice shape under src/{Module}/, register services in Resources/config/services_{module}.yaml, import its routes in config/routes.yaml Tests tests/UnitTest/{Module}/ (unit), tests/Integration/ (kernel), matching the tier conventions in phpunit.dist.xml

docs.title: 动态查询系统 — 完整参考
docs.text:
动态查询系统由BaseServiceReadListTrait::list()驱动 (src/Core/Service/Concern/BaseServiceReadListTrait.php) 和表达式 src/Core/Parser/ 加上 src/Core/Service/ExpressionService.php 中的引擎。 任何基于 ListApiViewMixin 构建的列表端点（或使用以下命令调用的任何服务） list(..., false) — 即 $disableRequest = false) 接受这些查询 GET 请求上的参数。

该系统有两层：

  1. SQL/DQL 层 — @filter、@dql、@order、@select、@groupBy、 @hints 被编译到 Doctrine QueryBuilder 中。
  2. 内存层 — @sort （当 DQL 编译失败时，还有 @filter 非管理员）在 PHP 中根据已获取的结果集进行评估。

docs.title: 1. 参数参考
docs.text:
参数 类型 等级 描述 示例 page 整数 SQL 页码（从 1 开始） 2 limit 整数 SQL 每页项目数（通过控制器默认 100；分页器遵循 page/limit） 20 @filter 表达 DQL + 后备 表达式 WHERE 子句 entity.status == "active" @dql 数据查询 SQL 用作 id IN (...) 的原始 DQL 子查询entity.price > 100 @order 列表 SQL 排序依据字段 createdAt\|DESC @select 列表 SQL SELECT 覆盖（投影） entity.id, entity.name @groupBy 表达 SQL GROUP BY 子句 entity.category @hints JSON SQL Doctrine 查询上设置的查询提示 {"hint.name": "value"} @sort 表达 内存中 内存比较器（仅限管理员） x.getPrice() <=> y.getPrice() @showDQL 布尔 信息 转储生成的 DQL（仅限开发） true @expands JSON 查看 嵌套关系扩展 (__metadata) category,tags @display 字符串 查看 响应投影：complex、reduce、JSON 投影 reduce @transform JSON 查看 基于表达式的内容转换（创建/更新操作） {"category": "Service.get(...)"} @partial 布尔 查看 禁用周围事务（创建/批量更新） true @mode 字符串 查看 批量更新模式：update / mixed (upsert) mixed @basis 列表 查看 批量更新/更新插入的匹配字段 id,sku

视图级参数（@expands、@display、@transform、@partial、 @mode、@basis) 由 RestController::success()/requestProcess() 应用 和创建/更新混合 - 它们不是 list() 本身的一部分，但是 在 CRUD 端点上对其进行补充。为了完整起见，本参考文献涵盖了它们。

docs.title: page / limit
docs.text:
对结果集进行分页。 RestController::pagination() 应用它们 服务器端（通过 Doctrine Paginator 通过 QueryBuilder 获得准确的 总计，或在数组/ArrayCollection 和 array_slice 上）。生成的 paginator 元数据如下所示：

{
  "total": 100, "page": 2, "limit": 20, "pages": 5,
  "has_previous": true, "has_next": true
}

docs.title: @filter
docs.text:
根据根别名 entity 计算的表达式。相同的语法是 可用作原始 QueryBuilder 片段（DQL 层）和内存中的片段 谓词（后备）。

支持的运算符（客户端 @filter 和服务器 DqlExpression 共享）：

操作员 意义 DQL 映射 == / != 等于/不等于 = / != > >= < <= 比较 相同 && / || 逻辑与/或 AND / OR ! 逻辑非（属性检查） prop IS NULL 对孩子 in / not in 收藏会员 IN (:param) / NOT IN (:param) — 绑定为数组参数；空 in [] 变为 1 = 0，空 not in [] 变为 1 = 1 matches 正则表达式 / LIKE REGEXP(...) = TRUE 或 LIKE '%...%' + - * / 算术 相同

字段引用是根别名加上点的吸气剂，例如 entity.status、entity.getCategory().getName()（链式属性访问 生成必要的连接）。裸属性（无运算符）编译为 prop IS NOT NULL。

示例：

# Equality
@filter=entity.status == "active"

# Comparison + logic
@filter=entity.price >= 100 && entity.status != "deleted"

# Chained attribute (joins category)
@filter=entity.getCategory().getName() == "Electronics"

# Regex match
@filter=entity.email matches "/@example\.com$/i"

# LIKE match (plain string pattern → %...%)
@filter=entity.name matches "pro"

# NOT — attr is null
@filter=!entity.deletedAt

访问和回退：需要内存中评估的@filter（例如 当 DQL 编译失败或过滤器触及非持久数据时） 仅限管理员。对于非管理员，会引发 DQL 编译错误 AccessDeniedHttpException；管理员回退到 每个实体上的LegacyEvaluator::evaluateBool()。

服务器拥有的 DqlExpression 与客户端 @filter：DqlExpression 重用 相同的表达式编译器，但变量绑定在 PHP 代码中（例如 new DqlExpression('entity.getUser() == user', ['user' => $this->getUser()]) 或new DqlExpression('entity.getStoreUuid() in this.getAllowedStoreUuids()') — 后者是显式绑定的简写，仅在内部可用 commonFilter() 通过 ApiView::resolvedCommonFilter()）。它从不使用 LegacyEvaluator，永远不会退回到内存过滤和编译 或元数据验证失败是一个 500 配置错误，拒绝 请求。与 commonFilter() 数组一样，它会自动使用 AND 编辑 id/uuid由mixIdToCommonFilter添加，因此无法进行详细/更新/删除 绕过了。带有空集合的 in/not in 被编译为常量 谓词 1 = 0 / 1 = 1 而不是无效的 IN ()。

docs.title: @dql
docs.text:
原始 DQL 子查询，其匹配 id 用作 id IN (subquery)：

@dql=SELECT e.id FROM App\Trade\Entity\Product e WHERE e.price > 100

仅限于ROLE_ADMIN。

docs.title: @order
docs.text:
排序依据字段。以逗号分隔的 field|DIRECTION 对：

@order=createdAt|DESC,id|ASC

如果您按链接路径排序（joiner 函数 寄存器 leftJoin）。非管理员注意： @order 本身没有门控，但是 DQL 编译必须是安全的。

docs.title: @select
docs.text:
覆盖 SELECT 子句（投影）。链式路径扩展为连接：

@select=entity.id, entity.name, entity.category.name

由 assertSafeSelect() 保护：选择 App\Identity\* 实体或 user|profile|password|roles|email|phone|phoneVerified|refreshToken|sessionKey|rawData 中的任何一个 引发 AccessDeniedHttpException （“@select 无法访问身份数据。”）。 当@select（或@groupBy）存在时，list()返回查询结果 直接而不是 QueryBuilder。

docs.title: @groupBy
docs.text:
附加 GROUP BY 子句：

@groupBy=entity.category

与 @select 一样，链式路径会自动连接并使用它直接返回结果。

docs.title: @hints
docs.text:
应用于执行查询的 Doctrine 查询提示的 JSON 对象：

@hints={"Doctrine\\ORM\\Query::HINT_FORCE_PARTIAL_LOAD": true}

仅限于ROLE_ADMIN。

docs.title: @sort
docs.text:
内存中比较器表达式使用 x 和 y 计算作为两个 正在比较的实体（使用 LegacyEvaluator::evaluateBool；真实的结果 首先对 x 进行排序）。因为它在 PHP 中运行，所以它仅限于 ROLE_ADMIN。

@sort=x.getTotalAmount() > y.getTotalAmount()

当存在 @sort 时，将应用 DQL 层过滤器结果，但排序 在内存中回退到usort。

docs.title: @showDQL
docs.text: 当为真时，端点不会返回结果而是抛出 ValidatorException('DQL: ' . $qb->getDQL())，显示为 JSON 错误 显示生成的 DQL。对于调试很有用。仅在 dev 中可用 环境（否则任何环境都会引发AccessDeniedHttpException）。

docs.title: 3.视图级参数
docs.text: 在查询之后应用，在 RestController::success()/requestProcess() 中，并且 在创建/更新 mixins 中。

docs.title: @expands
docs.text:
点关系的 JSON 数组（允许单引号，FixJSON 处理它们） 通过附加 __metadata 属性（对象本身）来扩展链 每个相关节点，因此平面序列化器可以包含它：

# GET /api/v1/manage/contents?@expands=['category','tags']

docs.title: @display
docs.text:
控制响应投影：

  • @display=reduce — 每个项目都变为{id, __toString}。
  • @display=<json array> — 例如['id','name','category.name'] 产生 具有请求字段的平面对象（通过 getter 遍历的虚线路径）。
  • @display=<json object> — 键是输出字段，值是 ExpressionLanguage 表达式用 entity、Math 计算，并且 ArrayCommon。
  • 省略（默认 complex） — 完整序列化实体。

示例：

# GET /api/v1/app/products?@display={"title":"entity.name","score":"Math.round(entity.price/100)"}

docs.title: @transform
docs.text:
由 CreateApiViewMixin、UpdateApiViewMixin 和 Single* mixins 使用。一个 JSON 对象将字段映射到重写的 ExpressionLanguage 表达式 提交的内容。 :value 替换为提交的字段值，并且 Service（相关实体服务的网关）、entity、Math、 ArrayCommon可用。

# POST /api/v1/manage/contents
# body:    {"title": "Hi", "category": "Test"}
# @transform={"category": "Service.get({'name': ':value'}).getId()"}

# GET /api/v1/manage/contents?@transform={"category":"Service.get({'name':':value'}).getId()"}

对于实体上的一对一关系，匹配的 *Service 通过以下方式自动解析 约定（类名中的 Entity → Service）。返回相关的 实体的 ID。

docs.title: @partial
docs.text: 布尔值。在创建和批量更新时，当 false （默认）整个批次是 包含在一笔交易中；当true每个项目单独处理并且 事务包装器被跳过（部分模式批量更新也会吞掉 每个项目的例外）。

docs.title: @mode和@basis（批量更新）
docs.text:
UpdateApiViewMixin::batchUpdateAction (POST /batch-update):

  • @mode=update — 仅更新现有匹配项。
  • @mode=mixed (默认) — upsert: 当不存在匹配的实体时创建。
  • @basis — 逗号分隔的字段，用于匹配每个字段的现有实体 提交的行（例如 @basis=id,sku）。当为空时，不发生匹配（事务 用于更新插入决策）。
# POST /api/v1/manage/products/batch-update?@basis=sku&@mode=mixed

docs.title: 4. list() 工作流程如何工作
docs.text:
（摘自BaseServiceReadListTrait::list()。）

  1. 构建 root — 带有 root 的服务实体类上的 QueryBuilder 别名entity；关联的 $object 数组变为 entity.key = :value_key 条件；传递的 QueryBuilder 按原样使用。
  2. @dql — 附加为 id IN (subDql)。
  3. @filter — 由ExpressionService::buildFilter()编译 → ExpressionDqlParser → ExpressionQueryBuilderAssembler;由此产生的 ids 通过 id IN (filterQb) 应用并合并参数。开 编译失败，非管理员获得AccessDeniedHttpException，管理员失败 回到内存过滤。
  4. @select / @groupBy — 应用； joiner 派生出 leftJoin 虚线路径。
  5. @order — 应用 (field|DIRECTION)，根据需要派生连接。
  6. @hints — 在执行的查询上设置。
  7. @showDQL — 使用生成的 DQL 抛出异常。
  8. 如果@select/@groupBy存在→返回查询结果。
  9. 否则返回 QueryBuilder （供控制器分页） — 或者， 当过滤器/订单回退到内存中时，获取结果并应用 @filter (evaluateBool) 和 @sort (usort) 超过它们。

docs.title: 5. 安全总结
docs.text:
Parameter Requires ROLE_ADMIN Notes @dql ✅ Raw SQL surface @sort ✅ In-memory evaluation @hints ✅ Raw query hints @filter only for the in-memory fallback DQL-fast-path is allowed; non-admin failures → AccessDeniedHttpException @showDQL ✅ (env-gated) dev only @select guarded, not gated assertSafeSelect() blocks identity data DqlExpression (commonFilter server scope) N/A — code-owned Fail-closed, never PUBLIC_ACCESS; compilation/validation failure → 500, never in-memory fallback

DqlExpression is the server-owned counterpart to @filter for row-level authorization: commonFilter() may return new DqlExpression(...); it shares the operator set (including in/not in) but is constructed in PHP, bound via withCriteria()/withContext() and validated before any query executes.

docs.title: 6. Operators & People Notes
docs.text:
• Chained attribute access uses the root alias entity.getX().getY() form in @filter; the DQL tier maps these to joins (filter_entity_x_y).
  • matches with a /pattern/flags value compiles to REGEXP(...) = TRUE (supported flags gimsux); a plain string compiles to LIKE '%...%' with ! escaping.
  • The ExternalExpressionValues available inside filter expressions include math/Math, datetime/Datetime, and ArrayCommon.

For parsing internals and class-level details, see core-framework.md (§4 Parser & Expression Engine).

docs.title: 媒体存储&七牛
docs.text: 本文档是可插拔媒体存储层的操作参考。 它涵盖了存储驱动程序、默认驱动程序选择、每次上传驱动程序 覆盖，以及如何启用可选的七牛科多驱动程序。

docs.title: 驱动程序
docs.text:
媒体上传支持多个存储驱动程序 App\Storage\Service\MediaStorageInterface。

司机 状态 笔记 local 内置 默认驱动程序。将文件存储在 public/uploads/{YYYYMM}/... 下并返回 /uploads/... 路径。 qiniu 可选 七牛科多兽司机。需要七牛PHP SDK和common_setting记录。

docs.title: 默认驱动程序
docs.text:
默认上传驱动程序由以下控件控制：

MEDIA_STORAGE_DEFAULT=local

docs.title: 每次上传覆盖
docs.text:
您可以通过发送名为 storage 的多部分表单字段来覆盖每次上传的驱动程序：

curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/manage/media/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "file=@/path/to/photo.jpg" \
  -F "storage=qiniu"

docs.title: 启用七牛
docs.text:
默认情况下故意不需要七牛SDK。仅将其安装在 使用 storage=qiniu 的部署：

composer require qiniu/php-sdk

使用 Docker：

docker compose exec app composer require qiniu/php-sdk

对于生产撰写命令，请包含您的生产撰写文件和环境文件：

docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local exec app composer require qiniu/php-sdk

docs.title: 七牛凭证
docs.text:
七牛凭证是从common_setting读取的，而不是从.env读取的。创建这些 使用驱动前的设置：

关键 价值 qiniu.access_key 七牛访问密钥 qiniu.secret_key 七牛秘钥 qiniu.bucket 桶名称 qiniu.domain 公共桶域，例如https://cdn.example.com

使用控制台命令创建任何缺失的键而不覆盖现有值：

php bin/console app:storage:qiniu:settings:init \
  --access-key=<access-key> \
  --secret-key=<secret-key> \
  --bucket=<bucket> \
  --domain=https://cdn.example.com

使用 Docker：

docker compose exec app php bin/console app:storage:qiniu:settings:init \
  --access-key=<access-key> \
  --secret-key=<secret-key> \
  --bucket=<bucket> \
  --domain=https://cdn.example.com

或者，通过管理设置 API 创建设置：

curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/manage/settings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[
    {"key":"qiniu.access_key","value":"<access-key>","type":"string","groupName":"storage","label":"Qiniu Access Key"},
    {"key":"qiniu.secret_key","value":"<secret-key>","type":"string","groupName":"storage","label":"Qiniu Secret Key"},
    {"key":"qiniu.bucket","value":"<bucket>","type":"string","groupName":"storage","label":"Qiniu Bucket"},
    {"key":"qiniu.domain","value":"https://cdn.example.com","type":"string","groupName":"storage","label":"Qiniu Domain"}
  ]'

如果在未安装 SDK 的情况下使用 storage=qiniu，API 将返回一个明确的 运行时错误要求您安装 qiniu/php-sdk。

docs.title: 测试
docs.text: 测试套件如何组织和运行。该套房目前位于 默认运行中的 2224 个测试 · 7951 个断言，加上 477 个低值测试 默认情况下排除的。

docs.title: 1. 套房布局
docs.text:
测试位于 tests/ 下并命名为 App\Tests\...：

tests/
|-- bootstrap.php                    # env bootstrapping, DB isolation, paratest wiring
|-- UnitTest/                        # pure unit tests, no kernel, no DB
|-- Integration/                     # kernel + DB + HTTP tests, shared helpers
|-- LowValue/                        # audit-flagged tests, excluded by default
|-- Smoke/                           # long fuzzy smoke suites (Settlement/Nightclub)
`-- Identity/Security/               # JWT test keypair used by .env.test
目录 命名空间根 测试 大约。文件 tests/UnitTest App\Tests\UnitTest 实体、实用程序、DSL 引擎、升级策略、基于模拟的服务/控制器、工作流状态机 189 tests/Integration App\Tests\Integration 跨模块流、API 回归、发件箱/收件箱幂等性、并发性、运行状况/指标/速率限制端点 71 tests/LowValue App\Tests\LowValue 审计标记的重复项和覆盖率追踪测试 43

tests/Integration 还包含共享助手：

  • DatabaseBootstrapTrait.php
  • IntegrationKernelTestCase.php
  • IntegrationWebTestCase.php

加上 API 回归套件 (*ApiRegressionTest.php)、集成套件 (*IntegrationTest.php)，以及构建完整的 OpenAPI 集成测试 规范正在进行中。

docs.title: 2. phpunit.dist.xml
docs.text:
phpunit.dist.xml 是单个 PHPUnit 配置：

设置 价值 引导程序 tests/bootstrap.php 环境（强制） APP_ENV=test、KERNEL_CLASS=App\Kernel 失败 failOnDeprecation、failOnNotice、failOnWarning 全部 true 内存 memory_limit=512M （OpenAPI 集成在进程中构建完整的规范） 套房 Project Test Suite（单元测试 + 集成），Low Value（低值） 团体 low-value 全局排除每次运行 报道来源 src/ 和 ignoreSuppressionOfDeprecations，弃用触发器映射到 Doctrine/Symfony 弃用 API

Low Value 套件存在，因此排除的文件仍可被发现 --group low-value；由于适用全局排除，套件本身是空的 每次跑步。

docs.title: 3.1 DatabaseBootstrapTrait
docs.text:
由需要工作数据库的内核/Web 集成测试使用：

use App\Tests\Integration\DatabaseBootstrapTrait;

class MyKernelTest extends IntegrationKernelTestCase
{
    use DatabaseBootstrapTrait;

    public function testSomething(): void
    {
        $this->bootTestDatabase();
        // ...kernel is booted, schema is ready...
    }
}

bootTestDatabase() 的作用 - 每个进程一次（由静态标志保护）：

  1. 启动内核。
  2. doctrine:schema:drop --force --full-database（测试环境，安静）。
  3. doctrine:schema:create（测试环境，安静）。

该模式是从 Doctrine 模式工具 构建的，而不是从迁移构建的 - 也就是说 测试合同（见§6）。它还将 getKernelClass() 固定到 App\Kernel。

docs.title: 3.2 IntegrationKernelTestCase
docs.text: 扩展KernelTestCase的抽象基。直接将内核类解析为 App\Kernel （无自动加载器假设）并使用 createKernel() 公开 APP_ENV/APP_DEBUG 来自具有 test/true 默认值的环境。用它来 需要容器服务或数据库的内核引导测试。

docs.title: 3.3 IntegrationWebTestCase
docs.text:
抽象基础扩展 WebTestCase 用于完整的 HTTP 请求/响应测试。它的关键 另外：

$client = static::createAuthenticatedClient();
  • 启动内核，创建持久测试用户testauth@example.com （用户名 testauth、密码 TestPass123!、ROLE_ADMIN）（如果缺失），以及
  • 通过App\Identity\Security\TokenManager生成真正的JWT，然后
  • 注入 HTTP_AUTHORIZATION: Bearer <token> 作为服务器参数。

这满足了要求 IS_AUTHENTICATED_FULLY 的防火墙规则，无需重新处理 每个测试中的登录流程。

docs.title: 4. 测试类别
docs.text:
类别 底座/图案 目的 单位 PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase 隔离逻辑——无内核，无数据库 内核 IntegrationKernelTestCase (+ DatabaseBootstrapTrait) 启动内核、容器服务、数据库访问 网页 IntegrationWebTestCase 完整的 HTTP 请求/响应周期，带或不带 JWT 身份验证 回归 *ApiRegressionTest 跨模块的 API 合约稳定性 烟 tests/Smoke/（例如NightclubSettlementFuzzySmokeTest） 长期运行的模糊/属性烟雾套件

命名模式：{Class}Test.php、{Module}ApiRegressionTest.php、 {Module}IntegrationTest.php。

docs.title: 5.1 完整默认套件（串行）
docs.text:
./vendor/bin/phpunit

运行 tests/UnitTest + tests/Integration （low-value 组被排除 自动）。默认使用 SQLite var/test.db。

docs.title: 5.2 并行（推荐速度）
docs.text:
PARATEST=1 ./vendor/bin/paratest --processes 8 --runner WrapperRunner

大约。速度快 2-3 倍。 tests/bootstrap.php 为每个工作人员提供自己的 SQLite 文件 (var/test_paratest_{pid}.db)，急切地创建模式，并路由测试访问 记录到每个进程的文件（var/log/access-{pid}.log），因此并发工作人员永远不会 比赛。 CI 使用相同的机制，但每个工作人员有 4 个工作人员和一个 PostgreSQL 数据库 通过 PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE 的令牌 (app_test_1..4)。

docs.title: 5.3 单个文件
docs.text: ./vendor/bin/phpunit tests/UnitTest/Core/Service/BaseServiceInfrastructureTraitTest.php

docs.title: 5.4 低价值群体（默认排除）
docs.text:
./vendor/bin/phpunit --group low-value

这些保留作为参考和历史审计范围；他们不属于 CI门。

docs.title: 5.5 覆盖范围
docs.text:
覆盖范围仅在 src/ 上测量 (pcov.directory=src)。在CI中使用PCOV；为了 本地运行相同的标志适用：

PCOV_ENABLED=1 ./vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text

或使用 Xdebug（速度较慢，不需要 PCOV 扩展）：

XDEBUG_MODE=coverage ./vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text

HTML 报告：

XDEBUG_MODE=coverage ./vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-html var/coverage
# open var/coverage/index.html

docs.title: 5.6 90% 覆盖率门
docs.text: CI 在 src/ 源集上强制执行 最小 90% 的行覆盖率。 tests 工作 使用 --coverage-text 运行 paraTest，提取 Lines: 图，并导致构建失败 如果低于90.0（与bc相比）。将 90% 视为底线，而不是目标 — 新 代码应该进行涵盖其行为的测试，尤其是错误路径。

docs.title: 6. 测试数据库合约
docs.text:
规则 详情 环境 APP_ENV=test、KERNEL_CLASS=App\Kernel（在 phpunit.dist.xml 中强制） 默认数据库 SQLite (var/test.db)，无需外部服务 CI数据库 PostgreSQL 16，每个 ParaTest 令牌一个数据库 架构 从 Doctrine 架构工具 (doctrine:schema:create) 创建 - 绝不是从本地测试中的迁移创建 清洁度 DatabaseBootstrapTrait 每个进程删除并重新创建一次模式；每个测试/类别测试种子装置 隔离 每个 ParaTest 工作线程都针对自己的数据库运行；串行运行共享 var/test.db 但每次测试都会刷新

所需的测试配置来自.env.test：

APP_SECRET='$ecretf0rt3st'
DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///%kernel.project_dir%/var/test.db'
INVENTORY_ENABLED=0
JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=.../tests/Identity/Security/test_private.pem
JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH=.../tests/Identity/Security/test_public.pem
JWT_PASSPHRASE=''
ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL=7200
REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL=31536000
REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET=test_refresh_secret_key_32bytes
OTP_TTL=300
OTP_REDIS_DSN=redis://localhost:6379/0
ALIYUN_*  # SMS values with ALIYUN_SMS_DRY_RUN=true
# WeChat:*  # left empty — WeChat is disabled for tests

docs.title: 7. CI 中的静态分析和覆盖门
docs.text:
.github/workflows/ci.yml中的tests作业是权威门：

Set up PHP 8.4 (ext pdo_pgsql, coverage: pcov)
  → composer install
  → start postgres:16, create app_test_1..4
  → PCOV_ENABLED=1 PARATEST=1 php vendor/bin/paratest \
      --processes=4 --coverage-text=/tmp/coverage.txt --display-deprecations
  → extract "Lines: <pct>%" → fail if < 90.0

PHPStan 和 Rector 门是独立的作业（phpstan、rector）。参见 development-workflow.md 用于完整管道。

docs.title: 8. 故障排除
docs.text:
症状 原因/修复 Missing DATABASE_URL / 未找到表格 加载引导程序后运行（phpunit 自动执行此操作）；使用 sqlite 默认值时不要设置真正的 DATABASE_URL 架构上的平行跑比赛 tests/bootstrap.php仅在PARATEST=1时隔离数据库；不要将项目级 DATABASE_URL 与并行运行混合在一起，除非提供了 PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE 添加代码后覆盖率低于阈值 为新的源代码行添加测试；检查 var/coverage/index.html 测试中的 JWT 错误 确保 JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH/JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH 指向 tests/Identity/Security/ 密钥对和 JWT_PASSPHRASE='' OpenAPI 测试中的内存耗尽 memory_limit=512M预设在phpunit.dist.xml中；仅在实际扩展规范时提出

请参阅测试质量合同 以及标记低价值测试的审计 。

docs.title: Order And Payment API Flow
docs.text:
This document is for frontend integration of the user order, payment, cancellation, and refund flow.

Base path: /api/v1

Auth: app endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <access_token> unless explicitly noted.

Response envelope:

{
  "data": {},
  "code": 0,
  "message": "SUCCESS"
}

Amounts are stored as integer cents/fen. For example, 1234 means 12.34 CNY.

docs.title: Order Status
docs.text:
Status Meaning Frontend meaning draft Order created but not submitted/confirmed Created, not payable yet pending Submitted and waiting for confirmation Ready for user/backend confirmation confirmed Confirmed and can start payment Payable paid Payment completed Paid, waiting fulfillment fulfilled Order shipped/fulfilled Waiting completion/receipt completed Order completed Completed, refundable by backend flow cancelled Order cancelled Cancelled refunded Order fully refunded Refunded

Order workflow:

stateDiagram-v2
    draft --> pending: submit
    pending --> confirmed: confirm
    confirmed --> paid: pay
    paid --> fulfilled: fulfill
    fulfilled --> completed: complete
    completed --> refunded: refund
    draft --> cancelled: cancel
    pending --> cancelled: cancel
    confirmed --> cancelled: cancel

Cancellation is allowed only from draft, pending, or confirmed.

Refund is allowed only from completed.

docs.title: Invoice Status
docs.text:
Status Meaning Frontend meaning pending Invoice created but payment not started Waiting payment start paying Payment started, waiting gateway result Waiting user payment or gateway callback paid Payment completed Paid failed Payment failed Payment failed, can retry by creating/using payable invoice flow if allowed cancelled Invoice cancelled Payment cancelled partial_refunded Partially refunded Partial refund completed refunded Fully refunded Full refund completed

Invoice workflow:

stateDiagram-v2
    pending --> paying: start_pay
    paying --> paid: mark_paid
    paid --> partial_refunded: partial_refund
    partial_refunded --> refunded: refund
    pending --> failed: fail
    paying --> cancelled: cancel

Invoice paid/refunded/cancelled/failed events update the linked order payment fields automatically when the invoice source is a trade order.

docs.title: User-Side Order Transitions
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders creates an order in draft status.

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{id}/payment can only pay an order in confirmed status.

The user can move their own order to payable status without admin intervention:

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{id}/submit
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{id}/confirm
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Only the current user's own order can be submitted or confirmed. Other users' orders return 404.

After the order becomes confirmed, the frontend can call the user payment endpoint.

docs.title: 1. List Products
docs.text:
Only active and non-deleted products are returned.

GET /api/v1/app/products?page=1&limit=20
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Example response fields:

{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "uuid": "...",
      "name": "Product A",
      "description": "...",
      "status": "active",
      "isDeleted": false,
      "metadata": null
    }
  ],
  "code": 0,
  "message": "SUCCESS"
}

docs.title: 2. Get Product Detail
docs.text:
GET /api/v1/app/products/{productId}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

docs.title: 3. List Product Specifications
docs.text:
Only active and non-deleted specifications are returned.

GET /api/v1/app/specifications/by-product/{productId}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Example response fields:

{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 10,
      "name": "Default",
      "price": 1500,
      "priceAsFloat": 15.0,
      "status": "active",
      "sort": 0,
      "isDeleted": false
    }
  ],
  "code": 0,
  "message": "SUCCESS"
}

docs.title: 4. Create Order
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Request:

{
  "items": [
    { "specificationId": 10, "quantity": 2 },
    { "specificationId": 11, "quantity": 1 }
  ],
  "currency": "CNY",
  "notes": "Please ship quickly",
  "metadata": {
    "receiver": {
      "name": "Zhang San",
      "phone": "13800138000",
      "address": "Nanshan, Shenzhen"
    }
  }
}

Rules:

Field Required Notes items yes Non-empty array items[].specificationId yes Specification id items[].quantity yes Must be at least 1 currency no Defaults to CNY notes no Customer note metadata no Saved as-is into trade_order.metadata, suitable for receiver/address snapshots and other frontend payloads

Example response:

{
  "data": {
    "id": 123,
    "uuid": "...",
    "totalAmount": 4500,
    "totalAmountAsFloat": 45.0,
    "currency": "CNY",
    "status": "draft",
    "notes": "Please ship quickly",
    "metadata": {
      "receiver": {
        "name": "Zhang San",
        "phone": "13800138000",
        "address": "Nanshan, Shenzhen"
      }
    },
    "paymentMethod": null,
    "invoiceId": null,
    "invoiceNo": null,
    "paymentStatus": null,
    "createdAt": "..."
  },
  "code": 0,
  "message": "Order created"
}

docs.title: 5. List My Orders
docs.text:
GET /api/v1/app/orders?page=1&limit=20
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Only current user's orders are returned.

Useful filters:

GET /api/v1/app/orders?@filter=entity.getStatus() == 'paid'

docs.title: 6. Get Order Detail
docs.text:
GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Only current user's own order can be read. Other users' orders return 404.

docs.title: 7. Get Order Items
docs.text:
GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/items
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Example response fields:

{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "uuid": "...",
      "specificationTitle": "Default",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unitPrice": 1500,
      "price": 3000,
      "specSnapshot": {
        "id": 10,
        "name": "Default",
        "productId": 1
      },
      "productSnapshot": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Product A"
      }
    }
  ],
  "code": 0,
  "message": "SUCCESS"
}

docs.title: 1. Make Order Payable
docs.text:
Current implementation requires the order to be confirmed before user payment.

User app flow:

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/submit
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/confirm
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

The order is now confirmed and can be paid.

Admin/backend can still use POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/do/{transition} for operational workflows.

docs.title: 2. Start Order Payment
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/payment
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Mock payment request:

{
  "payment": "mock"
}

Wallet payment request:

{
  "payment": "wallet",
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

Mixed wallet deduction + gateway payment request:

{
  "payment": "mock",
  "walletAmount": 1000,
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

Mock auto-paid request for development/testing:

{
  "payment": "mock",
  "autoPaid": true
}

Supported payment values:

payment Meaning mock Mock gateway for development/testing wallet Wallet balance payment wechat WeChat Pay gateway, including Mini Program JSAPI payment, if configured

Common payment options:

Field Required Notes payment no Defaults to mock systemWalletId for wallet payment/deduction Target system wallet id walletAmount no Deduct part of invoice from wallet balance before gateway payment autoPaid mock only If true, mock gateway immediately marks invoice paid gateway no Saved to invoice gateway field tradeType no Saved to invoice trade type. WeChat currently supports jsapi and native. Mini Program payment uses jsapi.

Example response for mock payment not yet paid:

{
  "data": {
    "invoice": {
      "id": 88,
      "uuid": "...",
      "outTradeNo": "PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12",
      "sourceType": "trade_order",
      "sourceId": "<order_uuid>",
      "scene": "order",
      "payment": "mock",
      "status": "paying",
      "amount": 4500,
      "currency": "CNY"
    },
    "status": "paying",
    "payUrl": "/mock/pay/PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12",
    "qrCode": null,
    "payload": {
      "gateway": "mock",
      "outTradeNo": "PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12",
      "amount": 4500,
      "transactionId": "mock-PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12"
    },
    "message": "Mock payment created"
  },
  "code": 0,
  "message": "Payment started"
}

If payment completes synchronously, such as wallet or mock with autoPaid: true, the returned status is paid, invoice status becomes paid, and linked order status becomes paid automatically.

docs.title: WeChat Mini Program Payment
docs.text: WeChat Mini Program payment uses the wechat payment gateway with tradeType: "jsapi".

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
The user must log in through WeChat Mini Program before starting JSAPI payment. This creates or finds the local user and stores the WeChat openid mapping used by payment.

POST /api/wechat/miniapp/login
Content-Type: application/json

Request:

{
  "js_code": "wx.login returned code"
}

Response:

{
  "access_token": "<jwt>",
  "expires_in": 7200,
  "refresh_token": "<refresh_token>"
}

Use access_token as the Bearer token for order/payment APIs.

Optional phone binding:

POST /api/wechat/miniapp/phone
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "code": "getPhoneNumber returned code"
}

Server configuration required for WeChat Pay:

Env Meaning WECHAT_MINIAPP_APP_ID Mini Program app id WECHAT_MINIAPP_SECRET Mini Program secret WECHAT_PAY_MCH_ID WeChat Pay merchant id WECHAT_PAY_SECRET_KEY API v3 secret key WECHAT_PAY_PRIVATE_KEY Merchant private key path WECHAT_PAY_CERTIFICATE Merchant certificate path WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL Public notify URL, should route to /api/payment/notify/wechat

docs.title: Start Mini Program Payment
docs.text:
The order must already be confirmed. For user-side flow, call POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/submit and then POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/confirm before starting payment.

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/payment
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Request:

{
  "payment": "wechat",
  "tradeType": "jsapi"
}

If using wallet balance deduction before WeChat payment:

{
  "payment": "wechat",
  "tradeType": "jsapi",
  "walletAmount": 1000,
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

Example response:

{
  "data": {
    "invoice": {
      "id": 88,
      "uuid": "...",
      "outTradeNo": "PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12",
      "sourceType": "trade_order",
      "sourceId": "<order_uuid>",
      "scene": "order",
      "payment": "wechat",
      "tradeType": "jsapi",
      "status": "paying",
      "amount": 4500,
      "currency": "CNY"
    },
    "status": "paying",
    "payUrl": null,
    "qrCode": null,
    "payload": {
      "timeStamp": "1234567890",
      "nonceStr": "abc123",
      "package": "prepay_id=wx_prepay_jsapi_001",
      "signType": "RSA",
      "paySign": "sign_abc"
    },
    "message": "WeChat JSAPI order created"
  },
  "code": 0,
  "message": "Payment started"
}

Frontend Mini Program call:

wx.requestPayment({
  timeStamp: payload.timeStamp,
  nonceStr: payload.nonceStr,
  package: payload.package,
  signType: payload.signType,
  paySign: payload.paySign,
  success() {
    // Payment UI succeeded. Final payment status still depends on server notify.
    // Poll GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId} until status becomes paid.
  },
  fail(err) {
    // User cancelled or payment failed in the client UI.
    // Keep order as confirmed/paying and allow retry, or ask backend to cancel if needed.
  }
});

Important frontend notes:

Point Meaning wx.requestPayment.success Only means the client payment UI completed. Use server order/invoice status as source of truth. Polling target GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId} or GET /api/v1/app/invoices/{invoiceId} Success final state Order paid, invoice paid Retry If order remains confirmed and invoice/payment status is paying or failed, frontend can show retry according to backend policy.

docs.title: WeChat Pay Notify
docs.text:
WeChat Pay sends server callback to the configured WECHAT_PAY_NOTIFY_URL, which should point to:

POST /api/payment/notify/wechat

The server verifies the WeChat signature and decrypts the event through EasyWeChat. On success it returns:

{
  "code": "SUCCESS",
  "message": "成功"
}

After valid notify:

Entity Result Invoice paid, transactionId saved from WeChat transaction id Order paid through invoice paid event listener Order payment fields paymentMethod=wechat, paymentStatus=paid, invoiceId, invoiceNo, paidAt updated

docs.title: WeChat Native Payment
docs.text:
The same gateway also supports WeChat Native QR payment for non-mini-program scenarios.

{
  "payment": "wechat",
  "tradeType": "native"
}

Response returns payUrl as WeChat code_url. The frontend can render it as a QR code.

docs.title: 3. Handle Gateway Callback
docs.text:
The external payment gateway posts to:

POST /api/payment/notify/{payment}
Content-Type: application/json

Mock notify example:

{
  "secret": "mock",
  "outTradeNo": "PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12",
  "status": "paid",
  "amount": 4500,
  "currency": "CNY",
  "transactionId": "mock-txn-001"
}

Success response:

SUCCESS

Failed response:

FAIL

When notify succeeds with status: paid:

Entity Result Invoice paid Order paid Order payment fields paymentMethod, invoiceId, invoiceNo, paymentStatus, paidAt are updated

docs.title: 4. Poll Order Or Invoice After Payment
docs.text:
Poll order:

GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Poll invoice:

GET /api/v1/app/invoices/{invoiceId}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

List my invoices:

GET /api/v1/app/invoices?page=1&limit=20
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Pay an existing invoice directly:

POST /api/v1/app/invoices/{invoiceId}/pay/{payment}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Example:

{
  "autoPaid": true
}

docs.title: User Cancel Order
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/cancel
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Allowed only when order status is draft, pending, or confirmed.

If the order has a linked invoice, cancellation also cancels that invoice. If wallet deduction was applied to the invoice, cancellation releases the deduction and returns wallet balance.

Example success response:

{
  "data": {
    "id": 123,
    "status": "cancelled",
    "cancelledAt": "...",
    "paymentStatus": "cancelled"
  },
  "code": 0,
  "message": "Order cancelled"
}

Common failure:

{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Order cannot be cancelled in current status.",
  "raw_data": ""
}

docs.title: Admin Cancel Order
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/do/cancel
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>

docs.title: Admin Cancel Invoice Directly
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/invoices/{invoiceId}/cancel
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Request:

{
  "reason": "Customer cancelled before payment"
}

docs.title: Fulfillment And Completion Flow
docs.text: These are admin/backend operations in the current implementation.

docs.title: Fulfill Order
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/fulfill
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Allowed only from paid.

Request:

{
  "trackingNumber": "TRACK-001",
  "shippingAddress": "Address snapshot"
}

Result: order status becomes fulfilled.

docs.title: Complete Order
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/do/complete
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>

Allowed only from fulfilled.

Result: order status becomes completed.

docs.title: Refund Flow
docs.text: Refunds are admin/backend operations in the current implementation.

docs.title: Refund Order
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/refund
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Allowed only from completed.

Request:

{
  "reason": "Customer requested refund",
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

Rules:

Case Behavior Order has linked invoice Calls invoice refund for remaining invoice amount. systemWalletId is needed if the payment/refund path uses wallet. Order has no linked invoice Uses wallet transfer refund and requires systemWalletId. Invoice has wallet deduction Adjusted invoices only support full refund.

Example response:

{
  "data": {
    "invoice": {
      "id": 88,
      "status": "refunded",
      "refundedAmount": 4500
    },
    "amount": 4500,
    "status": "refunded",
    "refundId": "mock-refund-PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12-4500",
    "rawData": {
      "gateway": {
        "reason": "Customer requested refund",
        "amount": 4500,
        "paidAmount": 4500
      }
    }
  },
  "code": 0,
  "message": "Refund processed"
}

When the invoice becomes fully refunded, the linked order becomes refunded automatically.

docs.title: Refund Invoice Directly
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/invoices/{invoiceId}/refund
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Request:

{
  "amount": 4500,
  "reason": "Customer requested refund",
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

amount can be integer cents/fen or decimal string, for example 4500 or "45.00".

docs.title: Get Available Order Transitions
docs.text:
GET /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/transitions
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>

Example response field:

{
  "data": [
    { "name": "submit" },
    { "name": "cancel" }
  ],
  "code": 0,
  "message": "SUCCESS"
}

docs.title: Apply Generic Order Transition
docs.text:
POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/do/{transition}
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

Supported transitions:

Transition From To submit draft pending confirm pending confirmed pay confirmed paid fulfill paid fulfilled complete fulfilled completed cancel draft, pending, confirmed cancelled refund completed refunded

The body is optional. If present, supported order fields are updated before transition.

Example:

{
  "notes": "confirmed by backend"
}

docs.title: Get Available Invoice Transitions
docs.text:
GET /api/v1/manage/invoices/{invoiceId}/transitions
Authorization: Bearer <admin_access_token>

docs.title: Order Action Buttons
docs.text: Order status Show actions draft Submit; Cancel pending Confirm; Cancel confirmed Pay; Cancel paid Show paid/waiting fulfillment fulfilled Show shipped/fulfilled completed Show completed cancelled No primary action refunded No primary action

docs.title: Payment UI Handling
docs.text: Payment result status Frontend action paying Redirect/open payUrl, show QR if qrCode exists, then poll order/invoice paid Show success and refresh order detail failed Show failure and allow retry if backend allows cancelled Show cancelled

docs.title: Polling Strategy
docs.text:
After starting payment, poll:

GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}

Stop polling when order status is one of:

paid, fulfilled, completed, cancelled, refunded

If order status is still confirmed but paymentStatus is paying, continue polling or ask user to complete gateway payment.

docs.title: Development Mock Payment, Auto Paid
docs.text:
1. User creates order:
POST /api/v1/app/orders

{
  "items": [{ "specificationId": 10, "quantity": 1 }],
  "currency": "CNY"
}
  1. User submits and confirms order:
POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/submit
POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/confirm
  1. User starts mock auto-paid payment:
POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/payment

{
  "payment": "mock",
  "autoPaid": true
}
  1. Frontend refreshes order:
GET /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}

Expected order status: paid.

docs.title: Development Mock Payment With Notify
docs.text:
1. User starts payment without autoPaid:
{
  "payment": "mock"
}

  1. Response returns invoice outTradeNo and amount.

  2. Simulate callback:

POST /api/payment/notify/mock

{
  "secret": "mock",
  "outTradeNo": "PAY20260704120000ABCDEF12",
  "status": "paid",
  "amount": 4500,
  "currency": "CNY",
  "transactionId": "mock-txn-001"
}
  1. Frontend polls order; expected status: paid.

docs.title: Wallet Payment
docs.text:
Prerequisites:

Requirement Notes User wallet exists Same currency as order, for example CNY User wallet has enough balance Otherwise payment fails System wallet exists Pass its id as systemWalletId unless configured server-side

Request:

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/payment

{
  "payment": "wallet",
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

Expected result: invoice paid, order paid, user wallet debited, system wallet credited.

docs.title: Cancel Before Payment Completes
docs.text:
Allowed order statuses: draft, pending, confirmed.

POST /api/v1/app/orders/{orderId}/cancel

If an invoice is linked and still cancellable, it is cancelled too.

docs.title: Refund After Completion
docs.text:
Backend/admin:

POST /api/v1/manage/orders/{orderId}/refund

{
  "reason": "Customer requested refund",
  "systemWalletId": 99
}

Expected final status: order refunded, invoice refunded.

docs.title: EasyWeChat 6.x Usage Notes
docs.text: Research source: https://easywechat.com/6.x/ Focus: Mini Program, login/openid, and WeChat Pay APIs.

docs.title: 1.1 Install And Instantiate
docs.text:
EasyWeChat 6.x uses module-specific Application classes. For Mini Program:

use EasyWeChat\MiniApp\Application;

$config = [
    'app_id' => 'wx3cf0f39249eb0exx',
    'secret' => 'f1c242f4f28f735d4687abb469072axx',
    'token' => 'easywechat',
    'aes_key' => '......',
    'http' => [
        'throw' => true,
        'timeout' => 5.0,
        'retry' => true,
    ],
];

$app = new Application($config);

Common entry points:

$client = $app->getClient();       // API client, auto handles access_token
$server = $app->getServer();       // server callback handling
$config = $app->getConfig();       // config repository
$token = $app->getAccessToken();   // access token object
$utils = $app->getUtils();         // mini app utility helpers
$account = $app->getAccount();     // app_id / secret / token / aes_key info

Access token value:

$accessToken = $app->getAccessToken();
$token = $accessToken->getToken();

docs.title: 1.2 Generic API Calls
docs.text:
Use getClient() for arbitrary WeChat Mini Program APIs:

$response = $app->getClient()->postJson('/wxa/getwxacodeunlimit', [
    'scene' => '123',
    'page' => 'pages/index/index',
    'width' => 430,
    'check_path' => false,
]);

$path = $response->saveAs('/tmp/wxacode-123.png');

docs.title: 1.3 Get Phone Number
docs.text:
Mini Program phone number API uses a frontend code passed to backend:

$data = [
    'code' => (string) request()->get('code'),
];

$response = $app->getClient()->postJson('wxa/business/getuserphonenumber', $data);

docs.title: 2.1 Web OAuth Flow
docs.text:
EasyWeChat OAuth is mainly documented for Official Account / Open Platform web authorization.

Typical flow:

  1. User opens a protected business page.
  2. Backend detects missing login/session.
  3. Backend redirects user to WeChat OAuth URL.
  4. WeChat redirects back with code and state.
  5. Backend exchanges code for OAuth user info.
  6. Backend stores openid and optional profile info in the local user/session.

docs.title: 2.2 Start Authorization
docs.text:
$oauth = $app->getOauth();

$redirectUrl = $oauth->scopes(['snsapi_userinfo'])->redirect();

// Or set callback/current URL explicitly:
$redirectUrl = $oauth->scopes(['snsapi_userinfo'])->redirect($request->fullUrl());

Then return a framework redirect response:

return redirect($redirectUrl);

docs.title: 2.3 Handle Callback And Get OpenID
docs.text:
$code = $_GET['code'];
$user = $oauth->userFromCode($code);

Useful methods:

$openid = $user->getId();          // WeChat openid
$nickname = $user->getNickname();
$name = $user->getName();
$avatar = $user->getAvatar();
$raw = $user->getRaw();            // original API response
$accessToken = $user->getAccessToken();
$refreshToken = $user->getRefreshToken();
$expiresIn = $user->getExpiresIn();
$tokenResponse = $user->getTokenResponse();

Important notes:

  • $user->getId() is the WeChat openid.
  • With snsapi_base, the returned user generally only contains id/openid.
  • With snsapi_userinfo, nickname/avatar and richer profile fields are available after user consent.

docs.title: 2.4 Mini Program Login Note
docs.text:
For Mini Program login, EasyWeChat 6.x primarily exposes the generic API client. In backend code, pass frontend js_code to the WeChat auth endpoint through $app->getClient(), then persist the returned openid/unionid according to the official Mini Program login contract.

Example shape:

$response = $app->getClient()->get('/sns/jscode2session', [
    'query' => [
        'appid' => $app->getAccount()->getAppId(),
        'secret' => $app->getAccount()->getSecret(),
        'js_code' => $jsCode,
        'grant_type' => 'authorization_code',
    ],
]);

$data = $response->toArray(false);
$openid = $data['openid'] ?? null;
$unionid = $data['unionid'] ?? null;
$sessionKey = $data['session_key'] ?? null;

docs.title: 3.1 Instantiate Pay Application
docs.text:
use EasyWeChat\Pay\Application;

$config = [
    'mch_id' => 1360649000,
    'private_key' => __DIR__ . '/certs/apiclient_key.pem',
    'certificate' => __DIR__ . '/certs/apiclient_cert.pem',
    'secret_key' => 'APIv3_KEY',
    'v2_secret_key' => 'V2_API_KEY',
    'platform_certs' => [
        // Platform cert mode:
        // 'SERIAL_NO' => '/path/to/wechatpay/cert.pem',

        // WeChat Pay public key mode:
        // 'PUB_KEY_ID_...' => '/path/to/wechatpay/pubkey.pem',
    ],
    'http' => [
        'throw' => true,
        'timeout' => 5.0,
    ],
];

$app = new Application($config);

Useful entry points:

$client = $app->getClient();       // WeChat Pay API client
$utils = $app->getUtils();         // payment frontend config helpers
$config = $app->getConfig();
$merchant = $app->getMerchant();
$validator = $app->getValidator(); // signature validator
$server = $app->getServer();       // payment/refund notify server

Merchant helpers:

$merchant->getMerchantId();
$merchant->getPrivateKey();
$merchant->getCertificate();
$merchant->getSecretKey();
$merchant->getV2SecretKey();
$merchant->getPlatformCert($serial);
$merchant->getPlatformCerts();

docs.title: 3.2 JSAPI Order
docs.text:
JSAPI requires payer openid:

$response = $app->getClient()->postJson('v3/pay/transactions/jsapi', [
    'mchid' => (string) $app->getMerchant()->getMerchantId(),
    'out_trade_no' => $outTradeNo,
    'appid' => $miniAppIdOrOfficialAccountAppId,
    'description' => $description,
    'notify_url' => $notifyUrl,
    'amount' => [
        'total' => $amountInCents,
        'currency' => 'CNY',
    ],
    'payer' => [
        'openid' => $openid,
    ],
]);

$result = $response->toArray(false);

docs.title: 3.3 Native Order
docs.text:
$response = $app->getClient()->postJson('v3/pay/transactions/native', [
    'mchid' => (string) $app->getMerchant()->getMerchantId(),
    'out_trade_no' => $outTradeNo,
    'appid' => $appId,
    'description' => $description,
    'notify_url' => $notifyUrl,
    'amount' => [
        'total' => $amountInCents,
        'currency' => 'CNY',
    ],
]);

$result = $response->toArray(false);

docs.title: 3.4 Query Order
docs.text:
By merchant order number:

$response = $app->getClient()->get("v3/pay/transactions/out-trade-no/{$outTradeNo}", [
    'query' => [
        'mchid' => $app->getMerchant()->getMerchantId(),
    ],
]);

$order = $response->toArray();

By WeChat transaction id:

$response = $app->getClient()->get("v3/pay/transactions/id/{$transactionId}", [
    'query' => [
        'mchid' => $app->getMerchant()->getMerchantId(),
    ],
]);

docs.title: 3.5 Validate API Response Signature
docs.text:
$response = $app->getClient()->postJson('v3/pay/transactions/jsapi', [...]);

try {
    $app->getValidator()->validate($response->toPsrResponse());
} catch (\Throwable $e) {
    // Signature verification failed
}

docs.title: 3.6 Payment Notify Handling
docs.text:
Payment notifications should be verified and treated as untrusted until validated. EasyWeChat provides server handlers:

$server = $app->getServer();

$server->handlePaid(function ($message, \Closure $next) use ($app) {
    // $message->out_trade_no: merchant order no
    // $message->transaction_id: WeChat transaction id
    // $message->payer['openid']: payer openid

    $app->getValidator()->validate($app->getRequest());

    // Recommended: query WeChat order by out_trade_no and use query result as source of truth.
    // Then update local invoice/order idempotently.

    return $next($message);
});

return $server->serve();

Default successful response is similar to:

['code' => 'SUCCESS', 'message' => '成功']

Important notes:

  • Notify URL must use HTTPS for production WeChat Pay.
  • Callback route usually needs CSRF disabled.
  • Do not blindly trust callback payload. Verify signature and query the order state when possible.
  • Use out_trade_no as local invoice/order lookup key.
  • Use idempotency because WeChat can retry callbacks.

docs.title: 3.7 Refund Notify Handling
docs.text:
$server = $app->getServer();

$server->handleRefunded(function ($message, \Closure $next) {
    // $message->out_trade_no
    // $message->transaction_id
    // Handle local refund state idempotently.
    return $next($message);
});

return $server->serve();

Some refund notifications may still use v2-style XML in certain merchant-platform flows. EasyWeChat docs recommend using a dedicated refund notify route if this appears in production.

docs.title: 3.8 Read Raw Request Message
docs.text:
$message = $server->getRequestMessage();

$eventType = $message->getEventType();
$original = $message->getOriginalAttributes();

The parsed $message is decrypted by SDK. getOriginalAttributes() returns encrypted/original callback attributes.

docs.title: 4. Payment Frontend Config Helpers
docs.text: EasyWeChat Pay utils can generate frontend payment configs from prepay_id.

docs.title: 4.1 WeixinJSBridge
docs.text:
$utils = $app->getUtils();
$config = $utils->buildBridgeConfig($prepayId, $appId, 'RSA');

Frontend:

WeixinJSBridge.invoke('getBrandWCPayRequest', {
  timeStamp: config.timeStamp,
  nonceStr: config.nonceStr,
  package: config.package,
  signType: config.signType,
  paySign: config.paySign
}, function (res) {
  if (res.err_msg === 'get_brand_wcpay_request:ok') {
    // User-side success callback; still rely on server notify/query for final state.
  }
});

docs.title: 4.2 JSSDK wx.chooseWXPay
docs.text: $config = $utils->buildSdkConfig($prepayId, $appId, 'RSA');

docs.title: 4.3 Mini Program wx.requestPayment
docs.text:
$config = $utils->buildMiniAppConfig($prepayId, $miniAppId, 'RSA');

Frontend:

wx.requestPayment({
  timeStamp: config.timeStamp,
  nonceStr: config.nonceStr,
  package: config.package,
  signType: config.signType,
  paySign: config.paySign,
  success(res) {
    // Client success callback only. Server notify/query remains source of truth.
  }
});

docs.title: 4.4 APP Pay
docs.text: $config = $utils->buildAppConfig($prepayId, $appId);

docs.title: 5. Sensitive Field Encryption
docs.text:
EasyWeChat 6.17.0+ supports WeChat Pay public-key encryption for sensitive fields:

$utils = $app->getUtils();

$encrypted = $utils->encryptWithRsaPublicKey($plaintext, $serialOrPubKeyId);

When sending requests that require serial headers:

$response = $app->getClient()
    ->withSerialHeader('PUB_KEY_ID_123456')
    ->postJson('v3/applyment4sub/applyment/', [
        'business_code' => '12345678',
        'contact_info' => [
            'contact_name' => $utils->encryptWithRsaPublicKey('张三', 'PUB_KEY_ID_123456'),
        ],
    ]);

docs.title: 6. Practical Integration Notes For This Project
docs.text:
• Store all amounts as integer cents. WeChat Pay amount.total also uses cents.

  • Store WeChat Pay transaction_id as provider transaction id.
  • Store payer openid in local identity/payment metadata before creating JSAPI orders.
  • Use server-side notify/query to mark invoices paid. Frontend success callbacks are not authoritative.
  • Webhook handling should be idempotent and signature-verified.
  • For Mini Program payment, backend should return buildMiniAppConfig($prepayId, $miniAppId, 'RSA') payload to frontend.
  • Keep merchant credentials, API keys, private keys, platform cert/public key paths in environment or secret config, never committed.

Request envelope for all V2 APIs:

    "product_id": "YMFZS",
    "data": { ... },
    "sign": "<base64 RSA-SHA256>"

docs.title: 2. Core Signing — RSA-SHA256 (from official SDK)
docs.text: These are the exact implementations from BsPaySdk\core\BsPayTools.php — the official Huifu PHP SDK.

docs.title: 2.1 Request signing
docs.text:
// File: BsPaySdk/core/BsPayTools.php (official SDK v2.0.11)
public static function sha_with_rsa_sign($data, $rsaPrivateKey, $alg=OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256){
    $key = "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n"
        . wordwrap($rsaPrivateKey, 64, "\n", true)
        . "\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----";
    $signature= '';
    try {
        openssl_sign($data, $signature, $key, $alg);
    } catch (\Exception $e) {
        echo $e->getMessage();
    }
    return base64_encode($signature);
}

Usage: 1. Build request data as associative array. 2. ksort($data) 3. json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) 4. sha_with_rsa_sign($json, $rsaPrivateKey) → base64 signature 5. Wrap into {sys_id, product_id, data, sign} envelope

docs.title: 2.2 Response / notify verification
docs.text:
// File: BsPaySdk/core/BsPayTools.php (official SDK)

// Simple verify (raw string)
public static function verifySign($signature, $data, $rsaPublicKey, $alg=OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256){
    $key = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
        . wordwrap($rsaPublicKey, 64, "\n", true)
        . "\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----";
    return openssl_verify($data, base64_decode($signature), $key, $alg);
}

// Verify with ksort (for API response data arrays)
public static function verifySign_sort($signature, $data, $rsaPublicKey, $alg=OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256){
    $key = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
        . wordwrap($rsaPublicKey, 64, "\n", true)
        . "\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----";
    ksort($data);
    $data = json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    $data = str_replace("\n","\\n",$data);
    $data = str_replace('"enter_fee":0,','"enter_fee":0.00,',$data);
    return openssl_verify($data, base64_decode($signature), $key, $alg);
}

Note: verifySign_sort() has a hardcoded workaround for enter_fee field format bug. New implementations should be aware of this.

public static function encrypt_with_rsa_pubkey($data, $rsaPublicKey, $padding=OPENSSL_PKCS1_PADDING){
    $key = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\n"
        . wordwrap($rsaPublicKey, 64, "\n", true)

// File: BsPaySdk/core/BsPayRequestV2.php — createBody()
private function createBody(MerConfig $merChantConfig, $post_data, $file = null){
    $body = array();
    $body['sys_id'] = $merChantConfig->sys_id;
    $body['product_id'] = $merChantConfig->product_id;
    ksort($post_data);
    $body['data'] = $post_data;
    $sign = BsPayTools::sha_with_rsa_sign(
        json_encode($post_data, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
        $merChantConfig->rsa_merch_private_key);
    $body['sign'] = $sign;
    if(!empty($file)){
        $body['file'] = $file;
        $body['data'] = json_encode($post_data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    }
    return $body;
}

docs.title: 3.1 Unified Order (JSAPI/MiniApp/Native/H5/APP)
docs.text:
POST /v2/trade/payment/jspay

Request data fields:

Field Type Required Description req_date string(8) Yes Ymd format, e.g. "20230725" req_seq_id string Yes Merchant order number, unique huifu_id string Yes Merchant sys_id or sub-merchant huifu_id trade_type string Yes T_JSAPI, T_MINIAPP, T_NATIVE, T_APP, T_H5 trans_amt string Yes Amount in YUAN, e.g. "10.00" goods_desc string Yes Product description (UTF-8) notify_url string Yes Async callback URL wx_data string Conditional JSON string: miniapp → {"sub_appid":"...","sub_openid":"..."}, JSAPI → {"openid":"..."} time_expire string No Order expiry alipay_data string No Alipay channel data acct_split_bunch string No Split settlement config risk_check_data string No Risk control terminal_device_data string No POS terminal data extend_pay_data string No Extended pay data

Response data fields:

Field Description resp_code 00000100 (order created), 00000000 (success), other = error resp_desc Description hf_seq_id Huifu transaction seq ID req_seq_id Echo back merchant order no trans_stat P = processing, S = success, F = failed bank_code / bank_message Channel info pay_info JSON: {appId, timeStamp, package, paySign, signType, nonceStr} for wx.requestPayment trans_amt Amount
